# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment (Gen 2: $\mu\text{m}$)

- **Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment [Optics & Precision Alignment]
- **Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Role**: Domain Expert AI — DRAM Foundation VN Council

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  1. Vacuum Load Wafer  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   2. Set Separation    │
│    Gap 10 to 20 um     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3. Split-Field Dual   │
│      CMOS Vision       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    4. XY-Theta Fine    │
│   Alignment +/- 5 um   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    5. i-line 365nm     │
│    Exposure 120-150    │
│         mJ/cm2         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Check & Chuck Mounting**:
   - Verify that the wafer has been spin-coated with Shipley 1813 photoresist at $4000\text{ RPM}$ ($\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ film thickness) and soft-baked at $115^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ seconds}$ on a flat aluminum hot plate.
   - Mount the wafer onto the macroscopic vacuum chuck stage beneath the chromium-on-quartz mask holder. Engage vacuum hold-down.
2. **Gap Separation Setting**:
   - Using three differential micrometers (or closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity), establish a parallel proximity separation air gap of $10\ \mu\text{m}\text{ to }20\ \mu\text{m}$ between the photoresist-coated substrate and the mask surface to prevent scratch defects while aligning.
3. **Split-Field Optical Focus & Imaging**:
   - Position the split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras (configured with $10\times$ Plan Achromat objectives, $\text{NA }0.25$) over the wafer-mask fiducial zones.
   - Adjust focus to simultaneously bring both the substrate fiducials and mask crosshair alignment marks into sharp field view.
4. **Fine $XY$-$\theta$ Co-Registration**:
   - Translate and rotate the macroscopic stage using fine differential micrometers to align the wafer fiducials with the mask crosshairs.
   - Verify overlay error across dual split-field cameras to bring alignment error within the Gen 2 tolerance limit ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).
5. **Mode Engagement & UV Dose Exposure**:
   - For proximity printing, maintain the calibrated $10\text{--}20\ \mu\text{m}$ air gap; for contact printing, gently close the gap into direct contact if sub-micron feature transfer is required.
   - Expose the substrate using a $365\text{nm}$ i-line UV source (high-power UV LED array or 200W Mercury short-arc lamp through a fly's eye integrator lens).
   - Deliver a clear exposure dose calibrated by an optical radiometer to $120\text{--}150\text{ mJ/cm}^2$.
6. **Post-Exposure Unload**:
   - Disengage contact/proximity stage, release vacuum chuck, and transfer the wafer to the wet bench for developing in Microposit MF-319 for $45\text{--}60\text{ seconds}$ followed by a deionized (DI) water rinse.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Overlay Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Split-field dual CMOS camera crosshair co-registration |
| **Separation Air Gap (Proximity Mode)** | $10 \text{ to } 20$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Closed-loop piezo actuator / Differential micrometer ($0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity) |
| **UV Exposure Dose (Shipley 1813, $\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$)** | $120 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mJ/cm}^2$ | Optical radiometer at $365\text{nm}$ (i-line) |
| **Beam Exposure Uniformity** | $> 95$ | $\%$ | Multi-point radiometer scan across wafer field via fly's eye integrator |

---

### Source Citations
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**: Split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras; contact vs. proximity printing ($10\text{--}20\ \mu\text{m}$ gap); differential micrometers/piezo actuators ($0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity); 365nm i-line source / 200W Mercury lamp with fly's eye integrator ($>95\%$ beam uniformity); crosshair fiducial alignment; Shipley 1813 clear exposure dose ($120\text{--}150\text{ mJ/cm}^2$).
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**: Stable macroscopic stage and optical aligner; $10\times$ Plan Achromat microscope objective ($\text{NA }0.25$); Shipley 1813 spin-coated at $4000\text{ RPM}$ ($\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thickness); soft bake at $115^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ s}$ on aluminum hot plate; $365\text{nm}$ i-line UV source; Microposit MF-319 developer ($45\text{--}60\text{ s}$) with DI rinse; Gen 2 alignment tolerance limit of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires spin-coating bake stabilization (Softbake 90°C for 60s, HMDS vapor prime) before exposure. Post-exposure bake and develop latency must be strictly monitored.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: UV exposure dose budget (120-150 mJ/cm2 at 365 nm / 248 nm). Overlay alignment budget for Gen 2 (µm) must achieve <= +/- 5 um (Gen 2) or <= +/- 35 nm (Gen 3). Depth of focus (DOF) >= 1.2 um.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Precision fused silica chrome reticles and high-NA objective lenses must be COTS sourced; stage micrometers and linear encoders should use standard high-resolution industrial modules.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 48 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Alignment misregistration directly ruins multi-layer interconnect and contact via connectivity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Vernier misregistration exceeding overlay budget causing short-circuit between gate and bitline contact via.
1. Non-uniform exposure illumination across field causing critical dimension (CD) line-width variation > 10%.
1. Photoresist scumming in fine vias due to insufficient MF-319 developer agitation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-01` | **Optical Overlay Vernier Registration & Misalignment Metrology** | Optical Inspection Microscope (100x Oil/Dry Objective, 0.9 NA) with Digital Vernier Micrometer | 1. Focus optical system on wafer alignment cross and reticle outer box fiducials at wafer center and 4 corners. 2. Read vernier comb teeth displacement along X-axis and Y-axis. 3. Calculate rotational theta error and linear misregistration vector (Delta X, Delta Y). | `Max misregistration |Delta X|, |Delta Y| <= 5.0 um for Gen 2 / <= 35 nm for Gen 3 (Pass); Angular theta <= 0.02 deg (Pass).` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-02` | **Critical Dimension (CD) Line-Space Profile & Residue Scum Verification** | Top-Down / Cross-Sectional CD-SEM (Hitachi / FEI) or High-Resolution UV Profiler | 1. Position beam at 5 dense line-space arrays (nominal 180 nm or 1.0 um pitch depending on generation). 2. Take high-contrast secondary electron image at 1.0 kV acceleration voltage. 3. Measure linewidth across 10 distinct scanlines and inspect trench bottom for undeveloped resist scum. | `Linewidth within target +/- 8% (Pass); trench floor completely cleared of organic scum (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Nitrile cleanroom gloves (double gloving recommended during resist spin), UV-blocking amber safety glasses (certified 100% optical attenuation at 365 nm / 248 nm), Conductive cleanroom ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: TMAH skin contact warning: TMAH is a systemic neurotoxin capable of causing respiratory arrest upon dermal absorption. Flush with copious water for 15+ minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Explosion-proof solvent exhaust bench with activated charcoal VOC adsorber bed (exhaust velocity >= 0.45 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Flammable solvent waste segregated into grounded stainless steel safety cans. Never mix organic developer/solvent with oxidizers or acids.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-5` | Semiconductor Grade | `2.38% aq in Microposit MF-319 developer` |
| **1-Methoxy-2-propyl acetate (PGMEA)** | `108-65-6` | Electronic Grade | `Resist solvent base (Shipley 1813)` |
| **Hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS)** | `999-97-3` | Semiconductor Grade | `100% vapor prime adhesion promoter` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: HMDS vapor-primed, dehydration-baked substrate (150°C for 30 min) to ensure resist adhesion.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Softbaked photoresist film (1.2 um thickness, uniform within +/- 10 nm across wafer).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture uptake and ambient airborne amine contamination neutralizes surface photoacid generators, causing resist 'T-topping' and failed contact via opening.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment: Photolithographic exposure and development achieves critical dimension line-width target within tolerance, satisfying layer-to-layer overlay budget.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CD_SEM_top_down_inspection_micrographs.tiff`
- [ ] `Box_in_box_Vernier_overlay_error_map.csv`
- [ ] `Stylus_profiler_resist_step_height_log.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Critical Dimension (CD) line width** | `180 nm (Gen 3) / 2.0 um (Gen 2) / 0.1 mm (Gen 1)` | +/- 10% maximum CD window (3-sigma) | Calibrated Top-down Critical Dimension SEM (CD-SEM) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layer-to-layer overlay misregistration (delta_x, delta_y)** | `<= +/- 35 nm (Gen 3) / <= +/- 5.0 um (Gen 2)` | 3-sigma statistical distribution across field | Optical Box-in-Box Vernier overlay metrology |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-develop photoresist sidewall profile angle** | `>= 85.0 deg` | +/- 3.0 deg | Cross-sectional SEM / AFM high-aspect profilometry |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero photoresist bridging, scumming, or micro-pinholes observed in inspection fields; overlay registration strictly within design budget across 100% of die locations.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Split-Field Optical System Calibration & Proximity Gap Setting

**Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) `[Architecture & Integration]` > `[Optics & Precision Alignment]`  
**Document Link**: [`docs/sop_split_field_optical_system_calibration_proximity_gap_setting.md`](docs/sop_split_field_optical_system_calibration_proximity_gap_setting.md)

---

### Process Execution Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Load Mask & Wafer   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    WEC Parallelism    │
│      Calibration      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Set Proximity Gap   │
│     (10 - 30 µm)      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Split-Field Optical  │
│    Focus (5x->20x)    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Fiducial Overlay    │
│  Metrology (±2-5 µm)  │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Optical Parfocality & Objective Configuration**:
   - Inspect and load the chromium-on-quartz mask onto the mask holder under vacuum retention.
   - Initialize the binocular split-field microscope with dual high-resolution CMOS cameras.
   - Step objective magnification sequentially from **5x** (field mark acquisition) to **10x** and lock at **20x** for high-resolution fiducial alignment. Adjust independent channel focus for left/right camera parfocality.

2. **Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) Parallelism Leveling**:
   - Mount the 100mm silicon wafer on the leveling vacuum chuck.
   - Release the spherical air bearing to allow multi-axis self-leveling chuck articulation.
   - Raise the wafer stage into mechanical contact with the mask leveling pads and lock the spherical air bearing, ensuring parallelism across the 100mm wafer field is **$< 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$**.

3. **Proximity Gap Setting & Actuation**:
   - Retract the leveled wafer chuck downward using three differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators with **0.1 µm** sensitivity.
   - Establish the target proximity air gap within **$10\ \mu\text{m} \text{ to } 30\ \mu\text{m}$** (nominal 10–20 µm) to protect resist and mask from scratch damage while constraining Fresnel diffraction.

4. **Split-Field Overlay Alignment & Illumination Homogeneity**:
   - Align wafer and mask crosshair fiducial marks under 20x split-field viewing across X, Y, and $\theta$ axes. Target operator overlay error within **$\pm 2\ \mu\text{m} \text{ to } \pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$**.
   - Verify UV exposure optics (365nm i-line LED array or 200W Hg short-arc lamp coupled through a fly's eye integrator lens) delivers **$> 95\%$** beam uniformity measured with a calibrated radiometer.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                      Target Acceptance Specifications  
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
      Beam Uniformity┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                     │▒▒▒                              │
 Overlay Align (Prox)┤▒▒▒                              │
Proximity Gap Setting┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                      │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                      │
      WEC Wedge Error┤█                                │
                     │█                                │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    23.8    47.5    71.2   95.0 
```

| Parameter | Nominal Specification | Acceptance Range | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **WEC Parallelism / Wedge Error** | $< 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ | $\le 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ across 100mm wafer | Spherical air bearing leveling mechanical gauge |
| **Proximity Air Gap** | $10\ \mu\text{m} - 30\ \mu\text{m}$ | $10.0\ \mu\text{m} \le \text{Gap} \le 30.0\ \mu\text{m}$ | 0.1 µm differential micrometers / closed-loop piezo |
| **Proximity Mode Overlay Alignment** | $\le \pm 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 2.0\ \mu\text{m} \text{ to } \pm 5.0\ \mu\text{m}$ | 20x dual CMOS split-field crosshair metrology |
| **UV Exposure Beam Uniformity** | $> 95\%$ | $\ge 95.0\%$ | Calibrated optical radiometer sweep |

---

### Literature Citations
- **Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Standard Operating Procedure & Gap Control**: Wedge Error Compensation ($< 1\ \mu\text{m}$ across 100mm wafer via spherical air bearings); split-field optical system (5x, 10x, 20x objectives, dual CMOS cameras); proximity gap ($10\ \mu\text{m} \text{ to } 30\ \mu\text{m}$); operator overlay precision ($\pm 2 \text{ to } 5\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**: Quartz mask handling; gap setting via differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators ($0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity; $10 \text{ to } 20\ \mu\text{m}$ proximity gap); UV exposure optics (365nm i-line LED / 200W Hg lamp with fly's eye integrator lens for $> 95\%$ beam uniformity).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) spherical air-bearing pneumatics must be dynamically interlocked with the proximity gap linear optical encoders. A 0.5 um mechanical drift in chuck leveling across a 100mm substrate cascades into non-uniform Fresnel diffraction margins, directly degrading Gen 2 overlay registration and critical dimension uniformity.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Calibrating the split-field binocular optical microscope requires precise parfocality and telecentricity across 5x, 10x, and 20x objectives to avoid parallax-induced operator alignment errors. For 180nm DRAM Gen 2 micrometer test structures, proximity gap setting between 10 um and 20 um must maintain planarity within 1.0 um across split viewports to prevent asymmetric diffraction fringes.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: CMOS camera sensor replacements and 20x long-working-distance infinity-corrected objectives for Karl Suss MA6 platforms face long lead times and vendor lock-in. Domestic Vietnam sourcing must maintain dual-source inventory for micro-aperture calibration reticles, optical stage micrometers, and precision air-bearing regulators.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibration cycles directly bottleneck pilot line throughput if split-field reticle registration exceeds 15 minutes per batch. Standard operating procedures must balance full daily optical re-calibrations with rapid 3-point shift-check routines to maintain baseline fab cadence without sacrificing alignment reproducibility.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. WEC spherical air-bearing clamp slippage causing physical mask-to-wafer collision during proximity gap descent, resulting in catastrophic quartz mask cracking and wafer surface scratching.
1. Split-field optical axis misalignment between left and right CMOS channels leading to systematic rotational theta-errors (>1.5 um vector offset across 100mm field) on overlay verniers.
1. Fresnel diffraction ring distortion due to uncalibrated non-parallel gap (>3 um wedge tilt), leading to severe resist line blooming and bridging at active area boundary structures.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-01` | **Split-Field Optical Objective Parfocality and Telecentric Magnification Calibration** | NIST-traceable Dual-Axis Optical Stage Micrometer (10 um grid, 0.1 um accuracy), Karl Suss MA6 Split-Field Dual CMOS Vision System, Digital Image Analysis Engine. | 1. Position certified stage micrometer under split-field left and right optical objectives at 5x magnification. 2. Focus left and right cameras to maximum MTF contrast and zero digital vernier coordinates. 3. Turret-switch objectives to 10x, then 20x magnification without adjusting Z-height manual focus; record focal contrast shift. 4. Measure optical cross-hair pixel-to-micrometer calibration factor across a 1000 um span in X and Y axes on both channels. 5. Calculate parcentricity offset (center shift) and parfocal delta Z. | `Parfocal Z-axis focus shift <= 1.5 um across 5x to 20x transition; magnification scale error <= 0.20% across 1000 um; left-to-right optical channel magnification mismatch <= 0.10%.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-02` | **Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) Parallelism and Proximity Air Gap Verification** | Karl Suss MA6 Multi-Point Capacitive Gap Sensor Chuck, Non-contact Optical Spectral Reflectometer / Laser Interferometric Gap Gauge, 100mm Polished Monitor Wafer. | 1. Load 100mm bare silicon monitor wafer on WEC chuck. 2. Initiate automatic WEC leveling cycle to float spherical bearing until wafer contacts quartz blank at 0.2 bar contact force; clamp spherical air bearing. 3. Command optical gap drive to retract chuck to programmed 20.0 um proximity gap setting. 4. Measure absolute physical gap at center and 4 orthogonal peripheral points (R = 40 mm, 0 deg, 90 deg, 180 deg, 270 deg) using calibrated interferometric sensor. 5. Calculate total wedge thickness variation and mean proximity offset. | `Parallelism error (wedge delta across 100mm field) <= 1.0 um; absolute proximity gap at all 5 points within 20.0 um +/- 1.0 um; repeat gap error <= 0.3 um over 5 consecutive cycles.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 1000 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-blocking safety glasses (absorbance > 99.9% at 200-450 nm), Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive shoe covers, Lint-free cleanroom hood and face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA: Remove contaminated gloves/clothing immediately and flush skin with copiously flowing clean deionized water for 15 minutes. Eye exposure: Irrigate eyes immediately at plumbed eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Accidental high-intensity UV exposure: Evacuate immediately, seek ophthalmic evaluation for photokeratitis. N2 asphyxiation risk: Move affected personnel to fresh air immediately; administer CPR/oxygen if breathing ceases.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Lithography wet bay dedicated point-of-use laminar downdraft exhaust operating at face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); continuous ambient O2 deficiency monitoring (< 19.5% alarm threshold) for high-flow N2 pneumatic purge lines.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and IPA residues must be collected in closed, dedicated antistatic hazardous solvent waste cans with grounded conductive liners; dispose of via licensed flammables incineration protocols; zero drain disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (Grade 5.0) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Split-Field Dual CMOS Microscope Optical Alignment & Calibration

- **System / Area**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment > Metrology
- **Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Action Type**: Make / Calibrate

---

### Optical Alignment & Calibration Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│          Split-Field Microscope Setup        │
│    (5x / 10x / 20x Objectives & Dual CMOS)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│      Objective Parfocality & Parcentricity   │
│         (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25)         │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│         CMOS Pixel Scale Calibration         │
│     (Sub-micron Stage Micrometer Grid)       │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│      WEC Chuck Parallelism & Gap Baseline    │
│    (< 1 µm Parallelism / 10-30 µm Air Gap)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

#### 1. Dual-Objective Optical Turret & Illumination Setup
1. Configure the split-field binocular optical head with matched objective pairs (**5x**, **10x Plan Achromat NA 0.25**, and **20x**).
2. Align dual high-resolution CMOS digital cameras onto the left and right optical ports.
3. Power on the coaxial/fiber-optic illumination and adjust left and right field brightness to equal digital intensity (within $\pm 5\%$) across both CMOS sensor feeds.

#### 2. Parfocality & Parcentricity Alignment
1. Mount a calibrated crosshair stage micrometer target onto the vacuum chuck.
2. Focus the left objective channel at **5x** magnification, center the fiducial reticle on the digital display crosshair, then switch to **10x** and **20x**.
3. Adjust mechanical collar shims or parfocal tube focus until switching from 5x $\rightarrow$ 10x $\rightarrow$ 20x maintains sharp optical focus without requiring manual Z-stage displacement.
4. Repeat parcentricity alignment for the right objective channel, ensuring both optical centerlines are parallel across the split-field span.

#### 3. CMOS Pixel Scaling & Electronic Crosshair Calibration
1. Calibrate pixel-to-micron aspect scaling on both digital feeds using the stage micrometer target.
2. Verify that horizontal and vertical digital reticle markings align precisely with stage micrometers across the active field of view.
3. Lock the camera C-mount rotators to ensure zero angular tilt between left and right sensor matrices.

#### 4. Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) Parallelism & Gap Baseline
1. Place a reference 100mm test substrate onto the leveling chuck.
2. Engage the spherical air bearing Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) system to mechanically level the wafer chuck against the mask holder.
3. Confirm mechanical parallelism across the 100mm area is **$< 1\ \mu\text{m}$**.
4. Set the calibrated air gap baseline for proximity alignment within **$10\ \mu\text{m}$ to $30\ \mu\text{m}$**.
5. Verify alignment overlay repeatability across both split-field views to confirm target alignment tolerances within **$\pm 2\ \mu\text{m}$ to $5\ \mu\text{m}$** (proximity mode) and down to **$\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$** (vacuum contact mode).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Measurement Method | Verification Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **WEC Chuck Parallelism** | **$< 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$** across 100mm substrate | Spherical air-bearing WEC sensor feedback | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Proximity Mode Overlay Alignment** | **$\pm 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$ to $5.0\ \mu\text{m}$** | Dual CMOS split-field overlay metrology | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Vacuum Contact Overlay Precision** | **$\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$** | Dual CMOS high-magnification overlay verification | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Calibrated Proximity Air Gap** | **$10.0\ \mu\text{m}$ to $30.0\ \mu\text{m}$** | Z-axis optical micrometer / gap sensor | $\mu\text{m}$ |

---

### Context Citations
1. **Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Standard Operating Procedure & Gap Control**:
   - Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) achieves parallelism $< 1\ \mu\text{m}$ across 100mm wafers via spherical air bearings.
   - Split-field microscope configuration utilizes 5x, 10x, and 20x objectives paired with dual CMOS cameras.
   - Operator overlay alignment precision of $\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$ in vacuum contact mode, and $\pm 2$ to $5\ \mu\text{m}$ in proximity mode.
   - Proximity mode calibrated air gap of $10\ \mu\text{m}$ to $30\ \mu\text{m}$.
2. **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**:
   - Split-field binocular microscope architecture with dual CMOS cameras for dual-reticle mask/wafer viewing.
3. **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
   - 10x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25) resolution baseline.
   - Gen 2 micron-scale overlay alignment tolerance reaching $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-objective split-field optical heads must maintain absolute mechanical co-planarity and parfocal registration during independent X/Y travel across the mask holder. Any differential thermal expansion between the left and right optical trains or structural compliance in the motorized lead screws will manifest as virtual overlay shift, invalidating sub-micron alignment in vacuum contact mode.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm Gen 2 DRAM lithography alignment targets, optical distortion and chromatic aberration across 5x, 10x, and 20x objectives must be calibrated against a NIST-traceable grid. The dual CMOS sensor arrays must be precisely mapped for pixel-aspect-ratio orthoplanarity, ensuring that operator reticle-to-wafer vernier alignment does not introduce >0.25 µm systematic runout across a 100mm substrate.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom telecentric long-working-distance infinity-corrected objectives and matched global-shutter CMOS sensors face extended lead times and single-supplier vulnerability. We must standardize on standard C-mount optical tubes and off-the-shelf high-quantum-efficiency Sony Pregius CMOS sensors to avoid custom optomechanical assembly lock-in.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibration and parfocality verification procedures must not bottleneck daily yellow-room throughput. The dual-camera optical alignment protocol must execute in under 15 minutes per shift, using an automated fiducial pattern recognition routine rather than relying purely on subjective operator manual vernier alignment.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal drift of optical mounting bridge causing differential optical axis tilt (>0.15 mrad), leading to parallax error between mask and wafer planes during proximity gap indexing.
1. Parfocality mismatch between left and right objective turrets during magnification switching (5x to 20x), causing loss of focus on alignment marks and operator-induced reticle collision.
1. CMOS sensor pixel grid rotation or optical distortion exceeding 0.35 µm at field edge, introducing false asymmetric overlay errors during split-field vernier registration.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-1-01` | **Dual-Field Parfocality and Optical Axis Co-axiality Verification** | NIST-traceable 100mm chrome-on-quartz grid target (10 µm pitch, +/-0.05 µm accuracy), optical rail autocollimator, dual 5MP CMOS beam profiler/microscope cameras. | 1. Mount the NIST calibration grid onto the mask stage and engage vacuum clamping at -80 kPa. 2. Position left and right objectives over dual calibration crosses separated by 60 mm. 3. Focus left optical train at 20x magnification to maximize image contrast (MTF50 peak) on chrome edges. 4. Switch both turrets sequentially from 5x to 10x to 20x without adjusting Z-stage micrometer. 5. Measure focal shift (Delta Z) and lateral centroid displacement (Delta X, Delta Y) for both optical channels using automated sub-pixel edge detection software. | `Parfocal Z-focus variation across turret switch Delta Z <= 2.0 µm; lateral parcentricity displacement Delta X, Delta Y <= 0.35 µm across 5x to 20x transition for both left and right optical channels.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-1-02` | **CMOS Sensor Pixel Scale Calibration and Geometric Distortion Mapping** | Standard quartz distortion test reticle with 10x10 dot matrix array (50 µm pitch), calibrated laser vibrometer/encoder stage. | 1. Position quartz dot matrix reticle in the field of view of the left CMOS camera at 20x magnification. 2. Capture 10 successive frames and perform 16-point sub-pixel centroid analysis of all dot fiducials. 3. Compute pixel-to-micron calibration scale factor in horizontal (Sx) and vertical (Sy) axes. 4. Translate stage by 500.0 µm using calibrated encoder to verify stage-to-pixel linearity. 5. Repeat procedure for the right CMOS camera channel. 6. Calculate Seidel barrel/pincushion distortion coefficient across the diagonal field of view. | `Pixel scale calibration factor Sx/Sy ratio within 1.000 +/- 0.001; absolute scale accuracy <= 0.05 µm over 500 µm translation; optical field distortion <= 0.20% across full 1.2 mm diagonal field of view.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 / ISO 5 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, accelerator-free), UV-absorbing polycarbonate safety glasses (optical density >= 4 at 365-405 nm), Conductive ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Lint-free cleanroom frock and head cover
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of eye contact with cleaning solvents, flush immediately with copious sterile eyewash for at least 15 minutes. For vapor inhalation, move personnel to outdoor fresh air. For UV light exposure to eyes, cover eyes with sterile dressing and obtain immediate ophthalmological evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Local exhaust ventilation hood with face velocity of 0.5 m/s for solvent wipe operations. Lithography bay laminar downflow velocity 0.45 m/s (+/-0.05 m/s) with ULPA filtration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent-soaked wipes in dedicated sealed, conductive, grounded stainless-steel flammable waste bins. Liquid solvent residue disposed into designated Hazardous Solvent Waste Stream (Carboy A: Halogen-free organic solvents).

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Cleanroom Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Piranha-cleaned quartz calibration reticle (organic-free, particle count < 5 at >= 0.3 µm) and clean mechanical stage chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Calibrated optomechanical split-field head locked with torque-sealed stage micrometers; quartz reticle solvent-cleaned and returned to purged storage pod.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding queue time results in airborne hydrocarbon adsorption and dust agglomeration on optical targets, inducing autofocus contrast degradation and >0.4 µm false optical vernier offsets.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Dual-objective CMOS split-field microscope system optically aligned, parfocal across 5x, 10x, and 20x magnifications, with calibrated optical distortion and sub-pixel scale factors validated for Gen 2 DRAM lithography alignment.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `split_field_optical_calibration_report.pdf`
- [ ] `cmos_distortion_and_pixel_scale_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `objective_parfocality_verification_raw.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Left and right objective optical parcentricity error during magnification switch from 5x to 20x** | `0.20` | <= 0.35 um | High-resolution centroid tracking on NIST chrome-grid reticle under 20x objective |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Calibrated CMOS camera pixel-to-micrometer scale orthogonality across 1.0 mm field** | `1.0000` | +/- 0.0015 | 2D Fourier spatial transform and dot-matrix grid pitch regression analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Both optical channels achieve <= 0.35 µm parcentricity, optical axis tilt < 0.10 mrad, and automated calibration script confirms overlay measurement repeatability standard deviation (3-sigma) <= 0.15 µm over 30 consecutive alignment target captures.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dual CMOS Camera & Split-Field Optomechanical Sourcing and Assembly

- **Node Path**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment > Split-Field Optical System Calibration & Proximity Gap Setting > Split-Field Dual CMOS Microscope Optical Alignment & Calibration > Dual CMOS Camera & Split-Field Optomechanical Sourcing and Assembly
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Status**: Production Ready

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Optomechanical Rail  │
│   & Mount Sourcing    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Dual 10x Plan     │
│  Achromat Objective   │
│       Mounting        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Dual CMOS Sensor    │
│  Alignment & Spacing  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Optical Split-Field  │
│       Crosshair       │
│      Calibration      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Fiducial Mark     │
│  Resolution & ±5 µm   │
│     Verification      │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Optomechanical Rail & Base Sourcing**:
   - Procure and inspect an optical breadboard/rail system along with two independent coarse/fine linear stages for dual-axis positioning across the wafer surface.
   - Assemble the mounting brackets to support split-field binocular optical viewing of left and right alignment sites across the wafer and chromium-on-quartz mask.

2. **Objective Lens Integration**:
   - Thread and mount two matched **10x Plan Achromat objectives (Numerical Aperture / NA 0.25)** onto the respective left and right optical assembly arms.
   - Lock lens barrels into anti-backlash collets to preserve micron-scale feature resolution.

3. **Dual CMOS Camera Mount & Sensor Co-Planarity**:
   - Fasten two high-resolution industrial CMOS sensor cameras to the optical tube mounts via standard C-mount adapters.
   - Adjust sensor rotation until both camera raster planes are co-linear and orthogonal to the mask-stage travel axes.

4. **Split-Field Optical Alignment & Interpupillary Spacing**:
   - Align both optical channels simultaneously across the wafer and mask split-field binocular microscope assembly.
   - Adjust the lateral spacing between left and right objectives to match the spacing of the mask and wafer crosshair alignment marks.

5. **Crosshair Fiducial & Gap Calibration**:
   - Focus both channels on the top surface of the wafer and bottom chrome pattern of the quartz mask.
   - Confirm optical parfocality across both cameras when inspecting alignment through contact or proximity gap separation (10 to 20 µm).
   - Calibrate electronic crosshair overlays to digital fiducials to verify registration within the Gen 2 alignment target.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │████████                           │
Proximity Gap (Max)┤████████                           │
                   │▓▓▓▓                               │
Proximity Gap (Min)┤▓▓▓▓                               │
   Gen 2 Target Tol┤▒▒▒                                │
                   │▒▒▒                                │
Gen 1 Alignment Tol┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                   │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                    0       25      50       75     100 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Objective Optical Aperture** | `0.25` | NA (dimensionless) | Manufacturer optical spec verification on 10x Plan Achromat lenses |
| **Gen 2 Optical Alignment Tolerance** | `±5` | µm | Digital crosshair overlay readout across left/right fiducial marks |
| **Proximity Working Gap Range** | `10 to 20` | µm | Differential micrometer / piezo stage displacement measurement |
| **Diffraction Proximity Resolution Limit** | `~2 to 3` | µm | Resolvable line/space grating target on test substrate |

---

### Literature Citations

1. **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**:
   - Split-field binocular microscope viewing configuration with dual CMOS cameras for wafer and mask alignment.
   - Proximity mode air gap maintained at **10 to 20 µm** yielding resolution of **~2–3 µm**.
   - Crosshair fiducial alignment marks on mask and substrate.
2. **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
   - Sourcing of modified **10x Plan Achromat objectives (NA 0.25)** for micron-scale feature resolution.
   - Transition of alignment tolerances from Gen 1 (**±100 µm**) down to Gen 2 (**±5 µm**).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual CMOS split-field microscope assembly must maintain rigid optomechanical co-axiality and thermal stability across the two separate optical branches. Asymmetric mechanical deflection or differential thermal expansion between the left and right objective arms directly translates into false relative overlay offsets during wafer-to-mask alignment, destroying the sub-micron overlay budget required for contact lithography.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Operating in split-field mode requires optical parcentricity and parfocality across 5x, 10x, and 20x objectives with matched optical distortion under 0.1% across both fields of view. Optical alignment markings must be resolved with high contrast across varied thin-film stacks without chromatic aberration causing apparent fiducial shifts under monochromatic yellow cleanroom lighting.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procurement of matched industrial C-mount CMOS global-shutter sensor heads with consistent pixel pitch, along with precision dovetail or cross-roller split-field translation stages, introduces dual-sourcing vulnerabilities. Substitution of consumer-grade rolling shutter cameras or uncalibrated objective revolvers will cause frame distortion and non-reproducible optical pitch.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The optomechanical procurement and assembly must synchronize with the baseline Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) and proximity gap calibration integration schedule; unverified camera firmware or mechanical interference with the UV lamp house assembly will stall subsequent mask aligner qualification.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal drift and differential flexure between dual optical pods causing dynamic split-field registration error exceeding 0.5 um over an 8-hour operation cycle.
1. Parfocality mismatch between left and right CMOS cameras resulting in depth-of-field blur on either the mask fiducial or wafer alignment target during proximity gap setting.
1. Vibrational jitter coupling from cleanroom air handler or vacuum chuck solenoids into camera cantilever mounts, degrading image MTF below fiducial edge-detection threshold.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-1-1-01` | **Dual Camera Field-of-View Parcentricity and Magnification Matching** | Certified chrome-on-quartz dual-grid optical micrometer calibration standard (10 um pitch, +/- 0.05 um accuracy), Split-Field Microscope Assembly with dual CMOS cameras, Sub-pixel edge detection calibration software. | 1. Mount certified dual-grid quartz calibration reticle under split-field objectives. 2. Adjust inter-objective separation to nominal 50.0 mm span. 3. Acquire 50 synchronous image pairs (Left CMOS and Right CMOS) at 20x magnification. 4. Compute pixel scale (um/pixel), field rotation angle, and barrel/pincushion optical distortion across each sensor active area. 5. Measure center-to-center coordinate offset between left and right optical channels. | `Pixel scaling difference between left and right channels must be <= 0.15%; Optical rotation angle difference <= 0.05 degrees; Optical distortion across full FOV <= 0.10%.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-1-1-02` | **Optomechanical Thermal Drift and Co-axial Stability Verification** | Thermally stabilized target plate with high-contrast etched chromium vernier fiducials, dual high-speed CMOS vision capture system, dual-axis differential capacitive displacement sensors, temperature datalogger. | 1. Focus both left and right cameras onto stationary chrome fiducials at 20x magnification. 2. Zero digital overlay coordinates using cross-correlation centroid tracking. 3. Monitor and record positional coordinates of left and right fiducial centroids continuously at 1 Hz for 4 hours. 4. Simultaneously record optical housing temperatures at objective mount and camera flange. 5. Calculate cumulative relative X-Y drift vector between the dual channels. | `Maximum relative lateral drift (Delta X, Delta Y) between left and right optical channels must not exceed 0.25 um over the 4-hour monitoring duration.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (Class 100 compatible), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and chemical splash safety glasses, Lint-free antistatic cleanroom frock and ESD wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact, flush with copius deionized water for 15 minutes. For eye contact, immediately flush eyes at eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. If inhaled, move personnel to fresh air. If irritation persists, seek medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Perform solvent optical cleaning strictly inside certified laminar flow hood with local exhaust ventilation maintaining minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent-soaked cleanroom optical wipes in designated flammable solvent waste bin; segregate liquid solvent waste in grounded, marked safety containers for hazardous chemical disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / MOS) | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / MOS) | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Solvent-degreased, dry, particle-inspected optical lenses and CMOS sensor protective cover glasses with zero organic contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Assembled and hermetically sealed split-field optomechanical pod, purged with dry filtered N2, optical surfaces particle-free (ISO Class 4).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excess ambient air exposure causes airborne hydrocarbon and particle deposition on unsealed objective lenses and CMOS cover glasses, causing irreversible focal flare and fiducial edge contrast loss.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Dual CMOS camera and split-field optomechanical assembly procured, mechanically assembled, optically centered, and verified with sub-pixel overlay calibration conforming to Gen 2 (micrometer) photolithography alignment requirements.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `split_field_camera_alignment_report.pdf`
- [ ] `dual_cmos_magnification_distortion_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `fiducial_edge_contrast_calibration_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Magnification and pixel pitch parity between Left and Right CMOS channels** | `1.000` | +/- 0.0015 | Dual-grid chrome reticle sub-pixel edge detection measurement across 50 synchronous frames |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Split-field dual-branch relative positional drift under continuous operational thermal load** | `0.10 um` | <= 0.25 um over 4 hours | Time-resolved cross-correlation centroid tracking of stationary quartz grid verniers at 20x |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful zero-backlash mechanical motion across full 20 mm to 100 mm split-field span, simultaneous resolution of 0.5 um chrome lines across both cameras, and formal signoff of optical distortion and drift validation by Metrology Lead.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dual-Channel Parfocality Tuning & Optical Magnification Calibration

**Module:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment > Split-Field Optical System Calibration & Proximity Gap Setting > Split-Field Dual CMOS Microscope Optical Alignment & Calibration > Dual-Channel Parfocality Tuning & Optical Magnification Calibration`  
**Target Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu$m)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Calibration  

---

### 1. Calibration Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Mount Stage       │
│    Micrometer Grid     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Channel A Focus &    │
│     Optical Center     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Channel B        │
│  Parfocality Shimming  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Dual Pixel-Pitch    │
│     Magnification      │
│        Matching        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Validation across    │
│    Gen 2 Alignment     │
│         Window         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Test Standard Setup & Substrate Loading:**
   - Mount a certified glass chrome stage micrometer target onto the macroscopic alignment vacuum chuck.
   - Position both optical split-field microscope channels equipped with matched **10x Plan Achromat objectives (Numerical Aperture $\text{NA} = 0.25$)** over the left and right split-field alignment viewing zones.
2. **Channel A Reference Focus & Center Lock:**
   - Turn on coaxial illumination for the split-field binocular microscope.
   - Adjust the primary macroscopic Z-axis micrometer drive to bring Channel A (Left CMOS camera) into maximum edge-contrast focus against the micrometer reticle.
   - Lock the macroscopic stage Z-axis position.
3. **Channel B Parfocality Adjustment & Independent Z-Compensation:**
   - Switch live video feed to Channel B (Right CMOS camera) without altering the main stage Z-drive.
   - Adjust the independent optical tube axial barrel / micro-shimming ring on Channel B until the reticle reaches peak image sharpness and modulation transfer function (MTF) contrast.
   - Verify that switching live views between Channel A and Channel B reveals simultaneous in-focus targets without stage refocusing.
4. **Dual-Channel Optical Magnification Calibration:**
   - Acquire a horizontal line profile across known pitch grid lines on Channel A. Calculate pixel scaling factor:
     $$\text{Scale}_A = \frac{\text{Known Reticle Distance}}{\text{Measured Pixels}}$$
   - Acquire the identical reticle target under Channel B and determine $\text{Scale}_B$.
   - Fine-tune optical zoom / tube focal distance shims until the magnification ratio error between Channel A and Channel B is nulled within calibration tolerance.
5. **Gen 2 Dual-View Crosshair Registration:**
   - Overlay digital alignment reticles on both CMOS camera outputs.
   - Translate the stage along the X/Y axes across a known baseline to verify tracking coincidence between channels across the required Gen 2 alignment window.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │█                                      │
   Mag Mismatch┤█                                      │
               │▓▓                                     │
Parfocality Dev┤▓▓                                     │
   Gen 2 Target┤▒▒▒                                    │
               │▒▒▒                                    │
   Gen 1 Window┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
                0        25       50        75      100 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Optical Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\le \pm 5.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Metrology Stage Vernier / Reticle Reading |
| **Channel-to-Channel Parfocality Focus Offset ($\Delta Z$)** | $\le 2.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Depth of Focus Contrast Profile (NA 0.25) |
| **Objective Optical Configuration** | $10\times\text{ Plan Achromat, } \text{NA} = 0.25$ | — (Magnification / NA) | Physical Lens Inspection |
| **Magnification Matching Discrepancy** | $\le 0.5$ | $\%$ | Cross-channel pixel pitch calculation |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose:**
  - *“wafer and mask viewed through split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras.”* — Establishes the binocular dual-CMOS split-field viewing architecture.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
  - *“Using a modified microscope objective (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) allows micron-scale feature resolution.”* — Direct basis for objective specification and optical resolution limit.
  - *“Alignment tolerance at Gen 1 is ±100 microns (0.1 mm), improving to ±5 microns in Gen 2.”* — Direct basis for Gen 2 alignment tolerance limit of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual CMOS split-field alignment requires rigid kinematic coupling between both optical barrels; differential thermal expansion between independent aluminum tube mounts can introduce >2 µm focal plane drift across a 30-minute alignment session, destabilizing parfocality between the left and right fiducial branches.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Calibrating 10x Plan Achromat objectives (NA 0.25) across dual split-field channels requires rigorous depth of focus (DoF ~ 8.8 µm at 550 nm illumination) matching; any telecentricity error or magnification mismatch exceeding 0.1% induces asymmetric vernier parallax, compromising Gen 2 contact/proximity overlay accuracy below the required ±5 µm baseline.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Certified quartz stage micrometers with 10 µm pitch chrome gratings traceable to NPL/NIST have lead times of 8-12 weeks; low-cost soda-lime glass alternatives suffer thermal drift (CTE ~8.5x10^-6/K vs quartz 0.5x10^-6/K), making local sourcing of high-precision calibration targets a critical bottleneck for Vietnamese academic fab infrastructure.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-channel calibration must be executable within a standard 20-minute pre-exposure shift checklist; relying on manual shimming or unindexed fine-focus screw verniers without automated image-contrast feedback (e.g. Laplacian variance) introduces operator-dependent variance and delays wafer throughput.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Differential focal plane offset exceeding depth of focus (Delta-Z > 4 µm), causing one alignment mark to defocus during simultaneous split-field exposure.
1. Magnification asymmetry (> 0.2%) between Channel A and Channel B resulting in systematic scale error across the 100 mm wafer diameter.
1. Optical axis angular tilt causing trapezoidal distortion (keystone effect) on CMOS image sensors, falsifying rotational theta alignment.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-1-2-01` | **Dual-Channel Parfocality & Focal Plane Coplanarity Verification** | Dual 10x Plan Achromat (NA 0.25) CMOS split-field microscope, calibrated piezoelectric Z-stage (0.05 µm resolution), dual chrome-on-quartz dot grid target. | 1. Position quartz dot-grid target under Channel A and Channel B split-field viewing zones. 2. Sweep Z-piezo from -15 µm to +15 µm in 0.25 µm steps while acquiring simultaneous image frames on both CMOS cameras. 3. Compute normalized Brenner/Tenengrad contrast gradient curve vs Z-position for both channels. 4. Determine peak focus Z-coordinate (Z_optA and Z_optB). 5. Calculate focal offset Delta-Z = |Z_optA - Z_optB|. | `Delta-Z <= 1.50 µm (within 20% of objective nominal DoF), and contrast retention > 90% at common focal plane Z_mid.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-1-2-02` | **Optical Magnification Ratio Calibration & Pixel-Pitch Scaling** | Dual-channel split-field CMOS sensor array, calibrated 10 µm pitch NIST-traceable chrome-on-quartz stage micrometer (100 divisions, 1 mm total). | 1. Align quartz micrometer grating horizontally across Channel A field of view; capture 30 averaged frames. 2. Measure pixel distance across 50 grating pitches (500 µm nominal) using sub-pixel edge detection (Gaussian fit on line spread function). 3. Calculate effective magnification Mag_A = (Pixel_Count * Sensor_Pixel_Pitch) / 500 µm. 4. Translate micrometer to Channel B field of view and repeat measurements to compute Mag_B. 5. Compute relative magnification ratio Delta_Mag = |Mag_A - Mag_B| / Mag_avg. | `Magnification mismatch Delta_Mag <= 0.10%, and absolute calibrated scale = 1.000 ± 0.005 µm/pixel on both sensors.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/optical laser safety glasses, ESD-safe cleanroom smock and grounded wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Rinse immediately with copious DI water for 15 minutes. Eye exposure: Flush eyes at eyewash station for 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh cleanroom air supply.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Perform solvent optical wipe-down inside dedicated laminar flow chemical hood with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); exhausted to VOC scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent cleaning wipes and swabs sealed into dedicated antistatic solvent waste containers; segregate flammable organic solvents from oxidizing waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |

critics.systems_engineer: Dual CMOS split-field alignment requires rigid kinematic coupling between both optical barrels; differential thermal expansion between independent aluminum tube mounts can introduce >2 µm focal plane drift across a 30-minute alignment session, destabilizing parfocality between the left and right fiducial branches.
critics.domain_expert: Calibrating 10x Plan Achromat objectives (NA 0.25) across dual split-field channels requires rigorous depth of focus (DoF ~ 8.8 µm at 550 nm illumination) matching; any telecentricity error or magnification mismatch exceeding 0.1% induces asymmetric vernier parallax, compromising Gen 2 contact/proximity overlay accuracy below the required ±5 µm baseline.
critics.supply_chain: Certified quartz stage micrometers with 10 µm pitch chrome gratings traceable to NPL/NIST have lead times of 8-12 weeks; low-cost soda-lime glass alternatives suffer thermal drift (CTE ~8.5x10^-6/K vs quartz 0.5x10^-6/K), making local sourcing of high-precision calibration targets a critical bottleneck for Vietnamese academic fab infrastructure.
critics.laya_pm: Dual-channel calibration must be executable within a standard 20-minute pre-exposure shift checklist; relying on manual shimming or unindexed fine-focus screw verniers without automated image-contrast feedback (e.g. Laplacian variance) introduces operator-dependent variance and delays wafer throughput.
critical_failure_modes: Differential focal plane offset exceeding depth of focus (Delta-Z > 4 µm), causing one alignment mark to defocus during simultaneous split-field exposure.
Magnification asymmetry (> 0.2%) between Channel A and Channel B resulting in systematic scale error across the 100 mm wafer diameter.
Optical axis angular tilt causing trapezoidal distortion (keystone effect) on CMOS image sensors, falsifying rotational theta alignment.

testcases.instrumentation: Dual 10x Plan Achromat (NA 0.25) CMOS split-field microscope, calibrated piezoelectric Z-stage (0.05 µm resolution), dual chrome-on-quartz dot grid target.
testcases.pre_conditions: Optomechanical chassis stabilized on pneumatic vibration table for >= 60 min at 20.0 ± 0.5 °C; optical illumination centered at 530 nm green LED.
testcases.procedure: 1. Position quartz dot-grid target under Channel A and Channel B split-field viewing zones. 2. Sweep Z-piezo from -15 µm to +15 µm in 0.25 µm steps while acquiring simultaneous image frames on both CMOS cameras. 3. Compute normalized Brenner/Tenengrad contrast gradient curve vs Z-position for both channels. 4. Determine peak focus Z-coordinate (Z_optA and Z_optB). 5. Calculate focal offset Delta-Z = |Z_optA - Z_optB|.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Delta-Z <= 1.50 µm (within 20% of objective nominal DoF), and contrast retention > 90% at common focal plane Z_mid.

testcases.title: Optical Magnification Ratio Calibration & Pixel-Pitch Scaling
testcases.instrumentation: Dual-channel split-field CMOS sensor array, calibrated 10 µm pitch NIST-traceable chrome-on-quartz stage micrometer (100 divisions, 1 mm total).
testcases.pre_conditions: Both optical channels locked at verified common parfocal plane; digital exposure adjusted to 70% saturation without pixel clipping.
testcases.procedure: 1. Align quartz micrometer grating horizontally across Channel A field of view; capture 30 averaged frames. 2. Measure pixel distance across 50 grating pitches (500 µm nominal) using sub-pixel edge detection (Gaussian fit on line spread function). 3. Calculate effective magnification Mag_A = (Pixel_Count * Sensor_Pixel_Pitch) / 500 µm. 4. Translate micrometer to Channel B field of view and repeat measurements to compute Mag_B. 5. Compute relative magnification ratio Delta_Mag = |Mag_A - Mag_B| / Mag_avg.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Magnification mismatch Delta_Mag <= 0.10%, and absolute calibrated scale = 1.000 ± 0.005 µm/pixel on both sensors.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Mask-to-Wafer Split-Field Fiducial Registration & Overlay Verification

- **Task Code / Level**: Metrology Leaf SOP (`Make`)
- **Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Process Line**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip — Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment

---

### 1. Objective & Principle
Achieve precise physical alignment and registration between crosshair fiducial marks on a chromium-on-quartz photomask and previous-layer fiducial marks on a photoresist-coated wafer (Shipley 1813, $\sim 1.3\,\mu\text{m}$ thickness). Dual CMOS cameras attached to a split-field binocular microscope simultaneously image left and right alignment marks to establish $X$, $Y$, and $\theta$ (rotational) registration within Gen 2 tolerances before UV exposure.

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Materials
- Split-field binocular microscope equipped with dual CMOS cameras and $10\times$ Plan Achromat objectives ($\text{NA } 0.25$).
- Macroscopic $X$-$Y$-$\theta$ wafer chuck alignment stage with high-precision differential micrometers / closed-loop piezo actuators ($0.1\,\mu\text{m}$ sensitivity).
- Chromium-on-quartz mask with crosshair fiducial marks.
- Pre-baked wafer: Shipley 1813 spin-coated at 4000 RPM ($\sim 1.3\,\mu\text{m}$ thickness), soft-baked at $115^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 seconds on a flat aluminum hot plate.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Substrate & Mask Loading into Alignment Stage       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: Gap Setting via Micrometers / Piezo Actuators       |
|         (10 to 20 um Proximity Air Gap)                     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Split-Field Dual CMOS Live Imaging & Calibration    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: Fiducial Mark Alignment (X, Y, Theta Coarse/Fine)   |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 5: Overlay Verification & Final Printing Mode Lock     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Substrate & Mask Loading**:
   - Secure the chromium-on-quartz mask into the vacuum holder facing downward toward the wafer stage.
   - Load the coated wafer (Shipley 1813, soft-baked at $115^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 s) onto the vacuum chuck beneath the mask.

2. **Proximity Gap Setting**:
   - Using the three high-precision differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators ($0.1\,\mu\text{m}$ sensitivity), establish a uniform proximity air gap of $10\text{ to }20\,\mu\text{m}$ between the mask chrome surface and the photoresist layer.
   - *Note*: Maintaining this gap during alignment prevents photoresist abrasion and contact-induced mask scratch defects.

3. **Split-Field Optical Focus & Dual CMOS Setup**:
   - Adjust split-field dual CMOS microscope cameras with $10\times$ Plan Achromat objectives ($\text{NA } 0.25$).
   - Focus simultaneously on the mask crosshair fiducial marks and the underlying wafer fiducial marks across both split fields (left and right channels).

4. **Fiducial Mark Registration ($X, Y, \theta$)**:
   - Manipulate the fine $X$ and $Y$ micrometers and the $\theta$ (rotational) control on the alignment stage.
   - Align the wafer alignment crosshairs to superimpose concentrically over the mask fiducial crosshairs on both split-field camera channels.

5. **Overlay Verification & Mode Lock**:
   - Verify digital pixel overlay error across both split fields. Ensure rotational mismatch across the field distance is resolved.
   - For **Contact Printing** ($< 1\,\mu\text{m}$ resolution target): Bring the stage upward to close the gap into direct contact with photoresist prior to UV exposure.
   - For **Proximity Printing** ($2\text{--}3\,\mu\text{m}$ resolution target): Lock the $10\text{ to }20\,\mu\text{m}$ gap to prevent contact damage.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gen 2 Alignment / Overlay Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Dual CMOS camera pixel overlay / metrology measurement |
| **Proximity Alignment Air Gap** | $10 \text{ to } 20$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Differential micrometers / closed-loop piezo feedback |
| **Z-Gap Actuator Sensitivity / Step** | $0.1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Closed-loop piezo / differential micrometer dial |
| **Photoresist Film Thickness Pre-Check** | $\sim 1.3$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Stylus profilometer / optical reflectometer (post-4000 RPM spin) |

---

### 5. Context & Source Citations
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**: Split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras; proximity air gap of $10\text{ to }20\,\mu\text{m}$; closed-loop piezo actuators / differential micrometers with $0.1\,\mu\text{m}$ sensitivity; contact resolution ($< 1\,\mu\text{m}$) vs. proximity resolution ($2\text{--}3\,\mu\text{m}$).
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**: Gen 2 alignment tolerance limit of $\pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$; modified microscope objective ($10\times$ Plan Achromat, $\text{NA } 0.25$); Shipley 1813 spin-coated at 4000 RPM yielding $\sim 1.3\,\mu\text{m}$ thickness soft-baked at $115^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 seconds.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual CMOS split-field alignment on 100mm wafers requires rigid optical-mechanical decoupling between the Karl Suss MA6 microscope arm and the pneumatic stage. Any mechanical backlash or thermal drift in the split-field translation lead screws directly injects differential X/Y magnification distortion between left and right fiducials, deteriorating overlay vector field consistency across die perimeters.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm DRAM node proxy lithography (Gen 2 µm testbed), non-telecentric illumination and residual wedge error (> 1 µm) induce optical parallax during gap switching from alignment separation (20-30 µm) to exposure contact mode (vacuum contact). Box-in-box fiducials must use optical verniers or diffraction-tolerant cross-in-frame targets to prevent false centerline registration caused by asymmetric photoresist edge bead reflections.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard Karl Suss 5-inch quartz mask tooling and vacuum chuck assemblies must be sourced with matched thermal expansion coefficients. Long lead-time quartz blanks (low-expansion synthetic silica) and specialized alignment target sets require dual-sourcing across regional optical mask shops to mitigate critical path stoppages in academic cleanroom pilot runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Overlay registration verification gates the entire active-area (AA) to shallow-trench isolation (STI) sequence. Operator fatigue during manual split-field joystick vernier alignment causes wide run-to-run cycle variance; automated image-processing cross-correlation sign-off must be deployed to keep alignment takt time under 90 seconds per wafer.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parallax runout error exceeding 0.75 µm induced by non-parallel wafer-to-mask wedge error compensation (WEC) failure during mechanical chuck clamp.
1. Mechanical photoresist shearing and particulate generation from premature stage translation prior to pneumatic separation gap stabilization (> 20 µm air cushion).
1. Vernier misinterpretation and false overlay lock caused by asymmetric resist buildup and diffraction fringe distortion on split-field CMOS camera sensors.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-1-3-01` | **Split-Field Dual-Camera Optical Parallax and Alignment Repeatability Verification** | Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner with Split-Field Microscope (20x Objectives, dual high-resolution CMOS cameras), calibrated optical micrometer quartz grid artifact (0.1 µm pitch standard). | 1. Mount calibrated quartz standard onto MA6 mask stage and engage mechanical vacuum hold (pressure <= -0.7 bar). 2. Load reference silicon wafer patterned with complementary box-in-box targets onto vacuum chuck. 3. Engage WEC alignment sequence to achieve parallelism <= 1.0 µm. 4. Separate chuck to 25 µm proximity alignment gap. 5. Adjust left and right split-field CMOS objectives to register left and right fiducial marks simultaneously. 6. Execute 10 consecutive chuck contact/separation cycles (vacuum contact mode at -0.8 bar chuck vacuum, 0.5 bar N2 cushion) without operator manual joystick adjustments. 7. Measure relative centroid shift (dX, dY) on both CMOS sensors using automated image cross-correlation metrology software. | `Repeatability standard deviation 3-sigma (dX, dY) <= 0.35 µm across all 10 cycles; maximum differential magnification drift between left and right channels <= 0.10 µm across 100mm field.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-1-3-02` | **Mask-to-Wafer Vacuum Contact Overlay Error Vector Quantification** | Automated Optical Overlay Metrology Tool / High-Resolution Split-Field CMOS Review Station, Profilometer, Optical Transmission Spectrophotometer. | 1. Position wafer and mask into MA6 aligner and perform wedge error compensation (WEC). 2. Set alignment gap to 20 µm; align left and right fiducial marks to within optical coincidence (< 0.25 µm visual vernier offset). 3. Transition system into Vacuum Contact Mode (vacuum seal engaged at <= -0.8 bar, vacuum chamber pressure <= 50 mbar). 4. Capture split-field CMOS digital frames of left, center, and right fiducials in contact state. 5. Expose with I-line UV dose (120 mJ/cm²), post-exposure bake, develop in 2.38% TMAH for 60 seconds, and DI rinse. 6. Inspect developed resist verniers and box-in-box targets at 9 radial die locations across the 100mm wafer using calibrated optical overlay review software. | `Mean absolute overlay vector magnitude |Delta_XY| <= 0.50 µm across all 9 die locations; maximum residual rotational runout <= 0.005 degrees (<= 0.45 µm runout at wafer edge).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, accelerator-free), UV-absorbing safety spectacles (ANSI Z87.1 certified, 365-436nm blocking), Full cleanroom gowning (lint-free antistatic bunny suit, hood, boots, face mask), Chemical splash apron and face shield during solvent wipe maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with cleaning solvents: Immediately flush eyes at safety eyewash station with clean tempered water for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and wash affected area thoroughly with mild soap and copious water. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. Seek immediate medical evaluation for all chemical contact incidents.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: MA6 aligner enclosure connected to dedicated cleanroom solvent exhaust ventilation providing >= 150 CFM continuous extraction; laminar flow clean hood maintaining ISO Class 5 air velocity at 0.45 m/s ± 20%.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect solvent-soaked wipes and waste IPA/acetone in labeled, grounded, flame-proof hazardous solvent waste carboys; route exhaust to central cleanroom VOC thermal oxidizer/scrubber system in accordance with industrial hazardous waste handling protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `99.5%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | High Purity Electronic Grade (99.999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Soft-baked positive I-line photoresist on hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS) primed SiO2/Si substrate; defect-free, surface roughness Ra < 0.5 nm, residual solvent content < 5%.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Aligned, UV-exposed photoresist film ready for post-exposure bake (PEB); latent cross-linking/PAC conversion intact without moisture-induced amine contamination or image blurring.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive queue time under ambient air leads to environmental airborne basic amine absorption (T-topping resist profile formation), photoactive compound (PAC) latent image decay, and substrate moisture re-absorption causing severe resist footing and catastrophic overlay dimensional distortion.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full optical fiducial registration and overlay verification on Karl Suss MA6 split-field lithography cluster demonstrating reliable, sub-micron registration across 100mm wafers for 180nm DRAM Gen 2 prototyping in vacuum contact mode.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MA6_SplitField_Fiducial_Calibration_Log.csv`
- [ ] `Wafer_Overlay_Vector_Map_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `SplitField_LeftRight_Registration_Micrographs.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum absolute overlay alignment error across 100mm wafer field in vacuum contact mode** | `0.45` | +0.05 µm | Automated box-in-box optical overlay coordinate measurement across 9 distributed die sites on developed resist pattern. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) mechanical gap parallelism** | `0.80` | +0.20 µm | MA6 pneumatic spherical air-bearing micrometer sensor readout verified with capacitance thickness gauge across wafer diameter. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Split-field dual-CMOS left-to-right optical channel differential magnification distortion** | `0.05` | +0.05 µm | Quartz grid micrometer standard dual-window digital cross-correlation pixel calibration. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit condition requires consecutive achievement of 3 test wafers exhibiting all 9 overlay test sites within <= 0.50 µm vector displacement, complete WEC leveling verification (< 1.0 µm), zero mechanical resist shearing defects under 20x split-field visual inspection, and peer signoff logged in MA6_SplitField_Fiducial_Calibration_Log.csv.
