# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Closed-Loop Piezo Proximity Gap Actuator Integration & Baseline Leveling

- **Document ID:** `SOP-LITH-GAP-002`
- **Domain:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment > Split-Field Optical System Calibration & Proximity Gap Setting > Metrology
- **Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Action Type:** Make
- **Reference Doc:** [sop_closed_loop_piezo_proximity_gap_leveling.md](docs/knowledge/sop_closed_loop_piezo_proximity_gap_leveling.md)

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Mount 3x Closed-Loop  │
│    Piezo Actuators     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Z-Stage Pre-Loading   │
│    & Sensor Nulling    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Baseline Optical    │
│      Wedge Error       │
│      Compensation      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Proximity Gap      │
│   Stepping & Dynamic   │
│        Leveling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Closed-Loop Gap     │
│       Stability        │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Mechanical Tri-Point Kinematic Mounting:**
   - Install three closed-loop piezoelectric actuators arranged in a 120° equilateral configuration beneath the wafer chuck or mask holder interface.
   - Anchor the base assembly to precision-ground linear guide rails (`MGN12H`) on an extruded aluminum 4040 structural frame to minimize Abbe errors.
2. **Coarse Z-Stage Engagement & Sensor Nulling:**
   - Drive the coarse vertical stage (C7 rolled ball screw or anti-backlash lead screw via microstepped NEMA 17 stepper) until the wafer approaches the baseline datum.
   - Monitor coarse approach via linear magnetic or optical scales (1 $\mu\text{m}$ resolution) and zero-calibrate internal piezo capacitive feedback sensors.
3. **Wedge Error Compensation (Baseline Leveling):**
   - Measure mask-to-wafer tilt using split-field optical gap detection across opposite field margins.
   - Apply independent differential voltage trims to the three closed-loop piezo actuators (operating with 0.1 $\mu\text{m}$ sensitivity) until wedge tilt error is nullified.
4. **Proximity Gap Adjustment & Closed-Loop Locking:**
   - Command all three piezo channels synchronously to retreat the chuck to the designated proximity printing air gap between 10 $\mu\text{m}$ and 20 $\mu\text{m}$.
   - Engage closed-loop PID control to hold gap position while verifying external vibration attenuation via neoprene/sorbothane isolation dampers (> 30 Hz).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░                                     │
   Encoder Res┤░░░                                     │
              │▒                                       │
  Actuator Res┤▒                                       │
Target Gap Max┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Target Gap Min┤█████████████████████                   │
              │█████████████████████                   │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
               0         5        10       15        20 
```

1. **Piezo Actuator Sensitivity:** $\le 0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ closed-loop positioning sensitivity per actuator channel.
2. **Operational Proximity Gap Range:** Proximity air gap maintained within $10\ \mu\text{m}$ to $20\ \mu\text{m}$ across the entire exposure field.
3. **Stage Feedback Resolution:** Optical / magnetic linear scale encoder resolution of $\le 1\ \mu\text{m}$.
4. **Vibration Isolation Cutoff:** Sorbothane/neoprene isolation damping effective for mechanical vibrations $> 30\ \text{Hz}$.

---

### Literature Citations
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose:** Defines proximity printing gap specifications ($10\ \mu\text{m}$ to $20\ \mu\text{m}$) to eliminate contact scratch defects, along with the requirement for three high-precision differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity.
- **Precision Linear Stage Design & Vibration Damping:** Dictates structural baseline using extruded aluminum 4040 frames, `MGN12H` linear rails, closed-loop positioning with $1\ \mu\text{m}$ resolution encoders, and vibration isolation damping $> 30\ \text{Hz}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires spin-coating bake stabilization (Softbake 90°C for 60s, HMDS vapor prime) before exposure. Post-exposure bake and develop latency must be strictly monitored.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: UV exposure dose budget (120-150 mJ/cm2 at 365 nm / 248 nm). Overlay alignment budget for Gen 2 (µm) must achieve <= +/- 5 um (Gen 2) or <= +/- 35 nm (Gen 3). Depth of focus (DOF) >= 1.2 um.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Precision fused silica chrome reticles and high-NA objective lenses must be COTS sourced; stage micrometers and linear encoders should use standard high-resolution industrial modules.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 48 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Alignment misregistration directly ruins multi-layer interconnect and contact via connectivity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Vernier misregistration exceeding overlay budget causing short-circuit between gate and bitline contact via.
1. Non-uniform exposure illumination across field causing critical dimension (CD) line-width variation > 10%.
1. Photoresist scumming in fine vias due to insufficient MF-319 developer agitation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-2-01` | **Optical Overlay Vernier Registration & Misalignment Metrology** | Optical Inspection Microscope (100x Oil/Dry Objective, 0.9 NA) with Digital Vernier Micrometer | 1. Focus optical system on wafer alignment cross and reticle outer box fiducials at wafer center and 4 corners. 2. Read vernier comb teeth displacement along X-axis and Y-axis. 3. Calculate rotational theta error and linear misregistration vector (Delta X, Delta Y). | `Max misregistration |Delta X|, |Delta Y| <= 5.0 um for Gen 2 / <= 35 nm for Gen 3 (Pass); Angular theta <= 0.02 deg (Pass).` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-2-02` | **Critical Dimension (CD) Line-Space Profile & Residue Scum Verification** | Top-Down / Cross-Sectional CD-SEM (Hitachi / FEI) or High-Resolution UV Profiler | 1. Position beam at 5 dense line-space arrays (nominal 180 nm or 1.0 um pitch depending on generation). 2. Take high-contrast secondary electron image at 1.0 kV acceleration voltage. 3. Measure linewidth across 10 distinct scanlines and inspect trench bottom for undeveloped resist scum. | `Linewidth within target +/- 8% (Pass); trench floor completely cleared of organic scum (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Nitrile cleanroom gloves (double gloving recommended during resist spin), UV-blocking amber safety glasses (certified 100% optical attenuation at 365 nm / 248 nm), Conductive cleanroom ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: TMAH skin contact warning: TMAH is a systemic neurotoxin capable of causing respiratory arrest upon dermal absorption. Flush with copious water for 15+ minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Explosion-proof solvent exhaust bench with activated charcoal VOC adsorber bed (exhaust velocity >= 0.45 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Flammable solvent waste segregated into grounded stainless steel safety cans. Never mix organic developer/solvent with oxidizers or acids.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-5` | Semiconductor Grade | `2.38% aq in Microposit MF-319 developer` |
| **1-Methoxy-2-propyl acetate (PGMEA)** | `108-65-6` | Electronic Grade | `Resist solvent base (Shipley 1813)` |
| **Hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS)** | `999-97-3` | Semiconductor Grade | `100% vapor prime adhesion promoter` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: HMDS vapor-primed, dehydration-baked substrate (150°C for 30 min) to ensure resist adhesion.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Softbaked photoresist film (1.2 um thickness, uniform within +/- 10 nm across wafer).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture uptake and ambient airborne amine contamination neutralizes surface photoacid generators, causing resist 'T-topping' and failed contact via opening.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Closed-Loop Piezo Proximity Gap Actuator Integration & Baseline Leveling: Photolithographic exposure and development achieves critical dimension line-width target within tolerance, satisfying layer-to-layer overlay budget.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CD_SEM_top_down_inspection_micrographs.tiff`
- [ ] `Box_in_box_Vernier_overlay_error_map.csv`
- [ ] `Stylus_profiler_resist_step_height_log.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Critical Dimension (CD) line width** | `180 nm (Gen 3) / 2.0 um (Gen 2) / 0.1 mm (Gen 1)` | +/- 10% maximum CD window (3-sigma) | Calibrated Top-down Critical Dimension SEM (CD-SEM) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layer-to-layer overlay misregistration (delta_x, delta_y)** | `<= +/- 35 nm (Gen 3) / <= +/- 5.0 um (Gen 2)` | 3-sigma statistical distribution across field | Optical Box-in-Box Vernier overlay metrology |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-develop photoresist sidewall profile angle** | `>= 85.0 deg` | +/- 3.0 deg | Cross-sectional SEM / AFM high-aspect profilometry |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero photoresist bridging, scumming, or micro-pinholes observed in inspection fields; overlay registration strictly within design budget across 100% of die locations.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 10–20 µm Proximity Gap Verification & Crosshair Vernier Metrology

**Document ID:** `SOP-LITH-GEN2-004`  
**Hierarchy Level:** Gen 2 (µm) | Metrology & Precision Alignment  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment > Split-Field Optical System Calibration & Proximity Gap Setting  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Wafer Loading &     │
│  Chuck Vacuum Engaged  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Wedge Error       │
│  Compensation (WEC)    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Set Calibrated Gap   │
│      10 to 20 µm       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│ Dual-Objective Split-  │◄───╮
│    Field Inspection    │    │
└────────────┬───────────┘    │
             │                │
             ▼                │
┌────────────────────────┐    │
│   Crosshair Vernier    │    │
│   Overlay Metrology    │    │
└────────────┬───────────┘    │
             │                │
             ▼                │
┌────────────◇───────────┐    │
│  Overlay ≤ ±2 to 5 µm? │    │
└────────────◇───────────┘    │
             │                │
     No ─────┴─────────┐      │ (Re-align)
                       ▼      │
             ┌────────────────┴─┐
             │   Micrometer /   │
             │ Piezo Fine Trim  │
             └──────────────────┘
     Yes ────┐
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│ Accept & Transfer to   │
│ 365 nm UV Exposure     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate & Mask Loading**:
   - Mount the chromium-on-quartz mask into the mask holder and lock vacuum.
   - Load the silicon wafer coated with Shipley 1813 photoresist (~1.3 µm thickness, soft-baked at 115 °C for 60 s) onto the leveling wafer chuck.

2. **Wedge Error Compensation (WEC)**:
   - Engage spherical air bearings to bring the wafer chuck into parallel contact with the mask.
   - Mechanically level until wedge parallelism across the 100 mm wafer is `< 1 µm`. Lock the WEC mechanism.

3. **Proximity Gap Displacement**:
   - Lower the wafer chuck from contact to establish a calibrated proximity air gap between **10 µm and 20 µm** using three differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators with **0.1 µm** sensitivity.
   - Verify gap uniformity across the wafer surface to eliminate mask-photoresist contact and scratch risks.

4. **Split-Field Optical Focus & Registration**:
   - Position the dual-objective split-field binocular optical microscope (using 10× Plan Achromat, NA 0.25, or 20× objectives paired with dual CMOS cameras) over left and right fiducial mark areas.
   - Focus simultaneously on the mask chromium patterns and substrate fiducials across the split fields.

5. **Crosshair Vernier Overlay Metrology**:
   - Observe the complementary crosshair vernier marks located at peripheral scribe lanes on both split-field channels.
   - Adjust stage $X$, $Y$, and $\theta$ fine differential micrometers until the mask crosshairs concentricity aligns with the wafer fiducials.
   - Read overlay offsets across both axes to confirm overlay precision is within Gen 2 tolerances.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric / Specification | Tolerance | Tool / Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Proximity Air Gap** | **10.0 µm to 20.0 µm** | $\pm 0.1 \text{ \mu m}$ | Closed-loop piezo actuators / differential micrometers |
| **WEC Chuck Parallelism** | **$< 1.0 \text{ \mu m}$** across 100 mm wafer | Maximum upper limit | Spherical air bearing leveling sensor |
| **Overlay Alignment Precision** | **$\le \pm 2 \text{ \mu m}$ to $\pm 5 \text{ \mu m}$** | Gen 2 limit ($\le \pm 5 \text{ \mu m}$) | Split-field dual CMOS crosshair vernier metrology |
| **Exposure Beam Uniformity** | **$> 95\%$** across wafer surface | Minimum lower limit | Optical radiometer (coupled with fly's eye integrator lens at 365 nm) |

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Physical Reference Matrix

- **Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Standard Operating Procedure & Gap Control**:
  - Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) parallelism $< 1\text{ \mu m}$ across 100 mm wafers via spherical air bearings.
  - Split-field microscope configuration with 5×, 10×, and 20× objectives and dual CMOS cameras.
  - Proximity mode operator overlay alignment precision of $\pm 2\text{ to } 5\text{ \mu m}$ with calibrated gap setting of $10\text{ to } 30\text{ \mu m}$ (diffraction limit $\sim 2.5\text{ \mu m}$).
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**:
  - Proximity printing gap range of $10\text{ to } 20\text{ \mu m}$ driven by three high-precision differential micrometers / closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\text{ \mu m}$ sensitivity.
  - 365 nm i-line source with fly's eye integrator lens yielding $> 95\%$ beam uniformity.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - Gen 2 alignment overlay tolerance target of $\pm 5\text{ \mu m}$.
  - Optical setup using 10× Plan Achromat (NA 0.25) objective for micron-scale feature resolution over Shipley 1813 resist.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Maintaining a uniform 10-20µm proximity gap across a 100mm wafer requires spherical air-bearing Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) parallelism to be strictly under 1.0µm total non-parallelism; mechanical drift or stage runout during manual Vernier overlay reading will induce focal plane tilt and lateral shear errors exceeding the ±5µm Gen 2 alignment budget.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Operating in the 10-20µm proximity regime creates Fresnel diffraction ringing (minimum resolution ~2.5µm at 365nm i-line), which degrades high-frequency Vernier mark edges; optical metrology must use 10x/20x objective split-field CMOS imaging calibrated against a certified chrome-on-quartz Ronchi ruling rather than subjective eye-gauge estimates.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom dual-objective split-field optical heads and certified calibration reticles present single-supplier vulnerability; the team must secure standardized 4-inch chrome-on-soda-lime or quartz reference masks and standardized optical capacitive/inductive displacement sensors with domestic spares to prevent fab downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule risk is driven by operator alignment cycle times; manual WEC leveling and split-field Vernier crosshair acquisition can exceed 15 minutes per wafer, threatening the 30-minute pre-exposure queue-time budget for Shipley 1813 resist and causing throughput bottlenecks in multi-layer DRAM lithography runs.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) mechanical lock failure causing physical mask-to-wafer hard collision during gap deflation, destroying mask chrome emulsion and fracturing wafer edge
1. Proximity gap wedge error (>3µm gradient across 100mm) resulting in spatial variation of Fresnel diffraction width, causing localized Vernier mark blooming and unresolvable DRAM array alignment errors
1. Optical CMOS field tilt and chromatic aberration causing parallax misregistration between split-field channels, falsely reporting zero Vernier offset while true overlay error exceeds 8µm

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-3-01` | **Three-Point Proximity Gap Calibration and WEC Parallelism Verification** | Karl Suss MA6 aligner chuck micrometer system, dual Mitutoyo 543-392B digital linear indicator gauges (0.5µm resolution), multi-wavelength optical thin-film gap reflectometer / spectral interference sensor. | 1. Perform initial mechanical Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) contact sequence at 0.2 bar N2 chuck leveling pressure. 2. Zero the calibrated z-axis displacement micrometer at initial contact. 3. Lower the chuck to a designated 15.0µm proximity setpoint. 4. Measure absolute physical separation at three periphery wafer locations (120° apart, r = 40mm) using optical gap interferometry. 5. Calculate total wedge thickness variation (gap non-parallelism) across the three points. | `Mean proximity gap across all 3 measurement locations must be 15.0µm ± 1.5µm, and the delta between the maximum and minimum measured gap (WEC parallelism) must be <= 1.0µm.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-3-02` | **Dual-Axis Split-Field Crosshair Vernier Overlay Metrology** | Dual-objective split-field optical microscope with 20x Plan Achromat objectives (NA 0.40), paired 5MP CMOS USB3 cameras, calibrated digital overlay reticle software. | 1. Focus split-field channel A onto the left Vernier mark (X-axis) and channel B onto the right Vernier mark (Y-axis). 2. Adjust split-field CMOS digital crosshairs to align mask-to-wafer zero-line fiducials using sub-micron stage micrometers. 3. Acquire 10-frame averaged image snapshots for both channels. 4. Run automated threshold edge-detection to compute the center-to-center offset between substrate Vernier teeth and mask Vernier teeth across both left and right dies. | `Measured residual overlay error in both X and Y directions must satisfy |delta_X| <= 3.0µm and |delta_Y| <= 3.0µm across both split-field inspection sites, with zero rotational runout theta <= 0.002°.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN 374 compliant), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering safety glasses / yellow-filtered face shield, Static-dissipative cleanroom gown and ESD-safe conductive footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of dermal contact with TMAH or resist solvents, immediately flush skin at emergency eyewash/shower station for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated cleanroom gear. If inhaled, relocate victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is difficult. Seek immediate medical attention with safety data sheet (SDS) identifying TMAH neurotoxic potential.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operate within laminar flow hood or dedicated yellow-room photolithography enclosure with minimum downflow face velocity of 0.45 m/s (90 fpm) and local solvent-rated exhaust ducting maintaining negative static pressure.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate all solvent and developer contaminated wipes into dedicated flammable/organic hazardous waste receptacles; spent aqueous TMAH developer must be segregated from acids, neutralized in an alkaline wastewater collection system, and hauled by a licensed hazardous waste contractor.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Shipley Microposit S1813 Photoresist (Residual solvent: Propylene Glycol Monomethyl Ether Acetate - PGMEA)** | `108-65-6` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `>= 70% solvent vehicle with diazonaphthoquinone/novolak resin` |
| **Microposit MF-319 Developer (Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide - TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Semiconductor Grade | `2.2% aqueous solution` |

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Differential Micrometer & Piezo Actuator Wedge Error Compensation Calibration
**Document ID:** `SOP-LITH-024`  
**Classification:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$) | Action Type: Make  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment > Split-Field Optical System Calibration & Proximity Gap Setting > 10–20 $\mu\text{m}$ Proximity Gap Verification & Crosshair Vernier Metrology > Differential Micrometer & Piezo Actuator Wedge Error Compensation Calibration

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Initial Leveling &   │
│  Mechanical Zeroing   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Three-Point      │
│     Proximity Gap     │
│   Baseline Setting    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Split-Field Optical  │
│   Fringe Inspection   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Closed-Loop Piezo   │
│   Actuation & Wedge   │
│     Error Nulling     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Final Metrology &   │
│      Acceptance       │
│     Verification      │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Purpose & Principles
To eliminate wedge error (parallelism deviation) between the chromium-on-quartz photomask and the photoresist-coated substrate in proximity alignment mode, establishing an unvarying proximity gap across the entire active exposure field. Coarse wedge leveling is executed mechanically using three high-precision differential micrometers, followed by active planarization via closed-loop piezo actuators.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Calibration Procedure

1. **Pre-Check & Vibration Isolation Setup**
   - Verify that the stage structure (MGN12H linear guide rails mounted on 4040 aluminum extrusion) rests on sorbothane pads or neoprene dampers to dampen mechanical vibrations $> 30\text{ Hz}$.
   - Ensure the wafer chuck and mask chuck are free of particulates.

2. **Mechanical Zeroing & Planarization (Differential Micrometers)**
   - Mount a calibration wafer onto the vacuum chuck.
   - Adjust the 3 differential micrometers arranged in a 120° equilateral configuration to bring the mask and wafer into soft coplanar baseline reference.
   - Back off each differential micrometer synchronously to establish a coarse gap in the target proximity window of $10\text{ to }20\,\mu\text{m}$.

3. **Split-Field Optical Inspection & Wedge Error Detection**
   - Position the split-field microscope optics (10× Plan Achromat objective, NA 0.25) over opposite peripheral fiducial marks on the mask and wafer.
   - Observe interference fringes / optical proximity crosshair alignment across both split fields.
   - Any asymmetry or tilt between the left and right split-field focus depths indicates angular wedge error across the chuck plane.

4. **Closed-Loop Piezo Fine Wedge Nulling**
   - Energize the three closed-loop piezo actuators ($0.1\,\mu\text{m}$ sensitivity).
   - Dynamically actuate individual piezo axes to tilt the stage plane until interference fringes across the periphery expand out to null (zero fringe differential) and both split-field focal planes converge.
   - Read position feedback via linear optical/magnetic encoders ($1\,\mu\text{m}$ resolution) and piezo capacitive sensors to confirm position lock.

5. **Proximity Gap & Alignment Lock Verification**
   - Confirm that the absolute separation across all measured points remains uniformly constrained within $10\text{ to }20\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Verify lateral fiducial crosshair mark alignment error remains within Gen 2 tolerances ($\pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Proximity Air Gap** | $10\text{ to }20$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical split-field focus metrology & linear encoder feedback |
| **Piezo Actuation Sensitivity** | $0.1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Closed-loop piezo controller capacitive sensor log |
| **Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Split-field crosshair vernier fiducial overlay inspection |
| **Stage Rail Straightness** | $< 5$ per $100$ | $\mu\text{m} / \text{mm}$ | MGN12H precision linear guide mechanical runout gauge |
| **Vibration Isolation Cutoff** | $> 30$ | $\text{Hz}$ | Accelerometer log on neoprene/sorbothane damped 4040 frame |

---

### 5. Context Citations

- **[Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose]**: Proximity printing separation of $10\text{ to }20\,\mu\text{m}$ air gap; gap control using three high-precision differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\,\mu\text{m}$ sensitivity; crosshair alignment marks.
- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**: 10× Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25); Gen 2 alignment tolerance specification of $\pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$.
- **[Precision Linear Stage Design & Vibration Damping]**: Extruded aluminum 4040 frames paired with precision ground linear guide rails (MGN12H) providing straightness $< 5\,\mu\text{m}/100\text{mm}$; linear encoder resolution of $1\,\mu\text{m}$; vibration isolation with neoprene dampers or sorbothane pads isolating external vibrations above $30\text{ Hz}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Integrating three differential micrometers with closed-loop piezo actuators for Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) demands deterministic stiffness and low thermal drift across the spherical air bearing leveling chuck. The control loop must decouple Z-axis vertical translation from tip/tilt pitch and roll rotations. A critical risk is capacitive sensor or LVDT feedback lag causing micro-chatter during mechanical contact or proximity gap leveling, which compromises open-source lithography tool repeatability across 100mm/150mm wafer runs.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm DRAM node lithography executed at Gen 2 (micrometer-scale proximity mode with 10-20 µm clearance), residual wedge parallelism error across a 100mm wafer must remain below 1.0 µm to avoid non-uniform Fresnel diffraction. If the gap diverges beyond +/- 1.5 µm across the field, local critical dimension (CD) variations on critical active area and capacitor contact patterns will induce immediate bridging or line collapse in Shipley 1813 resist.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying COTS ultra-high-resolution differential micrometers (e.g., Newport or Mitutoyo 0.5 µm sub-divisions) combined with standard open-loop or closed-loop piezo stacks (e.g., Thorlabs or PI 0.1 µm resolution) mitigates proprietary tool lock-in. Sourcing spherical air bearings with localized pneumatic clamping ensures affordable, reproducible assembly for domestic manufacturing in Vietnam without reliance on export-restricted turnkey aligner platforms.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The calibration workflow must fit within standard cleanroom operating cycles. The mechanical WEC leveling protocol, optical vernier verification, and gap calibration must be completed within a 45-minute shift handoff. Standardizing this buy-and-integrate package on modular optomechanical mounts ensures local fab technicians can troubleshoot and calibrate the split-field exposure system without OEM field-service contracts.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Piezoelectric actuator hysteresis and thermal creep inducing a dynamic wedge drift > 1.5 µm during the 15-second UV exposure exposure cycle.
1. Spherical air bearing clamping torque distortion introducing localized out-of-plane bow (> 2 µm) across the wafer chuck upon pneumatic locking.
1. Differential micrometer backlash leading to uncompensated tilt during manual coarse leveling, causing catastrophic quartz mask-to-wafer mechanical collision.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-3-1-01` | **Three-Point Piezo Actuator Z-Travel Linearity and Dynamic Wedge Error Verification** | Dual-wavelength laser displacement interferometer (Keyence or Heidenhain optical probes, 10 nm resolution), 100mm optical flat mirror (lambda/10 quartz reference), multichannel closed-loop piezo controller. | 1. Mount the 100mm lambda/10 quartz optical flat onto the WEC wafer chuck with 0.7 bar vacuum hold. 2. Position three synchronized optical displacement probes directly above the three actuator apex locations (120 degrees apart at 40mm radius). 3. Command piezo actuators to step through a 0.0 to 30.0 µm Z-travel range in 1.0 µm increments at 0.5 µm/s, recording displacement data across all three channels. 4. Calculate relative pitch and roll angular error (wedge deviation) across the 80mm gauge diameter at each increment. | `Total wedge error (max delta Z across any two probe positions across 80mm span) must be <= 0.80 µm across the full 0-30 µm stroke; individual piezo channel linearity R^2 >= 0.9995 with hysteresis <= 0.10 µm.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-3-1-02` | **Pneumatic Spherical Bearing Clamp Stability and 15 µm Proximity Gap Parallelism Retention** | Split-field dual-objective optical microscope (20x objectives, NA 0.40) with calibrated CMOS vernier image processing, 5-inch chromium-on-quartz calibration mask with edge verniers, 100mm bare test silicon wafer. | 1. Load the 100mm bare test wafer and engage vacuum chuck. 2. Bring wafer into soft mechanical contact with calibration mask under 0.2 bar N2 cushion to float spherical bearing into coplanar equilibrium. 3. Activate pneumatic bearing clamp (apply 3.0 bar vacuum lock). 4. Retract piezo actuators downward by exactly 15.0 µm to establish nominal proximity gap. 5. Measure proximity gap height optically at four extreme orthogonal wafer periphery locations (North, South, East, West, r = 45mm) using depth-from-focus metrology. | `Proximity gap at all four peripheral points must measure 15.0 µm +/- 1.0 µm; total tilt deviation across 90mm diameter <= 1.2 µm before and after 10 consecutive clamp/unclamp cycles.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ASTM D6319), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact-resistant safety glasses, Class 100 cleanroom lint-free Tyvek smock and ESD shoe covers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with IPA, rinse thoroughly with copious deionized water for at least 15 minutes. For eye splash, irrigate immediately at emergency eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. In case of vapor inhalation or asphyxiation warning from inert N2 purge line, move individual immediately to fresh outdoor air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Optomechanical alignment assembly must occur inside clean hood or laminar flow station equipped with localized solvent vapor exhaust (> 50 FPM face velocity) for IPA cleaning wipes.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA-wetted lint-free poly-cellulose wipes must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-retardant hazardous solvent waste containers for formal high-temperature incineration per local environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / MOS) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Dry Air (CDA) / Nitrogen** | `7727-37-9` | High Purity Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Solvent-cleaned, dry, particle-inspected quartz mask and polished prime silicon wafer chuck; surface free of organic residue and particulate contamination (> 0.5 µm particle count = 0).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Parallelism-calibrated, pneumatically locked WEC chuck ready for immediate resist-coated product wafer loading and UV split-field proximity exposure.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive queue time under ambient air leads to airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and micro-particulate sedimentation on chuck vacuum seats, causing local wedge tilt errors > 2.5 µm and catastrophic mask contact scratching.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed calibration and verification of the differential micrometer and three-channel piezo actuator wedge error compensation mechanism, guaranteeing residual gap wedge parallelism error <= 1.0 µm across 100mm wafers at a nominal 15 µm proximity gap.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WEC_Piezo_Actuator_Linearity_Calibration_Report.csv`
- [ ] `Proximity_Gap_Parallelism_Four_Point_Metrology.pdf`
- [ ] `Chuck_WEC_Clamp_Distortion_Interferogram.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total wedge parallelism error across 100mm wafer chuck diameter after pneumatic clamping** | `0.75 um` | +/- 0.25 um | Multi-channel laser displacement sensor array logging across orthogonal axes. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Nominal proximity exposure gap repeatability across 20 consecutive retraction cycles** | `15.0 um` | +/- 0.5 um | Split-field dual-objective optical focus depth metrology calibrated to 100nm stage encoder. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful execution of 10 consecutive automated WEC lock-and-gap sequences without operator intervention, achieving verified wafer-to-mask parallelism <= 1.0 µm and nominal gap offset of 15.0 +/- 0.5 µm signed off by Lead Lithography Metrology Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-LITHO-GAP-002`
**Title:** 10–20 µm Air Gap Dynamic Setting via Optical Triangulation & Micro-Gap Sensor  
**Process Step:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment > Split-Field Optical System Calibration & Proximity Gap Setting > 10–20µm Air Gap Dynamic Setting  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Classification:** Controlled Photolithography Metrology & Mechanical Actuation  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure establishes the physical protocol to establish, dynamically verify, and lock a uniform 10–20 µm proximity air gap between the chromium-on-quartz photomask and the Shipley 1813 photoresist-coated wafer. Maintaining this precise proximity gap prevents contact damage/scratch defects on the mask while avoiding excessive diffraction blurring prior to 365 nm i-line exposure.

---

### 2. Equipment, Tooling & Consumables
- **Wafer:** Silicon wafer coated with Shipley 1813 photoresist (1.3 µm nominal thickness, spun at 4000 RPM, soft-baked at 115°C for 60 s).
- **Mask:** Chromium-on-quartz proximity mask with fiducial crosshair marks.
- **Actuation System:** 3-point closed-loop piezoelectric actuators or high-precision differential micrometers with 0.1 µm positioning sensitivity.
- **Sensor/Metrology Tools:** 
  - Dual optical triangulation micro-gap displacement sensors.
  - Split-field microscope inspection optics (10× Plan Achromat, NA 0.25).
- **Sub-Fab / Environment:** Class 100/1000 cleanroom/flow-hood environment with vibration isolation.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
[Step 1: Substrate & Mask Loading]
       │
       ▼
[Step 2: 3-Point Reference Leveling (Coarse Approach)]
       │
       ▼
[Step 3: Dynamic Optical Triangulation Measurement]
       │
       ▼
[Step 4: Closed-Loop Piezo Differential Actuation]
       │
       ▼
[Step 5: Vernier Metrology & Gap Lock]
```

#### Step 1: Substrate & Mask Inspection and Chucking
1. Inspect the chromium-on-quartz mask under 10× Plan Achromat microscope optics to verify zero particulate contamination.
2. Vacuum-mount the 1.3 µm Shipley 1813 coated wafer onto the exposure stage.
3. Bring the optical triangulation laser/LED micro-gap sensor into position perpendicular to the mask-wafer interface.

#### Step 2: Reference Leveling (Coarse Approach)
1. Using manual differential micrometers, bring the wafer stage upward in the Z-axis toward the quartz mask while monitoring the optical gap displacement readout.
2. Stop coarse vertical translation at approximately 50 µm clearance to prevent mechanical contact.

#### Step 3: Dynamic Gap Interrogation via Optical Triangulation
1. Engage the optical triangulation micro-gap sensors at three peripheral fiducial positions ($Z_1, Z_2, Z_3$) spaced 120° apart.
2. Project the focused beam through the quartz mask and measure the differential reflection off the photoresist surface.
3. Calculate the tilt angle and local gap variation ($\Delta Z = \max(Z_1, Z_2, Z_3) - \min(Z_1, Z_2, Z_3)$).

#### Step 4: Closed-Loop Actuation to Target Proximity Range
1. Engage the 3-axis closed-loop piezoelectric actuators (0.1 µm step sensitivity).
2. Drive actuators $Z_1, Z_2, Z_3$ simultaneously to bring the air gap within the target range of **10.0 µm to 20.0 µm**.
3. Compensate for wedge error dynamically until gap variation across all three points is within acceptable parallelism tolerances.

#### Step 5: Verification and Actuator Lock
1. Verify crosshair fiducial alignment through the split-field microscope (confirming alignment is within Gen 2 tolerance of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).
2. Lock piezo actuator driver outputs. Ensure no thermal or mechanical drift occurs over a 30-second dwell period.
3. Ready the optical alignment stage for 365 nm UV exposure (dose calibrated for 120–150 mJ/cm²).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Proximity Air Gap Range** | $10.0 \text{ to } 20.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Calibrated Optical Triangulation Micro-Gap Sensor |
| **Actuator Positioning Sensitivity** | $0.1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Closed-Loop Piezo / Differential Micrometer Readout |
| **Stage Lateral Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Split-Field Fiducial Metrology (Gen 2 standard) |
| **Resist Film Thickness** | $1.3$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Ellipsometry / Reflectometry (Shipley 1813 @ 4000 RPM) |

---

### 5. Literature Sources & Citations
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose:**
  - Proximity printing gap baseline: *10 to 20 micron air gap* (eliminates contact damage; diffraction limits resolution to ~2-3 microns).
  - Actuation specifications: *Three high-precision differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators with 0.1 micron sensitivity*.
  - Resist exposure baseline: *Shipley 1813 (1.3 um thickness), clear dose 120-150 mJ/cm² at 365nm*.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
  - Optics: *10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25*.
  - Processing parameters: *Shipley 1813 spin-coated at 4000 RPM yielding ~1.3 micron thickness, soft bake at 115°C for 60 seconds*.
  - Alignment tolerance: *Gen 2 alignment tolerance improving to ±5 microns*.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dynamic closed-loop air-gap setting via optical triangulation faces phase-shift noise and parasitic reflection interference across the multi-layer dielectric stack (quartz photomask, Cr absorber, air gap, photoresist, SiO2/Si substrate). Piezoelectric z-drives coupled with micro-gap sensors require sub-millisecond settling times and active hysteresis compensation (charge-control or capacitive feedback) to avoid cross-axis tilt during wedge error compensation (WEC) locking.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Operating in the 10-20µm proximity regime limits resolution due to Fresnel diffraction (W ≈ √(λ · g) ≈ 2.3µm at λ=365nm and g=15µm). Non-uniformity in the air gap directly distorts critical dimension (CD) profiles across the 100mm wafer; dynamic gap variations exceeding ±0.5µm cause unacceptable asymmetric diffraction rings and localized pattern bridging on 180nm architecture test structures.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring optical triangulation laser heads with sub-50nm resolution and compatible dual-sensor controllers from tier-1 suppliers (e.g., Keyence, Micro-Epsilon, or Heidenhain) carries a 12-16 week lead time and export classification constraints. High-vacuum/cleanroom compatible piezo stages and spherical air bearing WEC chucks must have verified local second-source maintenance support in Vietnam.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Since this is designated as a 'Buy' work package, the commercial integration milestone must lock vendor Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP) before hardware dispatch. Tooling integration into the Gen 2 lithography line must not exceed the 3-week installation window, and metrology calibration kits must be certified prior to wafer dry-runs.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Premature mask-to-wafer mechanical crash during dynamic closed-loop approach caused by optical triangulation specular loss or sensor saturation on highly reflective metal fiducials.
1. Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) spherical air-bearing clamp drift inducing wedge-induced non-parallelism (>1.5µm total indicator reading across 100mm chuck diameter).
1. Thermal drift of optical sensor mounting brackets due to ambient i-line UV lamp thermal radiation, causing false gap measurement and drift out of the 10-20µm exposure envelope.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-3-2-01` | **Dynamic Proximity Gap Setting Accuracy and Linearity Verification** | Dual-channel laser triangulation displacement sensor (sub-nanometer resolution), calibrated capacitive gap gauge reference artifact, digital oscilloscope/data logger, closed-loop piezo z-stage with capacitive feedback. | 1. Command piezo stage to step the gap from 5.0µm to 25.0µm in increments of 1.0µm. 2. Record 1,000 readings per step from the optical triangulation sensor and capacitive reference sensor at 2 kHz sampling rate. 3. Calculate mean deviation, repeatability (3σ), and settling time for target gaps at 10.0µm, 15.0µm, and 20.0µm. 4. Reverse the sequence from 25.0µm down to 5.0µm to measure hysteresis. | `Static gap error must be ≤ ±0.20µm across the entire 10.0-20.0µm range; dynamic step settling time to within ±0.10µm of target must be < 150 ms; mechanical/optical hysteresis must not exceed 0.08µm.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-1-3-2-02` | **Full-Wafer Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) Parallelism and Dynamic Stability** | Three-point dynamic optical micro-gap sensor array (120-degree radial offset), 100mm double-side polished silicon test wafer, 5-inch quartz test mask with chrome fiducials, automated WEC clamp controller. | 1. Load silicon test wafer and engage air bearing for floating WEC alignment. 2. Drive wafer chuck into controlled soft contact (0.2 bar) to achieve mechanical leveling. 3. Clamp spherical air bearing and retract chuck dynamically to setpoints of 10.0µm, 15.0µm, and 20.0µm. 4. Measure absolute gap simultaneously at the 3 peripheral sensor locations over a 30-minute hold period. | `Differential gap variation across all 3 sensor points (wedge error) must be ≤ 0.50µm across 100mm diameter; total gap drift over 30 minutes must be ≤ 0.15µm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100/ISO 5 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, dual-layer), ANSI Z87.1 certified laser safety glasses (optical density OD 5+ matched to sensor laser diode wavelength, e.g., 655nm/405nm), UV-blocking polycarbonate face shield for alignment lamp inspection, Cleanroom antistatic ESD bunny suit and conductive booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Laser exposure: Immediate cessation of beam emission; transport personnel for ophthalmological examination if direct ocular exposure occurs. Chemical/IPA exposure: In case of skin contact, rinse with copious deionized water for 15 minutes. In case of inhalation, move subject to fresh air immediately. Eye wash and safety showers must be operational within 10 seconds of workstation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom vertical laminar flow (ISO Class 5) maintaining downflow velocity of 0.45 ± 0.05 m/s. Dedicated chemical local exhaust ventilation (LEV) on solvent cleaning tray operating at min. 35 m³/h capture velocity.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA-wetted cleanroom wipes must be segregated into sealed, airtight, flame-resistant solvent waste bins grounded against electrostatic discharge, and disposed of according to hazardous flammable organic waste protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.8%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: HMDS primed and photoresist soft-baked (1.3µm Shipley 1813 on bare/patterned Si), cleanroom particulate count ≤ 1 particle (>0.3µm) per wafer surface, cooled to 21°C.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Calibrated proximity-aligned wafer ready for UV shutter actuation, zero mechanical contact marks, gap locked at target setpoint (15.0 ± 0.5µm).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes moisture absorption into the photoresist matrix resulting in photoacid generator/sensitizer deactivation, localized resist blistering, and particulate accumulation on the resist surface that risks optical gap sensor readout distortion or mask scratch defects.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full commercial commissioning, optical calibration, and closed-loop validation of the dynamic 10-20µm air gap setting subsystem on the Gen 2 mask aligner, demonstrating automated wedge error leveling <0.5µm across 100mm wafers and repeatable dynamic proximity gap regulation within ±0.2µm without physical contact.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dynamic_gap_triangulation_calibration_report.pdf`
- [ ] `wec_3point_leveling_telemetry.csv`
- [ ] `proximity_gap_repeatability_matrix.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Dynamic proximity gap setting accuracy across 10-20µm operational range** | `15.0 µm` | ±0.20 µm | Dual-sensor comparative telemetry against certified capacitive gauge artifact during automated stepping cycles. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total Wedge Error Parallelism across 100mm wafer chuck area after clamping** | `0.35 µm` | ≤ 0.50 µm TIR | Multi-point optical triangulation triangulation runout check across chuck periphery under clamped air bearing state. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Completion of 50 consecutive automated wafer load-WEC-gap cycles at 15.0µm target gap demonstrating zero mask contacts, gap standard deviation 3σ < 0.15µm, and formal approval by both Lead Systems Engineer and Domain Expert.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dual-Field Crosshair Vernier Overlay Metrology & Runout Inspection

- **Node Title**: Dual-Field Crosshair Vernier Overlay Metrology & Runout Inspection
- **Hierarchy Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Microscopic Mask Optical Alignment > Split-Field Optical System Calibration & Proximity Gap Setting > 10-20µm Proximity Gap Verification & Crosshair Vernier Metrology
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type**: Buy (Commercial-Off-The-Shelf Dual-CMOS Split-Field Metrology Tool / Stage Optics)

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Load & Gap   │
│       Setting       │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│     Dual-Field      │
│  Microscope Focus   │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Crosshair Vernier  │
│   Overlay Reading   │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│    Runout Vector    │
│     Computation     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│     Acceptance      │
│    Verification     │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate & Mask Loading**:
   - Secure the photoresist-coated wafer (Shipley 1813, nominal thickness $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) onto the vacuum chuck.
   - Position the chromium-on-quartz mask in the mask holder directly above the wafer chuck.
2. **Proximity Gap Engagement**:
   - Engage the differential micrometers / closed-loop piezo actuators to establish and stabilize the nominal proximity gap between mask and wafer at $10\ \mu\text{m}$ to $20\ \mu\text{m}$ (actuator sensitivity: $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$).
3. **Dual-Field Optical Channel Alignment**:
   - Focus the dual CMOS cameras of the split-field binocular microscope (configured with 10x Plan Achromat objectives, $\text{NA} = 0.25$) on the complementary fiducial crosshair marks on both the left and right peripheral fields of the wafer and mask.
4. **Vernier Overlay & Runout Metrology**:
   - Capture digital images across both optical channels simultaneously.
   - Read the relative offset between mask and substrate crosshair vernier scales in the orthogonal $X$ and $Y$ axes at Field 1 (Left) and Field 2 (Right).
   - Calculate translational runout ($\Delta X, \Delta Y$) and rotational mismatch ($\Delta \theta = \arctan[(\Delta Y_2 - \Delta Y_1) / L]$).
5. **Stage Correction & Verification**:
   - Adjust the macroscopic alignment stage until both optical crosshair centers register within Gen 2 tolerances.
   - Verify that proximity gap clearance remains within $10\ \mu\text{m} - 20\ \mu\text{m}$ to prevent physical contact scratch defects.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Proximity Air Gap** | `10.0` to `20.0` | $\mu\text{m}$ | $10\ \mu\text{m} \le \text{Gap} \le 20\ \mu\text{m}$ |
| **Actuator Positioning Sensitivity** | `0.1` | $\mu\text{m}$ | $\le 0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ |
| **Gen 2 Overlay Alignment Tolerance** | `5.0` | $\mu\text{m}$ | $\le \pm 5.0\ \mu\text{m}$ |
| **Objective Numerical Aperture (NA)** | `0.25` | dimensionless (NA) | Nominal ($10\times$ Plan Achromat) |

---

### Literature Citations

1. **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**:
   - Proximity printing gap baseline: $10\ \mu\text{m}$ to $20\ \mu\text{m}$ separation to eliminate mask scratch damage.
   - Gap actuation resolution: three high-precision differential micrometers / closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity.
   - Metrology optics: crosshair alignment marks inspected via split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras.
2. **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
   - Optical objective configuration: $10\times$ Plan Achromat ($\text{NA} = 0.25$).
   - Photoresist baseline: Shipley 1813 at $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ film thickness.
   - Alignment precision roadmap: Gen 1 tolerance at $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ ($0.1\ \text{mm}$), advancing to $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ for Gen 2.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-field optical split systems inherently suffer from optical axis parallax and independent thermal drift between the left and right microscope heads. When inspecting runout over 100mm wafers at a 10-20µm proximity gap, depth of field limitations at 20x magnification require simultaneous telecentricity calibration; otherwise, minor Z-height variations induce apparent lateral scaling (runout) errors that are artifactual rather than physical mask-wafer expansion mismatches.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Crosshair Vernier structures designed for proximity lithography must accommodate diffraction-induced edge blur caused by Fresnel diffraction across the 10-20µm gap. Conventional 0.5µm Vernier comb fingers will wash out due to optical proximity effects at 365nm; the Vernier rule dimensions must maintain a pitch of ≥2.0µm with nominal 0.1-0.2µm vernier differential offsets to permit unambiguous sub-micron visual and automated edge-detection readout.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom quartz masks featuring dual-field high-resolution chrome Vernier fiducials with calibrated pitch standards have procurement lead times exceeding 6 to 8 weeks. Calibration reticles from external metrology vendors must adhere to NIST-traceable grid standards; lack of standardized secondary calibration plates in-country risks unverified tool drift during multi-shift wafer runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The dual-field inspection sequence represents an operational bottleneck during wafer lithography. Manual split-field Vernier alignment and manual runout recording exceed takt time allocations by ~180 seconds per wafer. An automated split-field image capture and sub-pixel edge detection pipeline must be validated to preserve the 12 wafers-per-hour target for the Gen 2 pilot run.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parallax-induced magnification and runout error resulting from unequal left/right optical Z-heights relative to the tilted wafer plane during split-field imaging.
1. Diffraction-broadened Vernier comb edge profile washing out optical intensity gradients, leading to sub-pixel fitting failure and false overlay misregistration readings.
1. Physical mask-wafer contact collision during alignment adjustment caused by inaccurate proximity gap sensing or uncompensated wedge error.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, accelerator-free), UV-blocking safety glasses (absorbance OD > 5 at 365nm-436nm), ESD cleanroom gown, hood, boot covers, and conductive ESD wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Immediately flush skin with copious amounts of deionized water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. Eye contact: Irrigate exposed eyes using eyewash station for ≥ 15 minutes holding eyelids open. UV exposure: Remove individual from UV beam area; seek medical evaluation for photokeratitis or skin erythema.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Aligner enclosure must maintain localized laminar air flow (Class 100 / ISO 5) with exhaust velocity at mask chuck perimeter ≥ 0.5 m/s; solvent vapor exhaust ducted directly to cleanroom VOC scrubbers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA and photoresist-contaminated cleanroom wipes must be disposed of in dedicated, grounded flammables bins with airtight self-closing lids. Spent solvent wash liquid collected in UN-rated polyethylene carboys for hazardous chemical incineration.

| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Cleanroom Cleaning Solvent** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Soft-baked Shipley 1813 photoresist (115°C for 60 seconds), surface clean and free of particulate contamination (Class 10 particle limit: 0 particles > 0.5µm).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Aligned and proximity-exposed photoresist latent image, ready for post-exposure bake (PEB) or immediate developer immersion without environmental amine poisoning.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive cleanroom ambient exposure causes airborne amine absorption leading to photoresist T-topping and insoluble surface inhibition layers; moisture absorption alters exposure dose sensitivity and induces dimensional resist shrinkage, invalidating runout overlay metrics.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery of fully verified dual-field crosshair Vernier overlay metrology baseline ensuring overlay alignment precision ≤ 1.5µm and wafer-scale runout ≤ 1.0µm under a 15µm proximity exposure gap on 100mm wafers.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dual_field_vernier_overlay_report.pdf`

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful execution of 5 consecutive wafer alignment cycles displaying overlay error ≤ 1.5µm and runout ≤ 1.0µm with automated edge-detection confidence > 95% across both split-field channels without physical mask-wafer contact.

critics.systems_engineer: Dual-field optical split systems inherently suffer from optical axis parallax and independent thermal drift between the left and right microscope heads. When inspecting runout over 100mm wafers at a 10-20µm proximity gap, depth of field limitations at 20x magnification require simultaneous telecentricity calibration; otherwise, minor Z-height variations induce apparent lateral scaling (runout) errors that are artifactual rather than physical mask-wafer expansion mismatches.
critics.domain_expert: Crosshair Vernier structures designed for proximity lithography must accommodate diffraction-induced edge blur caused by Fresnel diffraction across the 10-20µm gap. Conventional 0.5µm Vernier comb fingers will wash out due to optical proximity effects at 365nm; the Vernier rule dimensions must maintain a pitch of ≥2.0µm with nominal 0.1-0.2µm vernier differential offsets to permit unambiguous sub-micron visual and automated edge-detection readout.
critics.supply_chain: Custom quartz masks featuring dual-field high-resolution chrome Vernier fiducials with calibrated pitch standards have procurement lead times exceeding 6 to 8 weeks. Calibration reticles from external metrology vendors must adhere to NIST-traceable grid standards; lack of standardized secondary calibration plates in-country risks unverified tool drift during multi-shift wafer runs.
critics.laya_pm: The dual-field inspection sequence represents an operational bottleneck during wafer lithography. Manual split-field Vernier alignment and manual runout recording exceed takt time allocations by ~180 seconds per wafer. An automated split-field image capture and sub-pixel edge detection pipeline must be validated to preserve the 12 wafers-per-hour target for the Gen 2 pilot run.
critical_failure_modes: Parallax-induced magnification and runout error resulting from unequal left/right optical Z-heights relative to the tilted wafer plane during split-field imaging.
Diffraction-broadened Vernier comb edge profile washing out optical intensity gradients, leading to sub-pixel fitting failure and false overlay misregistration readings.
Physical mask-wafer contact collision during alignment adjustment caused by inaccurate proximity gap sensing or uncompensated wedge error.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Fiducial Mark Crosshair Alignment & UV Exposure Recipe Execution

- **Module**: [Photolithography / Optics & Precision Alignment](docs/)
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm Action)
- **Target Substrate**: Silicon wafer spin-coated with Shipley 1813 photoresist (~1.3 µm thickness, soft-baked at 115°C for 60 s)

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Load Wafer & Mask   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Wedge Error      │
│   Compensation (WEC)  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Set Alignment Gap   │
│      10 - 20 µm       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Split-Field Optical  │
│  Crosshair Alignment  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Hard Contact Clamp   │
│        1.0 bar        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   UV 365nm Exposure   │
│    120 - 150 mJ/cm²   │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate & Mask Loading**:
   - Secure the chromium-on-quartz mask onto the mask holder with vacuum enabled.
   - Place the Shipley 1813 coated wafer (~1.3 µm nominal film thickness) onto the vacuum chuck.

2. **Wedge Error Compensation (WEC)**:
   - Initiate the automated/spherical air-bearing WEC sequence.
   - Mechanically level the wafer chuck against the mask holder to guarantee planarity across the entire 100 mm wafer substrate (parallelism wedge error `< 1 µm`).

3. **Alignment Gap Engagement**:
   - Lower the chuck from contact into proximity alignment mode to prevent mask scratches and photoresist scuffing.
   - Establish a calibrated optical separation gap of **10 µm to 20 µm** utilizing the closed-loop differential micrometers / piezo actuators (0.1 µm resolution).

4. **Split-Field Optical Crosshair Alignment**:
   - Engage the split-field binocular optical microscope using **10x Plan Achromat (NA 0.25)** or 20x objectives over the dual high-resolution CMOS cameras.
   - Locate and translate wafer fiducial crosshairs relative to the mask crosshair reticles along $X$, $Y$, and $\theta$ (rotation).
   - Co-align fiducial crosshair features until overlay displacement is centered well within **±2 µm to ±5 µm** (Gen 2 alignment tolerance).

5. **Contact Mode Clamping**:
   - Switch from proximity gap to **Hard Contact** exposure mode.
   - Apply nitrogen under-chuck pressure at **1.0 bar** to ensure intimate contact without air pockets, achieving ~1.0 µm optical resolution limit.

6. **UV Exposure Recipe Execution**:
   - Verify 365 nm (i-line UV LED array / 200W Mercury short-arc source) beam uniformity is **> 95%** across the wafer via fly's eye integrator optics.
   - Read flux with the calibrated optical radiometer ($mW/cm^2$).
   - Execute exposure timer programmed to deliver a cumulative clear dose of **120 mJ/cm² to 150 mJ/cm²**.
   - Release chuck vacuum/pressure, lower wafer stage, and transfer substrate to post-exposure development (Microposit MF-319 for 45–60 s).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tooling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wedge Error Parallelism** | $< 1.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Spherical air-bearing WEC gauge across 100 mm wafer |
| **Pre-Exposure Alignment Gap** | $10 \text{ to } 20$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Differential micrometer / piezo gap sensor |
| **Crosshair Overlay Offset ($X/Y$)** | $\le \pm 5.0$ (down to $\le 0.5$ in vacuum contact) | $\mu\text{m}$ | Split-field dual CMOS camera reticle vernier |
| **Cumulative UV Dose (365 nm)** | $120 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mJ/cm}^2$ | Calibrated 365 nm optical radiometer |
| **UV Beam Uniformity** | $> 95$ | $\%$ | Multi-point optical radiometer sensor array |

---

### Context Citations & References
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**: 10x Plan Achromat (NA 0.25) microscope objective resolution; Shipley 1813 spin-coated at 4000 RPM (~1.3 µm thickness); 365 nm i-line UV source; Gen 2 alignment target of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**: Chromium-on-quartz mask optics; Proximity separation air gap (10–20 µm); Piezo/micrometer 0.1 µm sensitivity; Fly's eye integrator (>95% beam uniformity); Shipley 1813 clear dose (120–150 mJ/cm²).
- **Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Standard Operating Procedure & Gap Control**: Spherical air-bearing Wedge Error Compensation (parallelism $< 1\ \mu\text{m}$); Split-field binocular microscope (10x/20x dual CMOS); Hard Contact chuck pressure (1.0 bar for ~1.0 µm resolution); Proximity alignment overlay precision ($\pm 2\text{ to } 5\ \mu\text{m}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Contact and proximity printing modes create an inherent trade-off between mechanical overlay drift and optical diffraction. Maintaining a Gen 2 ±5 µm alignment tolerance requires sub-micron differential micrometer gap control and decoupled kinematic stages to prevent Abbe error and parasitic theta-yaw during Z-axis clamping.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For Shipley 1813 positive resist (1.3 µm nominal thickness at 4000 RPM), post-soft-bake (115°C, 60s) standing wave effects and ambient humidity variations dictate tight actinic i-line dose control. Dose calibration must stay strictly within 120-150 mJ/cm² to prevent crosshair fiducial over-exposure or undercut profile collapse.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Microposit MF-319 developer and Shipley S1813 resist possess strict shelf-life limitations and require climate-controlled cold storage (4-10°C). Quartz chromium photomasks fabricated with standard multi-field fiducials face regional procurement lead times, necessitating robust in-house mask cleaning and anti-scratch inspection routines.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Fiducial crosshair registration is the baseline pacing item for all subsequent DRAM layer overlays. Cycle time from soft-bake through alignment, exposure, and MF-319 development must not exceed the specified queue window to avoid wafer re-work and maintain daily throughput.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Run-out and angular misalignment (theta-Z error) exceeding ±5 µm due to non-coplanar wedge error compensation (WEC) between mask and wafer chuck.
1. Photoresist micro-scratch defects and particulate transfer during hard contact mode causing open or short lines on subsequent active area patterning.
1. Exposure dose non-uniformity (>5% across wafer) or optical defocus causing distorted fiducial crosshairs and incomplete photoresist clearing during immersion development.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-01` | **Crosshair Fiducial Mark X/Y Overlay Vernier Registration** | Optical Inspection Microscope (10x Plan Achromat NA 0.25, 50x measuring objective, calibrated sub-micron digital reticle / CCD camera) | 1. Align wafer substrate fiducial crosshairs with photomask crosshairs under split-field/dual-magnification microscope. 2. Establish 15 µm proximity gap, correct wedge error, and engage soft-contact/proximity mode. 3. Lock micrometer stages and record relative X, Y, and Theta coordinates. 4. Expose at 365nm UV i-line with 135 mJ/cm² nominal dose. 5. Develop in MF-319 for 50 seconds, DI rinse 60 seconds, and N2 blow-dry. 6. Measure overlay offset across 5 points (Center, North, South, East, West) via vernier reticle. | `Total registration error |ΔX| and |ΔY| ≤ 5.0 µm across all 5 verification sites; rotational error |Δθ| ≤ 0.05 degrees.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-02` | **Actinic 365nm UV Dose Uniformity and Resist Clearance Linearity** | Calibrated 365nm Optical Radiometer / Power Meter with 2mm aperture sensor, Stylus Profilometer (0.01 µm vertical resolution) | 1. Measure optical power density (mW/cm²) at 9 points across the 100mm wafer exposure field. 2. Calculate spatial irradiance uniformity across the field. 3. Expose test wafer using 120-150 mJ/cm² dose steps. 4. Immerse in MF-319 for 45-60 seconds and quench in DI water. 5. Measure remaining resist step height at cleared fiducial features using stylus profilometer. | `Beam irradiance uniformity ≥ 95.0% across exposure field; complete resist clearance down to substrate (remaining step height = 0.00 ± 0.05 µm) with zero residual scumming.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: UV-blocking amber face shield or certified UV400 safety goggles, Chemical-resistant nitrile gloves (double-gloved, minimum 6 mil), Polypropylene chemical apron and cleanroom lab coat, Closed-toe chemical-resistant footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TMAH skin contact: Immediately flush affected skin with copious volumes of cold water for at least 15 minutes; seek emergency medical care immediately as TMAH is a neuromuscular toxin. For UV eye exposure: Flush eyes with saline/water, cover with sterile dressing, and obtain ophthalmologic evaluation. For inhalation of organic solvent fumes: Move victim to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet bench fume hood with laminar exhaust velocity of 80-100 LFM (0.4-0.5 m/s); yellow yellow-filtered cleanroom lighting (<500nm cutoff); dedicated acid/alkaline wet drain exhaust for developer station.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate TMAH aqueous basic developer waste into dedicated basic collection carboys; neutralize cautiously with dilute hydrochloric acid/sulfuric acid to pH 6-8 before discharge if permitted, or dispose via certified hazardous waste hauler. Collect spent solvent/photoresist rinses in separate flammable waste carboys.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate (PGMEA, Shipley 1813 solvent)** | `108-65-6` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `70-85%` |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH, Microposit MF-319 developer)** | `75-59-2` | Semiconductor Grade | `2.2-2.4%` |
| **Diazo Photoactive Compound (Naphthoquinone diazide ester)** | `68510-93-0` | Electronic Grade | `10-20%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly soft-baked (115°C, 60s) Shipley 1813 photoresist layer (1.3 µm ± 0.05 µm), defect-free and dehydrated on HMDS-primed silicon/oxide surface.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Exposed and latent-image patterned photoresist ready for immediate MF-319 development, free of ambient airborne amines and condensation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time causes ambient moisture absorption, airborne amine chemisorption resulting in photoresist surface crusting (T-topping), and dark decay of the photoactive compound leading to catastrophic resolution loss and critical dimension shifts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed precision optical alignment and 365nm UV exposure of Gen 2 fiducial crosshairs on 1.3 µm Shipley 1813 resist, achieving sub-5 µm overlay tolerance and uniform resist patterning for DRAM Foundation VN.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `overlay_registration_metrology_report.csv`
- [ ] `uv_radiometer_dose_uniformity_map.pdf`
- [ ] `fiducial_crosshair_microscopy_inspection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum absolute overlay alignment error across wafer fiducials** | `3.5` | ≤ 5.0 µm | Calibrated optical measuring reticle under 50x objective across 5 wafer sites |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Delivered actinic 365nm UV exposure dose** | `135` | ± 10 mJ/cm² | NIST-traceable 365nm optical radiometer measurement integrated over exposure duration |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-development crosshair trench bottom clearance depth** | `1.30` | ± 0.05 µm | Contact stylus profilometer step-height measurement against bare substrate |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five-point optical metrology confirms X/Y fiducial overlay error ≤ 5.0 µm with zero observable mechanical contact scratching on active area, confirmed complete MF-319 clearance without resist scumming, and sign-off recorded in cleanroom execution log.

Expose test wafer using 120-150 mJ/cm² dose steps. 4. Immerse in MF-319 for 45-60 seconds and quench in DI water. 5. Measure remaining resist step height at cleared fiducial features using stylus profilometer.

Chemical-resistant nitrile gloves (double-gloved, minimum 6 mil)
