# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dual-Axis Split-Field Optical Aligner Setup & Gap Micrometer Calibration
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Process Category:** Optics & Precision Alignment / Photolithography | **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   1. Mount Mask and    │
│         Wafer          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  2. Focus Split-Field  │
│         Optics         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3. Zero Gap and Set   │
│   Proximity 10-20 um   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      4. Dual-Axis      │
│   Fiducial Alignment   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      5. i-Line UV      │
│        Exposure        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate & Mask Loading**:
   - Secure the chromium-on-quartz photomask into the mask holder frame and verify vacuum chuck retention.
   - Load the silicon wafer spin-coated with Shipley 1813 photoresist (1.3 µm nominal thickness, soft-baked at 115°C for 60 s) onto the macroscopic vacuum stage.

2. **Split-Field Optical Head Positioning**:
   - Engage the split-field binocular microscope equipped with dual CMOS cameras and 10x Plan Achromat objectives (NA 0.25).
   - Adjust left and right optical objectives along the split-field travel rail to locate the left and right crosshair alignment fiducials simultaneously on the mask.
   - Adjust optical focus until the mask crosshairs are sharply imaged on both CMOS video displays.

3. **Gap Micrometer Zeroing & Proximity Clearance Setup**:
   - Slowly raise the wafer chuck using the three high-precision differential micrometers (or closed-loop piezo actuators with 0.1 µm sensitivity) until planar optical contact is established between mask and photoresist across all points without excessive force.
   - Record the micrometer zero-contact datum position across all three differential micrometers.
   - Back off all three differential micrometers uniformly to establish a calibrated proximity air gap of **10 to 20 µm** to eliminate mask scratch risks while preserving resolution.

4. **Dual-Axis Fiducial Crosshair Alignment**:
   - With split-field dual CMOS cameras displaying overlaid live video, manipulate the stage X, Y, and $\theta$ (theta) fine-adjustment controls.
   - Bring wafer alignment marks into registration with mask fiducial crosshairs on both split-field fields simultaneously until misalignment is within **±5 µm** (Gen 2 alignment tolerance).

5. **UV Exposure Execution**:
   - Measure 365 nm (i-line) UV LED array or 200W Mercury short-arc lamp intensity with an optical radiometer ($\text{mW/cm}^2$), verifying >95% beam uniformity across the wafer area via the fly's eye integrator optics.
   - Expose the substrate to deliver an optimum clear dose of **120 to 150 $\text{mJ/cm}^2$**.
   - Lower the stage, release vacuum chucks, and transfer the exposed wafer to development in Microposit MF-319 (45–60 s) followed by DI water rinse.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Proximity Air Gap Separation** | **10 to 20 µm** | Differential micrometers / piezo actuators (0.1 µm sensitivity) |
| **Fiducial Overlay Misalignment (Gen 2)** | **$\le \pm 5 \ \mu\text{m}$** (X and Y dual-axis) | Split-field dual CMOS camera crosshair overlay |
| **Exposure Dose (Shipley 1813, 1.3 µm)** | **120 to 150 $\text{mJ/cm}^2$** at 365 nm | Calibrated optical radiometer ($\text{mW/cm}^2 \times \text{time}$) |
| **Beam Uniformity** | **$> 95\%$** across wafer field | Multi-point radiometer measurement across fly's eye optics |

---

### Context Citations
- *Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose*: Proximity printing air gap (10–20 µm), 0.1 µm sensitivity differential micrometers/piezo actuators, fly's eye integrator lens beam uniformity (>95%), optical radiometer calibration, Shipley 1813 clear dose (120–150 mJ/cm²), and split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras.
- *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*: Shipley 1813 resist thickness (1.3 µm), 10x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25), 365 nm i-line UV source, soft bake (115°C for 60 s), MF-319 developer timing (45–60 s), and Gen 2 alignment tolerance (±5 µm).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) spherical air-bearing planarity must maintain parallelism under 1.0 µm across a 100mm substrate to prevent non-uniform gap distribution during proximity/soft-contact modes, which directly causes runout errors across split-field fields of view.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Gap micrometer zero-datum drift beyond 0.5 µm alters Fresnel diffraction edge fringe patterns for 180nm DRAM Gen 2 fiducial targets, shifting the optical threshold during split-field image cross-correlation and degrading overlay accuracy beyond the 0.5 µm vacuum contact budget.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring precision differential micrometers with 0.1 µm vernier graduations or sub-micron capacitive gap displacement sensors carries a 10-14 week lead time; second-source calibration targets (calibrated chrome-on-quartz Ronchi rulings) must be qualified immediately to avoid fab commissioning delays.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-axis split-field optical aligner calibration forms a hard critical-path gating milestone for active-area to wordline exposure runs; micrometer recalibration protocols must be streamlined into a repeatable <45 minute preventative maintenance routine.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. WEC spherical bearing mechanical lockup or air starvation leading to mask-wafer wedge pinching, photoresist scraping, and quartz mask cracking.
1. Proximity gap micrometer hysteresis and backlash exceeding 1.5 µm, causing asymmetric Fresnel diffraction and non-resolvable fiducial box-in-box structures.
1. Optical split-field camera axis parallax and thermal drift resulting in false overlay convergence and >1.0 µm systematic pattern displacement.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-1-01` | **Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) Parallelism & Planarity Metrology** | Dual capacitance displacement gauge bridge (Lion Precision / capacitive sensors), precision granite optical flat, 100mm quartz optical flat mask standard. | 1. Mount standard 100mm optical flat quartz mask into mask holder. 2. Load polished reference silicon wafer onto chuck. 3. Initiate automatic pneumatic WEC contact cycle to level wafer chuck against quartz reference. 4. Clamp spherical bearing lock. 5. Measure capacitive gap distance across 4 orthogonal quadrants at radius r=45mm using dual capacitive sensors. | `Total thickness variation / wedge error delta between opposite quadrants must be <= 1.0 µm across 100mm substrate; repeatability over 5 consecutive WEC cycles must be σ <= 0.2 µm.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-1-02` | **Split-Field Dual-Axis Proximity Gap Micrometer Linearity and Backlash Calibration** | Mitutoyo electronic digital micrometer heads (0.001 mm resolution), He-Ne laser displacement interferometer / calibrated capacitive gap sensor. | 1. Zero gap micrometers at physical contact datum (contact sensor trigger at 0.0 µm). 2. Step gap micrometers in 5.0 µm increments from 5.0 µm to 50.0 µm. 3. Record true displacement using interferometer. 4. Reverse direction from 50.0 µm down to 0.0 µm in 5.0 µm steps to measure mechanical backlash. 5. Perform crosshair overlay measurement on split-field CMOS display. | `Gap positioning error must be <= ±0.5 µm across the full 0–50 µm range; mechanical backlash on direction reversal must not exceed 0.3 µm; split-field optical axis misalignment delta <= 0.25 µm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-blocking safety eyewear (400nm cut-off), ESD-safe cleanroom smock and conductive footwear grounding straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Flush affected skin immediately with copious deionized water for 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. Eye contact: Flush open eyes at eyewash station for 15 minutes. Inhalation: Relocate operator immediately to fresh clean air zone outside lithography cleanroom.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Chemical optics-cleaning workstation equipped with continuous laminar downdraft cleanroom exhaust maintaining 0.45 m/s face velocity; VOC exhaust dedicated line active.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked cleanroom lint-free wipes in grounded, airtight, fire-rated stainless steel solvent waste bins. Collect spent solvent drain in flammables carboy for licensed halogen-free organic solvent treatment.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: HMDS primed and Shipley 1813 photoresist spin-coated (1.3 µm nominal) with soft-bake completed at 115 °C for 60 seconds.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Aligned and gap-calibrated substrate ready inside exposure chamber prior to UV i-line (365nm) shutter release.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time causes ambient airborne amine and moisture absorption into the photoresist surface, resulting in T-topping profile degradation and unrecoverable loss of critical dimension (CD) resolution.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Dual-axis split-field optical aligner fully calibrated for WEC wedge error parallelism (<1.0 µm across 100mm), proximity micrometer travel linearity (0–50 µm with <=0.5 µm error), and optical crosshair split-field registration.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `aligner_wec_parallelism_map.csv`
- [ ] `micrometer_gap_calibration_curve.pdf`
- [ ] `split_field_fiducial_overlay_verification.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) across 100mm wafer chuck area** | `0.80 µm` | <= 1.0 µm | Four-quadrant capacitive displacement gauge metrology |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Proximity gap micrometer positioning linearity over 10-30 µm operational span** | `0.20 µm` | <= 0.50 µm | He-Ne laser displacement interferometry against micrometer scale |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Split-field dual-objective optical overlay registration repeatability** | `0.35 µm` | <= 0.50 µm | Automated digital crosshair centroid calculation on 10 µm pitch quartz reference grid |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five consecutive WEC and gap micrometer positioning runs verify gap error <= 0.5 µm and overlay dispersion <= 0.5 µm across both split-field camera channels without mechanical binding or bearing pressure drops.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Microscopic Crosshair Fiducial Overlay Alignment & i-Line Dose Recipe Execution

**Document ID:** `SOP-PHOTO-GEN2-004`  
**Classification:** Generation 2 (µm) Photolithography  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip Architecture & Integration  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   WEC & Gap Setting:   │
│        10-30 µm        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Split-Field       │
│  Crosshair Alignment   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Contact Mode      │
│  Selection: Soft/Hard  │
│        Contact         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    i-Line Exposure:    │
│    120-150 mJ/cm² @    │
│         365nm          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  MF-319 Development:   │
│   45-60s & DI Water    │
│         Rinse          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Exposure Wafer Preparation
1. Verify wafer is spin-coated with Shipley 1813 photoresist at **4000 RPM** yielding **~1.3 µm** film thickness.
2. Confirm completion of soft bake at **115°C for 60 seconds** on a flat aluminum hot plate.

### Step 2: Substrate Loading & Wedge Error Compensation (WEC)
1. Load mask (chromium-on-quartz) into mask holder and place coated wafer onto the vacuum chuck.
2. Execute automated/manual Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) utilizing spherical air bearings to mechanically level the wafer chuck against the mask holder until parallelism is **< 1 µm** across the substrate.

### Step 3: Proximity Gap Setting & Split-Field Alignment
1. Separate mask and wafer into proximity alignment mode by establishing a calibrated air gap of **10 µm to 30 µm** (using differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators with **0.1 µm** sensitivity).
2. Engage split-field binocular optical microscope with **10x** (Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) or **20x** objectives paired with dual CMOS cameras.
3. Actuate X, Y, and $\theta$ micrometers to align wafer crosshair fiducial marks with corresponding mask crosshairs. Ensure overlay error is within **$\pm$2 µm to $\pm$5 µm** during proximity view.

### Step 4: Contact Clamping Mode Selection
*Select appropriate mode based on layer resolution requirement:*
- **Soft Contact:** Apply nitrogen pressure under chuck at **0.1 to 0.5 bar** (achieving **~1.5 µm** resolution).
- **Hard Contact:** Apply nitrogen pressure under chuck at **1.0 bar** (achieving **~1.0 µm** resolution).
- **Vacuum Contact:** Clamp to vacuum contact for maximum resolution and overlay precision ($\le$ **0.5 µm**).

### Step 5: UV Exposure Recipe Execution
1. Verify UV source intensity using an optical radiometer calibrated at **365 nm** (i-line LED array or 200W Mercury short-arc lamp with fly's eye integrator achieving **> 95% beam uniformity**).
2. Execute UV exposure to deliver a cumulative clear dose of **120 mJ/cm² to 150 mJ/cm²**.

### Step 6: Post-Exposure Development & Rinse
1. Immerse wafer in **Microposit MF-319** developer for **45 to 60 seconds**.
2. Immediately transfer to a rigorous deionized (DI) water bath and rinse thoroughly to quench development.
3. Dry wafer with filtered dry nitrogen gas ($N_2$).

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Inspection / Measurement Method | Target Metric |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wedge Error Parallelism** | Chuck WEC displacement sensors across substrate | **$< 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$** |
| **Overlay Alignment Accuracy** | Split-field optical vernier / crosshair measurement | **$\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$** (Vacuum Contact) / **$\pm 2\text{ to } 5\ \mu\text{m}$** (Proximity) |
| **i-Line Exposure Dose** | Calibrated optical radiometer at 365 nm | **$120\text{ to } 150\ \text{mJ/cm}^2$** |
| **Optical Beam Uniformity** | Multi-point radiometer across wafer plane | **$> 95\%$** |

---

## 3. Literature Citations & Reference Context

- **Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Standard Operating Procedure & Gap Control:**
  - Parallelism via spherical air bearings WEC ($< 1\ \mu\text{m}$ across 100mm wafers).
  - Split-field microscope (5x, 10x, 20x objectives).
  - Clamping parameters: Proximity gap (10–30 $\mu\text{m}$), Soft contact ($0.1–0.5\text{ bar}$), Hard contact ($1.0\text{ bar}$), and Vacuum contact overlay precision ($\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose:**
  - Gap actuation: Piezo actuators/micrometers with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity.
  - Optics: 365nm source with fly's eye integrator ($>95\%$ beam uniformity).
  - Exposure dose: Shipley 1813 optimum clear dose of $120–150\ \text{mJ/cm}^2$.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
  - Resist coating: Shipley 1813 at 4000 RPM ($\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$).
  - Soft bake: $115^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 s.
  - Development: Microposit MF-319 for 45–60 s followed by DI water rinse.
  - Resolution objective: 10x Plan Achromat (NA 0.25) with Gen 2 overlay tolerance ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The kinematic wedge error compensation (WEC) and pneumatic chuck clamping introduce dynamic mechanical tilt if nitrogen backpressure fluctuates by more than ±0.05 bar during transition from alignment gap to soft contact mode. Furthermore, thermal dissipation from the high-power 365nm i-line UV source can induce local mask-wafer expansion mismatch, degrading Gen 2 overlay registration across a 100mm substrate unless exposure shutter sequencing and stage thermal stabilization are strictly synchronized.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Operating Shipley 1813 at ~1.3 µm thickness with an MF-319 TMAH-based developer requires rigorous control of the post-exposure delay and exposure dose. The Fresnel diffraction limit in proximity mode (~2.5 µm) makes resolving 1-2 µm fiducial crosshairs marginal; soft contact (0.3 bar N2) is mandatory to hit ≤ 1.5 µm line-edge fidelity. Without precise dual-objective split-field optical parity and anti-backlash micrometer stages, rotational theta error will dominate overlay offset.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Microposit MF-319 developer and Shipley S1813 positive resist face strict regional hazardous material shipping restrictions and shelf-life constraints (typically 12 months at 10-25°C). Sourcing quartz or soda-lime chrome master reticles with sub-micron fiducial grid precision (<0.25 µm placement error) from local tooling vendors represents a high lead-time risk (6-8 weeks) and single-point supply vulnerability.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Balancing research fabrication cycle-time against yield loss necessitates a gating check between soft bake and exposure. Operator fatigue during manual split-field crosshair alignment can bottleneck wafer throughput to under 4 wafers per hour, directly impacting the Gen 2 milestone timeline. An automated machine-vision overlay confirmation routine must be established before running multi-die array lots.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Crosshair vernier misregistration exceeding ±3.0 µm due to optical parallax, stage backlash, or thermal runout between mask and wafer chuck.
1. Photoresist bridging, scumming, or lift-off at fiducial intersections caused by i-line underexposure (<120 mJ/cm²) or post-exposure delay exceeding queue time.
1. Mechanical mask-to-substrate scratch damage and particle transfer during wedge error compensation leveling under excessive contact pressure (>0.5 bar).

Load substrate onto vacuum chuck and execute pneumatic WEC leveling cycle against reference mask at 0.2 bar N2 gap. 2. Separate chuck to 20 µm proximity gap and position left/right split-field objectives over primary wafer-to-mask alignment crosshairs. 3. Actuate X, Y, and Theta fine micrometer controls to superimpose substrate fiducial crosshairs inside the 5.0 µm mask alignment box. 4. Apply soft contact mode (0.3 bar N2 chuck pressure) and capture digital microscopy frames at 4 cardinal wafer coordinates (North, South, East, West). 5. Measure centroid overlay shift (dx, dy) and rotational error (dtheta) against reference coordinate crosshairs. | `Total planar overlay misalignment vector sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) <= 2.5 µm across all four cardinal points, and rotational theta misalignment <= 0.05 degrees.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-2-02` | **i-Line UV Exposure Dose and Developed Fiducial Critical Dimension (CD) Uniformity** | Calibrated 365nm optical radiometer/dosimeter probe, automated hot plate, spin-rinse developer bath, and optical surface profilometer / CD metrology microscope. | 1. Verify 365nm incident irradiance using the calibrated optical radiometer across 5 chuck zones (center and 4 quadrants). 2. Expose the soft-contacted wafer to a nominal target dose of 150 mJ/cm² (10.0 s exposure time at 15.0 mW/cm²). 3. Quench development immediately in DI water cascade bath for 60 s, followed by filtered N2 blow-dry at 2.0 bar. 5. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Yellow-room compatible UV-blocking safety goggles (ANSI Z87.1 certified), Chemical-resistant nitrile cleanroom gloves (double-gloving required, minimum 6 mil thickness), Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom coat and polypropylene apron, Face shield during liquid chemical transfer and developer bath preparation
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Immediately flush affected area with copious laminar flow DI water for at least 15 minutes while stripping contaminated clothing. TMAH is a potent neurotoxin and dermal hazard; seek immediate professional emergency medical care. Eye contact: Irrigate eyes at eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Inhalation: Relocate victim to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated chemical wet-bench laminar fume exhaust with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) linked to acid/base scrubber; aligner housing connected to negative-pressure UV ozone/solvent exhaust ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate spent TMAH aqueous developer waste in designated basic carboys; neutralize cautiously with dilute hydrochloric acid or citric acid in a dedicated waste treatment tank to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to certified hazardous waste disposal. Do NOT mix with organic solvents.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1-Methoxy-2-propyl acetate (PGMEA, Shipley 1813 solvent)** | `108-65-6` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `70-85%` |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH, Microposit MF-319 active base)** | `75-59-2` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade | `2.2-2.4%` |
| **Diazonaphthoquinone (DNQ) Photoactive Compound** | `68510-93-0` | Analytical Grade | `1-5%` |
| **Cresol Novolak Resin** | `117520-84-0` | Semiconductor Grade | `10-25%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: HMDS-primed silicon/oxide surface coated with 1.3 µm Shipley 1813 resist, freshly soft-baked at 115°C for 60 s, free of particulate contamination (>0.3 µm count < 5/wafer).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Patterned, exposed, developed, and DI-quenched photoresist with clear fiducials and active alignment features, post-baked at 120°C or ready for immediate etch/implant.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption and airborne amine contamination degrade photoactive compound sensitivity, causing unexposed resist erosion, insoluble footing (T-topping), and unacceptable CD drift > 0.8 µm.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful optical alignment of microscopic reticle crosshairs to pre-patterned wafer fiducials within Gen 2 tolerances (<= 2.5 µm overlay error) and execution of an i-line UV exposure/development cycle yielding crisp 3.0 µm fiducial geometries without micro-bridging or resist scumming.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `overlay_misalignment_vector_report_gen2.csv`
- [ ] `iline_dose_and_cd_metrology_inspection.pdf`
- [ ] `fiducial_crosshair_splitfield_micrograph.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| `ASSERT-02` | **Developed 3.0 µm fiducial crosshair critical dimension line-width** | `3.0 µm` | ± 0.3 µm | Calibrated optical CD metrology microscope at 50x magnification across 9 test sites. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Exposure dose delivery at 365nm wavelength across substrate plane** | `150.0 mJ/cm²` | ± 5.0 mJ/cm² | Multi-point calibrated 365nm UV optical radiometer integration over active exposure duration. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit signoff requires verified overlay error <= 2.5 µm at all 4 cardinal fiducials, CD variation within ± 0.3 µm, complete absence of resist scumming confirmed by darkfield microscopy, and delivery of all three artifacts signed by the Photolithography Lead.

critics.systems_engineer: The kinematic wedge error compensation (WEC) and pneumatic chuck clamping introduce dynamic mechanical tilt if nitrogen backpressure fluctuates by more than ±0.05 bar during transition from alignment gap to soft contact mode. Furthermore, thermal dissipation from the high-power 365nm i-line UV source can induce local mask-wafer expansion mismatch, degrading Gen 2 overlay registration across a 100mm substrate unless exposure shutter sequencing and stage thermal stabilization are strictly synchronized.
critics.domain_expert: Operating Shipley 1813 at ~1.3 µm thickness with an MF-319 TMAH-based developer requires rigorous control of the post-exposure delay and exposure dose. The Fresnel diffraction limit in proximity mode (~2.5 µm) makes resolving 1-2 µm fiducial crosshairs marginal; soft contact (0.3 bar N2) is mandatory to hit ≤ 1.5 µm line-edge fidelity. Without precise dual-objective split-field optical parity and anti-backlash micrometer stages, rotational theta error will dominate overlay offset.
critics.supply_chain: Microposit MF-319 developer and Shipley S1813 positive resist face strict regional hazardous material shipping restrictions and shelf-life constraints (typically 12 months at 10-25°C). Sourcing quartz or soda-lime chrome master reticles with sub-micron fiducial grid precision (<0.25 µm placement error) from local tooling vendors represents a high lead-time risk (6-8 weeks) and single-point supply vulnerability.
critics.laya_pm: Balancing research fabrication cycle-time against yield loss necessitates a gating check between soft bake and exposure. Operator fatigue during manual split-field crosshair alignment can bottleneck wafer throughput to under 4 wafers per hour, directly impacting the Gen 2 milestone timeline. An automated machine-vision overlay confirmation routine must be established before running multi-die array lots.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Fiducial Overlay Crosshair Micro-Positioning & Proximity Gap Calibration

- **Discipline**: Optics & Precision Alignment / Photolithography
- **Target Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Reference Document**: [sop_fiducial_overlay_crosshair_micro_positioning_proximity_gap_calibration.md](docs/sop_fiducial_overlay_crosshair_micro_positioning_proximity_gap_calibration.md)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["1. Stage Isolation & Mechanical Initialization (MGN12H / NEMA 17)"] --> B["2. Substrate & Mask Loading (Proximity Safety Gap >100 µm)"]
    B --> C["3. Dual-Field Crosshair Optical Acquisition (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25)"]
    C --> D["4. Proximity Gap Calibration (10–20 µm Air Gap via Piezo/Micrometers)"]
    D --> E["5. In-Plane Micro-Positioning (X/Y/Theta to ±5 µm Gen 2 Tolerance)"]
    E --> F["6. Alignment Lock & Drift Check (<0.1 µm Actuator Sensitivity)"]
    F --> G["7. Handoff to 365nm i-Line Exposure Recipe (120–150 mJ/cm²)"]
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Stage Isolation & Motion System Initialization**:
   - Verify the 4040 aluminum extrusion stage assembly is seated on neoprene dampers or sorbothane pads isolating environmental vibrations $>30\text{ Hz}$.
   - Home the MGN12H precision linear guide rails driven by NEMA 17 stepper motors ($1/16$ microstepping) and anti-backlash / C7 rolled ball screws; verify closed-loop magnetic/optical encoder feedback ($1\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ resolution).
2. **Substrate & Mask Loading**:
   - Secure the wafer (spin-coated with Shipley 1813 at 4000 RPM to $\sim 1.3\text{ }\mu\text{m}$, soft-baked at $115^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ s}$) onto the stage vacuum chuck.
   - Insert the chromium-on-quartz mask into the aligner holder with chrome pattern facing the resist, maintaining an initial vertical separation $>100\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to prevent contact damage.
3. **Microscopic Crosshair Acquisition**:
   - Align split-field or dual-objective optics (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) over wafer and mask crosshair fiducial marks under non-actinic yellow light.
   - Coarse-align the substrate stage to center wafer fiducial crosshairs within the optical field of view.
4. **Proximity Gap Calibration**:
   - Lower the mask relative to the wafer using three differential micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators ($0.1\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ sensitivity).
   - Set and level a uniform proximity air gap of **$10\text{ to }20\text{ }\mu\text{m}$** across the wafer surface, eliminating mechanical scratch defects while maintaining $\sim 2\text{--}3\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ diffraction-limited resolution.
5. **In-Plane Overlay Micro-Positioning**:
   - Adjust fine $X$, $Y$, and $\theta$ (rotation) controls to register the mask crosshairs concentric with the substrate fiducials.
   - Confirm in-plane overlay alignment error is reduced within the Gen 2 tolerance of **$\pm 5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$**.
6. **Alignment Lock & Exposure Readiness**:
   - Engage mechanical axis locks/clamps; monitor crosshairs for $10\text{ s}$ to confirm zero actuator creep or drift.
   - Handoff substrate to the 365nm i-line exposure cycle ($120\text{--}150\text{ mJ/cm}^2$ dose, $>95\%$ beam uniformity).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **In-Plane Overlay Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical microscope (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) fiducial crosshair metrology |
| **Proximity Air Gap** | $10 \text{ to } 20$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Closed-loop piezo actuators / differential micrometers ($0.1\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ sensitivity) |
| **Stage Travel Straightness** | $< 5$ | $\mu\text{m} / 100\text{ mm}$ | MGN12H linear guide rail calibration / optical linear encoder |
| **Vibration Isolation Cutoff Frequency** | $> 30$ | $\text{Hz}$ | Sorbothane / neoprene damping pad dynamic attenuation profile |

---

### 3. Literature Citations

- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**: 10x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25) for micron-scale feature resolution; Shipley 1813 resist ($1.3\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ film @ 4000 RPM, $115^\circ\text{C}$ soft bake for $60\text{ s}$); Gen 2 alignment target tolerance of $\pm 5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ (improved from Gen 1 $\pm 100\text{ }\mu\text{m}$).
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**: Proximity printing mode gap of $10\text{ to }20\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to prevent mask scratch defects; 3-point differential micrometers / closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ sensitivity; 365nm i-line optical radiometer calibration for $120\text{--}150\text{ mJ/cm}^2$ dose.
- **Precision Linear Stage Design & Vibration Damping**: 4040 aluminum extrusion frame paired with MGN12H guide rails ($<5\text{ }\mu\text{m} / 100\text{ mm}$ straightness); NEMA 17 steppers with $1/16$ microstepping driving C7 rolled ball screws / anti-backlash lead screws; neoprene/sorbothane vibration damping above $30\text{ Hz}$; $1\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ resolution encoder feedback.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) spherical air-bearing planarity must decouple mechanical leveling torque from Z-axis proximity gap micrometer indexing; uncontrolled clamping friction during WEC lock-down introduces up to 1.8 um parasitic lateral shear across a 100mm wafer chuck.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Operating in proximity exposure mode (10-20 um gap) eliminates photoresist abrasion on Shipley 1813 but induces Fresnel diffraction fringing that blurs crosshair fiducial edges; split-field optical focus must use dual-plane digital depth tracking to prevent manual Vernier parallax errors exceeding the 0.5 um overlay budget.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-vendor reliance on Karl Suss calibrated optical glass reference reticles and high-grade quartz mask blanks poses lead-time risks; procurement must secure local backup optical standards and maintain replacement spherical air-bearing seal rings with certified flatness < 0.25 um.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The micro-positioning and proximity calibration step acts as the primary pacing bottleneck for the Gen 2 DRAM lithography loop; manual split-field operator alignment must be standardized to <= 180 seconds per wafer to maintain target pilot-line throughput without violating pre-exposure softbake Q-time.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. WEC spherical bearing failure or particulate contamination causing localized hard contact during proximity setting, resulting in chromium mask scratching and photoresist tearing.
1. Optical diffraction-induced crosshair blur in split-field CMOS channels leading to miscalculated centroid overlay vector and layer-to-layer shift exceeding 1.5 um.
1. Piezo/micrometer Z-axis gap drift during UV lamp thermal stabilization, causing non-uniform Fresnel fringing and linewidth non-uniformity across the 100mm substrate.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-2-1-01` | **Wedge Error Compensation Parallelism & Proximity Gap Clearance Verification** | Karl Suss MA6 Split-Field Dual-CMOS Microscope, 3-point capacitive gap sensor array / optical laser triangulation profilometer, calibrated 100mm test quartz reticle. | 1. Load calibrated flat optical reticle and 100mm test substrate. 2. Initiate WEC pneumatic cycle at 0.5 bar N2 to achieve mechanical planarization. 3. Lock spherical air bearing. 4. Commanded Z-axis stage to 15.0 um proximity gap setpoint. 5. Measure absolute physical separation across 3 radial capacitive/optical probe locations (0 deg, 120 deg, 240 deg at r = 40mm). | `Total wedge parallelism error <= 1.0 um across 100mm span; absolute proximity gap at all 3 measurement sites must fall within 15.0 +/- 1.0 um.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-2-1-02` | **Split-Field Fiducial Crosshair Micro-Positioning Overlay Accuracy** | Dual-objective split-field binocular CMOS microscope (20x optical objectives, 0.40 NA), digital image pattern recognition centroid software. | 1. Position left and right split-field objectives over outer fiducial marks at +/- 40mm chord. 2. Acquire digital video stream of mask crosshairs and wafer crosshairs. 3. Execute micro-positioning micrometer translation in X, Y, and Theta. 4. Perform digital centroid extraction on both left and right split-field channels. 5. Record residual vector delta (dX, dY). | `Composite fiducial alignment vector error sqrt(dX^2 + dY^2) <= 0.50 um at both split-field inspection nodes.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (chemical resistant), UV-400 blocking amber safety glasses / face shield, Antistatic ESD cleanroom smock and hood, Chemical splash apron for solvent wipe maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with cleaning solvents, flush immediately with copious sterile deionized water for at least 15 minutes at eyewash station. In event of UV ocular flash, seek immediate medical evaluation and rest eyes in shaded environment.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated lithography wet hood local exhaust ventilation with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); laminar downflow hood certified Class 100 / ISO 5.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent-soaked wipes and IPA rinse effluents in dedicated flammable hazardous waste canisters; seal and manifest under RCRA solvent waste stream guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / MOS) | `>= 99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (N2 Compressed)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP Grade 5.0) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly softbaked Shipley 1813 positive photoresist (1.3 um nominal thickness, 95 deg C for 60s hotplate), free of ambient particulate contamination or surface skinning.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Aligned and gap-calibrated substrate locked in exposure chuck ready for immediate 365nm i-line dosage without airborne particulate deposition or thermal boundary shift.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time causes ambient airborne amine absorption resulting in photoresist surface crosslinking (T-topping defect) and solvent evaporation altering post-exposure dissolution kinetics.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful mechanical wedge error compensation planarity lock and sub-micron crosshair fiducial overlay alignment under 15 um proximity gap separation without physical contact or mask damage.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WEC_Planarity_Gap_Calibration_Log.csv`
- [ ] `Split_Field_Fiducial_Overlay_Verification_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Dual_Objective_Crosshair_Centroid_Capture.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Proximity gap separation distance across 100mm wafer field** | `15.0 um` | +/- 1.0 um | Three-point calibrated non-contact capacitive gap sensor array readout. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) residual tilt planarity** | `0.6 um` | <= 1.0 um total indicator reading across 100mm diameter | Multi-point laser surface profilometry. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Fiducial overlay alignment positional vector delta** | `0.35 um` | <= 0.50 um | Digital image centroid cross-correlation on split-field 20x CMOS channels. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher verifies WEC parallelism <= 1.0 um, proximity gap stable at 15.0 +/- 1.0 um, and fiducial crosshair overlay offset <= 0.50 um across dual split-field nodes with all three artifacts cryptographically archived.

testcases.instrumentation: Karl Suss MA6 Split-Field Dual-CMOS Microscope, 3-point capacitive gap sensor array / optical laser triangulation profilometer, calibrated 100mm test quartz reticle.
testcases.pre_conditions: Class 100 cleanroom ambient (21 +/- 0.5 deg C, 45 +/- 5% RH); chuck spherical bearing cleaned with filtered IPA; mask holder clamped and zero-referenced.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load calibrated flat optical reticle and 100mm test substrate. 2. Initiate WEC pneumatic cycle at 0.5 bar N2 to achieve mechanical planarization. 3. Lock spherical air bearing. 4. Commanded Z-axis stage to 15.0 um proximity gap setpoint. 5. Measure absolute physical separation across 3 radial capacitive/optical probe locations (0 deg, 120 deg, 240 deg at r = 40mm).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total wedge parallelism error <= 1.0 um across 100mm span; absolute proximity gap at all 3 measurement sites must fall within 15.0 +/- 1.0 um.

testcases.title: Split-Field Fiducial Crosshair Micro-Positioning Overlay Accuracy
testcases.instrumentation: Dual-objective split-field binocular CMOS microscope (20x optical objectives, 0.40 NA), digital image pattern recognition centroid software.
testcases.pre_conditions: WEC verified; proximity gap locked at 15.0 um; substrate pre-patterned with First-Metal/Zero-layer chromium fiducial crosshairs.
testcases.procedure: 1. Position left and right split-field objectives over outer fiducial marks at +/- 40mm chord. 2. Acquire digital video stream of mask crosshairs and wafer crosshairs. 3. Execute micro-positioning micrometer translation in X, Y, and Theta. 4. Perform digital centroid extraction on both left and right split-field channels. 5. Record residual vector delta (dX, dY).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Composite fiducial alignment vector error sqrt(dX^2 + dY^2) <= 0.50 um at both split-field inspection nodes.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-PHOTO-202: 365nm i-Line Radiometer Dose Calibration & Contact UV Exposure Execution

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   UV Source Warmup &   │
│     Stabilization      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Radiometer Intensity  │
│      Calibration       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Exposure Time      │
│      Calculation       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Substrate Loading &   │
│       Soft Bake        │
│      Verification      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Wedge Error       │
│     Compensation &     │
│      Contact Mode      │
│       Engagement       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Shuttered 365nm UV   │
│        Exposure        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Post-Exposure      │
│       Unclamp &        │
│      Development       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Light Source Warm-up & Fly's Eye Beam Check**
   - Power on the 365nm (i-line) high-power UV LED array or 200W Mercury short-arc lamp. Allow a minimum of 15 minutes for thermal stabilization.
   - Verify that the fly's eye integrator lens is aligned to deliver beam uniformity across the wafer exposure field.

2. **Optical Radiometer Measurement & Dose Calculation**
   - Place a calibrated optical radiometer detector head centered on the mask aligner chuck surface under the illumination field.
   - Trigger the optical shutter and measure the optical power density $I$ in $\text{mW/cm}^2$.
   - Calculate exposure time $t_{\text{exp}}$ based on target clear dose $D = 120\text{–}150\text{ mJ/cm}^2$ for the $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ Shipley 1813 film:
     $$t_{\text{exp}}\ (\text{s}) = \frac{D\ (\text{mJ/cm}^2)}{I\ (\text{mW/cm}^2)}$$

3. **Substrate Preparation & Loading**
   - Confirm substrate pre-processing: Shipley 1813 spin-coated at 4000 RPM (yielding $\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thickness) and soft-baked at $115^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 seconds on a flat aluminum hot plate.
   - Secure the wafer onto the vacuum chuck.

4. **Contact Gap Setting & Wedge Error Compensation**
   - Load the chromium-on-quartz mask into the mask holder.
   - Use the three differential micrometers (or closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity) to bring the wafer into physical contact printing mode with zero gap.
   - Confirm fiducial crosshair overlay registration to within Gen 2 alignment specifications ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).

5. **UV Exposure Execution**
   - Set the shutter timer to the calculated $t_{\text{exp}}$.
   - Execute the 365nm i-line exposure cycle while maintaining contact mode.
   - Immediately disengage chuck vacuum and lower the z-stage to avoid abrasive scratch defects on the chromium mask.

6. **Post-Exposure Development**
   - Transfer wafer to chemical wet bench. Immerse in Microposit MF-319 developer for 45–60 seconds with gentle agitation.
   - Submerge immediately in a cascading deionized (DI) water rinse tank for 60 seconds and blow dry with filtered $\text{N}_2$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                  Acceptance Criteria Metric Targets    
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░                                     │
Align Tolerance┤░░                                     │
               │▒                                      │
Gap Sensitivity┤▒                                      │
  Exposure Dose┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Beam Uniformity┤████████████████████████████           │
               │████████████████████████████           │
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
               0.0      33.8     67.5      101.2  135.0 
```

| Parameter | Acceptance Metric | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Exposure Dose ($D$)** | **$120\text{ to }150\text{ mJ/cm}^2$** | Calibrated optical radiometer ($\text{mW/cm}^2$) $\times$ exposure time ($\text{s}$) |
| **Beam Uniformity** | **$> 95\%$ across wafer** | Multi-point radiometer scan through fly's eye integrator optics |
| **Actuator Gap Sensitivity** | **$0.1\ \mu\text{m}$** | Closed-loop piezo actuators / differential micrometers |
| **Gen 2 Alignment Tolerance**| **$\le \pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$** | Split-field optical microscope overlay crosshair reading |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Exposure Dose & Optics**: *Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose*
  - 365nm i-line source / 200W Mercury short-arc lamp coupled through fly's eye integrator lens for $>95\%$ beam uniformity.
  - Shipley 1813 ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thickness) optimum clear dose: $120\text{–}150\text{ mJ/cm}^2$.
  - Gap setting controlled via differential micrometers/piezo actuators with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity.
- **Resist Processing & Alignment Tolerances**: *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*
  - Spin coat: 4000 RPM ($\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ resist thickness).
  - Soft bake: $115^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 seconds on flat aluminum hot plate.
  - Development: Microposit MF-319 for 45–60 seconds, followed by DI water rinse.
  - Gen 2 alignment target: $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Contact printing presents an unavoidable trade-off between sub-micron resolution and particulate defect propagation across repeated contact cycles. While soft/hard contact achieves near-zero effective exposure gap, particle entrapment creates catastrophic localized mask stand-off gaps exceeding 5 um, collapsing resolution to diffraction-limited fringe blur across adjacent DRAM cell patterns. Closed-loop optical radiometer dose calibration must strictly account for non-uniformity across the exposure plane before contact vacuum clamping.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Shipley 1813 (diazonaphthoquinone/novolak chemistry) demands an exact clearing dose (D_clear) between 120 and 150 mJ/cm^2 at 365 nm for 1.3 um nominal film thickness. If the 365nm LED array irradiance drifts or exhibits >5% spatial non-uniformity across the 100mm exposure field, critical dimension (CD) variations on 180nm node active-area/capacitor fiducial structures will exceed allowable photolithographic tolerances. Contact force calibration must be tuned to prevent mechanical shearing or micro-delamination of the unbaked resist film.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-wavelength calibrated 365nm radiometer detector heads (such as OAI or Thorlabs S401C/PM100D combinations) face restricted supply chains and calibration drift if uncertified. Sourcing semiconductor-grade quartz/chromium test masks with sub-micron fiducials requires verified local optical lithography vendors. Alternative high-power 365nm UV LED arrays must maintain tight binning (+/-2nm peak wavelength) to prevent out-of-band absorption in the novolak resin matrix.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The sequence from hot-plate soft bake completion to UV contact exposure and post-exposure puddle development is an extremely tight operational bottleneck. Process queue times (Q-time) must not exceed 30 minutes in ambient cleanroom air to prevent moisture re-absorption into the DNQ photoactive compound, which causes uncalibrated chemical dissolution kinetics and variable undercut profiles.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Contact-induced mechanical mask abrasion or photoresist pick-up transferring dried polymer residue to subsequent exposure sites.
1. Optical under-dose or intensity non-uniformity causing incomplete DNQ photolysis to indene carboxylic acid, leaving insoluble resist footing in micron-scale DRAM capacitor contact holes.
1. Excessive mechanical contact clamp force cracking brittle silicon substrate edges or distorting quartz mask plate flatness beyond 0.5 um runout.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-2-2-01` | **365nm i-Line Exposure Plane Irradiance & 9-Point Spatial Uniformity Calibration** | Calibrated NIST-traceable Optical Radiometer with 365nm narrow-band detector probe (OAI 306 or equivalent, 0.01 mW/cm^2 resolution), 100mm vacuum chuck fixture. | 1. Position the 365nm radiometer detector probe at the center of the exposure chuck at wafer height plane. 2. Trigger a 10.0-second continuous UV shutter exposure and record steady-state irradiance (mW/cm^2). 3. Map an orthogonal 9-point grid across the 100mm diameter exposure field (center, 4 points at 30mm radius, 4 points at 45mm radius). 4. Calculate mean irradiance (I_mean) and spatial non-uniformity percentage: Non-uniformity = [(I_max - I_min) / (2 * I_mean)] * 100%. 5. Compute recipe shutter time: T_exp = Target_Dose (135 mJ/cm^2) / I_mean. | `Central irradiance must be >= 15.00 mW/cm^2; spatial non-uniformity across all 9 measurement points must be <= 4.50%; calculated shutter time repeatability across 5 consecutive pulses must be within +/- 0.05 seconds.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-2-2-02` | **Hard Contact Alignment Vacuum Seal & Exposure Dose Print Verification** | Differential dial indicator / micrometer stage (0.1 um resolution), contact vacuum regulator/gauge, digital optical metallurgical microscope (100x-1000x magnification with calibrated reticle). | 1. Load wafer onto aligner chuck and position chromium contact mask over alignment markers. 2. Bring wafer into soft proximity, inspect fiducials, and engage hard vacuum contact mode (-60 kPa vacuum seal). 3. Verify vacuum gauge stability for 10 seconds. 4. Trigger exposure shutter with calibrated dose (135 mJ/cm^2). 5. Disengage vacuum, perform nitrogen purge separation, develop wafer in MF-319 for 50 seconds, DI rinse, and dry with filtered N2. 6. Inspect 5 um fiducial crosshairs and resolution test lines under metallurgical optical microscope. | `Vacuum chuck seal must sustain -60.0 +/- 5.0 kPa without leakage (> 2.0 kPa/min decay); developed resolution lines must show complete clear of 2.0 um pitch gratings with zero visible resist bridging, residue scumming, or mechanical scratch tearing under 500x magnification.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: EN 166 certified UV-400 blocking wraparound face shield or safety glasses, Double-layered disposable nitrile cleanroom gloves (minimum 5 mil thickness), Anti-static polypropylene cleanroom frock/smock with ESD wrist grounding, N95/VOC chemical vapor half-face respirator during manual solvent and developer handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Immediately strip contaminated clothing and flush skin with copious volume of running water for at least 15 minutes; for TMAH exposure, seek immediate emergency medical evaluation as TMAH is a systemic neurotoxin and cardiac depressant. Eye exposure: Flush eyes at eye-wash station holding eyelids open for minimum 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move subject to fresh air immediately. UV eye exposure (photokeratitis): Rest in darkened room, apply cold compress, seek ophthalmologic assessment.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation must occur inside a dedicated laminar flow yellow-light cleanroom hood equipped with active chemical fume extraction providing face velocity of 0.45 to 0.55 m/s (90-110 FPM) directly exhausted to certified scrubbers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent developer solution containing TMAH must be segregated into designated basic solvent containers, neutralized to pH 6.0-9.0 with dilute sulfuric or hydrochloric acid before specialized hazardous waste disposal; organic solvent rinses and expired resist must be collected into sealed hazardous flammable waste carboys.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate (PGMEA / Shipley 1813 solvent)** | `108-65-6` | Electronic Grade / VLSI | `>= 80.0%` |
| **Mixed cresol novolak resin** | `117520-84-0` | Semiconductor Grade | `10.0 - 20.0%` |
| **Diazo photoactive compound (DNQ ester)** | `68510-93-0` | Semiconductor Grade | `1.0 - 5.0%` |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH in MF-319 developer)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade | `2.2 - 2.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly soft-baked Shipley 1813 film on dehydrated/HMDS-primed silicon wafer, nominal thickness 1.30 um +/- 0.05 um, free of pinholes, edge bead cleaned, ambient temperature cooled (21-23 deg C).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Contact UV-exposed photoresist latent image exhibiting distinct refractive index differential at crosshair alignment marks, dry, un-scratched, awaiting aqueous alkaline development.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive atmospheric exposure causes humidity-driven water absorption into novolak/DNQ polymer matrix causing erratic unexposed dissolution, nitrogen micro-bubble bubbling during delayed exposure, and severe critical dimension enlargement causing loss of DRAM cell capacitor contact isolation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified calibration of 365nm UV source irradiance uniformity, precise clear-dose exposure recipe execution (135 mJ/cm^2), and defect-free hard contact optical alignment print transferring 2 um resolution structures into Shipley 1813 positive photoresist.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dose_calibration_9point_map.csv`
- [ ] `contact_exposure_recipe_execution_log.pdf`
- [ ] `fiducial_crosshair_micrograph_500x.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **365nm i-Line beam spatial non-uniformity across 100mm diameter chuck** | `3.20%` | <= 4.50% | NIST-traceable 9-point grid optical radiometer surface scan calculation |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Contact exposure delivered dose accuracy** | `135.0 mJ/cm^2` | +/- 3.0 mJ/cm^2 | Calibrated shutter timing multiplied by central radiometer steady-state flux integration |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Contact vacuum pressure during exposure sequence** | `-60.0 kPa` | +/- 5.0 kPa | In-line closed-loop pressure transducer / vacuum regulator recording |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Completion of 9-point radiometer dose calibration with non-uniformity <= 4.50%, verified vacuum contact seal holding at -60 +/- 5 kPa, execution of 135 mJ/cm^2 UV dose with zero mechanical resist tearing, and confirmation of sharp, scum-free developed 2 um features under metallurgical optical microscopy.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## MF-319 Immersion Development & Optical Overlay Vernier Misalignment Metrology

- **Module**: Metrology / Photolithography
- **Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Target Substrate**: Shipley 1813 Photoresist (~$1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ film thickness) on patterned silicon wafer

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  4. Split-Field / 10x  │
│   Optical Metrology    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       5. Vernier       │
│      Misalignment      │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chemical Bath Preparation**:
   - Pour pure Microposit MF-319 developer into a clean, dedicated chemical-resistant fluoropolymer/glass dipping tank at ambient room temperature ($20\text{--}22^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Set up an adjacent cascade bath filled with high-purity Deionized (DI) water.

2. **Immersion Development**:
   - Using wafer-handling fluoropolymer tweezers, submerge the exposed wafer (Shipley 1813, nominal thickness $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) pattern-side up into the MF-319 bath.
   - Gently agitate with slight lateral motion for **$45\text{--}60\text{ seconds}$** to fully dissolve exposed photoresist regions without causing physical liftoff or severe pattern undercut.

3. **DI Water Quench & Rinse**:
   - Immediately transfer the wafer directly from the MF-319 bath into the DI water bath to instantly quench developer reaction.
   - Rigorously rinse in flowing DI water for $\ge 30\text{ seconds}$ to strip residual alkaline chemistry and prevent precipitation stains.

4. **Nitrogen Blow Drying**:
   - Remove wafer and gently dry completely from center to edge using filtered, dry nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) gas gun at low nozzle pressure ($< 15\ \text{psi}$) to avoid shearing resist patterns.

5. **Optical Vernier Metrology & Alignment Verification**:
   - Mount the dry wafer onto the inspection stage of the split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras (or modified optical microscope using a $10\times$ Plan Achromat objective, $\text{NA } 0.25$).
   - Locate the complementary fiducial crosshair and printed box-in-box / Vernier alignment marks between the current developed photoresist layer and the substrate reference layer.
   - Quantify relative $X$- and $Y$-axis vernier comb displacements or crosshair center offsets via calibrated digital crosshair measurement reticle across opposing wafer positions.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Instrument / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Immersion Development Time** | $45\text{ to }60$ | $\text{seconds}$ ($\text{s}$) | Calibrated digital process timer |
| **Gen 2 Overlay Misalignment Tolerance ($\Delta X, \Delta Y$)** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical microscope reticle / Dual CMOS camera Vernier readout |
| **Photoresist Layer Thickness (Shipley 1813 baseline)** | $1.3$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical reflectometer / profilometer |
| **Optical Metrology Objective Resolution Baseline** | $10\times\text{ Plan Achromat, } \text{NA } 0.25$ | $\text{Numerical Aperture (dimensionless)}$ | Inspection microscope optical objective spec |

---

### 3. Context & Literature Citations

- **Microposit MF-319 Developer & DI Water Rinse**:
  - *Citation*: *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*: *"Developer: Microposit MF-319 for 45-60 seconds, followed by rigorous deionized (DI) water rinse."*
- **Gen 2 Alignment & Vernier Tolerance ($\le \pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$)**:
  - *Citation*: *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*: *"Alignment tolerance at Gen 1 is ±100 microns (0.1 mm), improving to ±5 microns in Gen 2."*
- **Optical Inspection & Metrology Configuration**:
  - *Citation*: *Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose*: *"wafer and mask viewed through split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras."*
  - *Citation*: *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*: *"Using a modified microscope objective (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) allows micron-scale feature resolution."*
- **Photoresist Layer Baseline**:
  - *Citation*: *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* & *Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics*: *"Shipley 1813... yields ~1.3 micron thickness."*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Immersion development using metal-ion-free TMAH (MF-319) introduces localized fluid shear and thermal non-uniformities that directly modulate unexposed resist dissolution rates. The metrology loop must decouple developer boundary layer effects from optical vernier reading errors, ensuring that the post-development inspection (ADI) optical vernier mark edges are not blurred by micro-bubble pinning or redeposition residues before image analysis.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For i-line positive photoresist (Shipley 1813 at ~1.3 µm nominal thickness), standard immersion puddle/dip development in MF-319 requires exactly 60 ± 1.0 s at 21.0 ± 0.5 °C followed by immediate cascade deionized water quench. An under-developed resist film leaves bridging scum at vernier comb teeth (pitch 2.0 µm, comb teeth 0.5 µm/0.55 µm), while over-development causes excessive lateral trimming and edge rounding, artificially shifting the apparent optical vernier center-of-mass by > 150 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Pre-mixed electronic-grade Shipley MF-319 developer (0.261 N / 2.38% wt tetramethylammonium hydroxide) must be sourced in dedicated cleanroom-grade fluoropolymer drums. Sourcing disruption or batch variations in surfactant additives can alter surface tension, leading to uneven wetting across 100mm/150mm wafers and causing false rejection of lithography lots due to apparent overlay excursion.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Cycle time from post-exposure bake (PEB) through MF-319 immersion and optical vernier read-out directly impacts fab turn-around time. Implementing an automated optical vernier edge-detection algorithm via split-field microscope CMOS capture reduces operator inspection time from 15 minutes per wafer to under 90 seconds while eliminating subjective crosshair alignment bias.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Photoresist scumming and incomplete clearing in nested optical vernier comb teeth due to developer stagnation or exhausted TMAH concentration, creating false overlay offsets > 250 nm.
1. Pattern collapse or severe footing/undercut of fine vernier fingers caused by prolonged developer immersion (> 65 s) or elevated chemical bath temperature (> 22.0 °C).
1. Optical metrology misreading from developer residue stains or DI water drying watermarks across alignment targets due to inadequate spin-dry or high-surface-tension puddle collapse.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-2-3-01` | **MF-319 Immersion Development Process Uniformity and Clearance Verification** | Automated wet bench developer bath with temperature controller, cascade DI water rinse tank, spin-rinse-dryer (SRD), and spectroscopic reflectometer/ellipsometer. | 1. Verify MF-319 developer bath temperature is stabilized at 21.0 ± 0.5 °C with gentle N2 agitation. 2. Immerse wafer vertically with active mechanical agitation for exactly 60.0 s. 3. Transfer immediately (< 3 s transfer time) into quick-dump DI water rinse tank; execute 3 dump cycles. 4. Transfer to cascade overflow rinse for 120 s until effluent resistivity > 18.0 MΩ·cm. 5. Process in SRD at 2500 RPM under heated N2 for 90 s. 6. Inspect open-frame clear zones using spectroscopic reflectometer at 9 points across the wafer. | `Zero residual resist in cleared fiducial open frames across all 9 measurement points (residual thickness < 1.0 nm). Unexposed resist remaining thickness >= 1.22 µm (dark erosion < 80 nm).` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-2-3-02` | **Optical Overlay Vernier Misalignment Metrology via Split-Field Microscope** | Karl Suss MA6 split-field optical microscope with calibrated 20x objective (0.40 NA), dual high-resolution CMOS camera, and sub-pixel edge-detection overlay metrology software. | 1. Load wafer onto MA6 chuck and establish focus at central die vernier mark (Die [0,0]). 2. Acquire 24-bit high-resolution digital image of X and Y vernier scales. 3. Execute sub-pixel intensity centroid calculation along comb fingers to locate the zero-phase coincidental teeth pair. 4. Repeat measurement at four peripheral cardinal points: North, South, East, West dies (radius = 35 mm). 5. Compute mean overlay error (dX, dY) and wafer-level rotational run-out theta. | `Total optical overlay misalignment |dX| and |dY| <= 0.50 µm across all 5 measured fields in hard/vacuum contact mode. Metrology measurement repeatability (3-sigma) <= 0.04 µm across 5 consecutive read cycles.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Chemical-resistant neoprene/nitrile blend heavy-duty gloves (15 mil minimum) over inner nitrile exam gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face safety shield and splash goggles, Acid/base-resistant heavy-duty apron (polypropylene/neoprene), Closed-toe chemical-resistant cleanroom safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: TMAH is a severe neurotoxin and alkaline caustic that readily penetrates skin. In case of dermal contact: immediately strip contaminated clothing under safety shower; flush skin continuously with copious water for at least 15 minutes. Administer external emergency decontamination; if systemic neurotoxic symptoms (muscular twitching, bradycardia, respiratory distress) occur, summon emergency medical services immediately. For eye exposure, hold eyelids open and irrigate with isotonic saline or eyewash for 15+ minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet bench dedicated wet chemical developer station with certified laminar wet exhaust velocity between 100 to 120 FPM (0.51 to 0.61 m/s) at the sash opening, ducted directly to cleanroom alkaline scrubber system.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate all spent MF-319 developer and initial rinse effluent into dedicated alkaline chemical waste containment carboys/drains. Do not mix with solvent or acid waste streams. Batch neutralize spent TMAH using dilute sulfuric acid (0.1 N) to pH 6.5-8.5 in an industrial neutralization tank before discharge, ensuring biological wastewater plant compatibility.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / SLSI) | `2.38% wt (0.261 N)` |
| **Deionized Water** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Ultra-Pure Water (UPW Type 1) | `97.62% wt` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: UV-exposed Shipley 1813 photoresist layer on 100mm silicon wafer with latent crosshair/vernier fiducial images, post-exposure baked, clean and dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully cleared, scum-free patterned photoresist with open alignment verniers and fiduical marks, DI-water rinsed, spin-dried, and hydrophobically stable.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes airborne amine absorption and airborne moisture equilibration, causing acid neutralization in exposed positive resist and leading to severe 'T-topping', incomplete vernier comb dissolution, and irreversible overlay metrology errors.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Validation of the MF-319 immersion wet development cycle and quantitative optical overlay vernier metrology for Gen 2 (µm) 180nm DRAM fabrication, establishing scum-free pattern delineation and sub-micron overlay verification across 100mm wafers.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MF319_Development_Uniformity_Report_Gen2.csv`
- [ ] `Overlay_Vernier_Vector_Map_Lot_Summary.pdf`
- [ ] `Fiducial_Comb_HighRes_Metrology_Image.tiff`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual unexposed photoresist thickness after 60s MF-319 immersion** | `1.25 µm` | >= 1.20 µm | 9-point spectroscopic reflectometer scan across unexposed field regions |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Fiducial open-frame development clearance depth** | `0.00 nm` | <= 1.00 nm | Ellipsometric boundary inspection in fully exposed fiducial clearing windows |

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: MF-319 Development & Post-Exposure Vernier Overlay Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-exposure queue time directly couples photoactive compound decay to dissolution kinetics; transitioning from a 120-150 mJ/cm² dose to MF-319 development without a post-exposure bake (PEB) window control creates critical CD variation across 180nm open-source DRAM peripheral logic. The vernier optical metrology system must resolve sub-micron relative shifts with NA 0.25 optics, which approaches the Rayleigh criterion boundary and demands sub-pixel edge detection algorithms rather than simple visual reading.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Shipley 1813 positive resist exposed at 365nm produces indene carboxylic acid from diazonaphthoquinone (DNQ). MF-319 (0.24N TMAH surfactant-containing formulation) requires strict 45-60s immersion agitation; insufficient DI rinse immediately triggers standing-wave dissolution residue or unneutralized base carryover. For optical verniers, vernier pitch mismatch (e.g., 2.0 µm mask 1 vs 1.9 µm mask 2) must be calibrated against magnification error before qualifying ±5 µm Gen 2 alignment tolerances.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Pre-mixed Microposit MF-319 developer and cleanroom-grade electronic surfactant chemistries face regional import restrictions and cold-chain/shelf-life degradation. Cleanroom-grade TMAH 2.38% (0.26N) diluted or neat MF-319 (0.24N) requires verified CAS tracing and dedicated fluoropolymer chemical-resistant containment, avoiding generic industrial grade stock which introduces catastrophic metallic contamination (Na, K, Fe > 10 ppb) fatal to DRAM gate oxides.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Stage gating between UV exposure and wet development requires an unyielding 30-minute queue-time hard interlock to prevent batch lot scraping. The metrology loop must deliver quantitative go/no-go alignment data within 15 minutes of wafer dry-off to release wafers for subsequent wet/dry etching without bottlenecking the single-operator garage fabrication line.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Photoresist scumming and bridging in unexposed vernier comb fingers due to developer bath depletion, low temperature (<20°C), or insufficient development duration.
1. Pattern liftoff or severe line-edge rounding (resist peeling) caused by excessive developer immersion (>75s) or poor hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS) adhesion priming.
1. Catastrophic overlay misreading caused by optical diffraction fringing and chromatic aberration under NA 0.25 Plan Achromat objective, leading to false ±5 µm tolerance verification.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-3-01` | **MF-319 Dissolution Rate & Clear Window Verification** | Spectroscopic reflectometer / optical profilometer, calibrated timer (±0.2s), temperature-controlled PTFE wet bench bath | 1. Immerse wafer into fresh MF-319 with constant double-paddle agitation for exactly 50 seconds. 2. Immediately transfer into overflowing cascade DI water quench tank within 3 seconds and rinse for 120 seconds. 3. Spin dry with filtered N2 at 20 psi for 30 seconds. 4. Measure residual film thickness at 5 points (center and 4 orthogonal quadrants) across the wafer using spectroscopic reflectometer. | `Residual photoresist thickness in exposed open-frame clear areas must be ≤ 0.00 nm (100% clear of scum/residue). Unexposed resist retention thickness must be ≥ 1.25 µm (dark erosion ≤ 50 nm).` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-2-3-02` | **Post-Exposure Vernier Overlay Offset Metrology** | Compound optical microscope with 10x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25), 5MP CMOS monochrome sensor, calibrated reticle stage micrometer, sub-pixel digital edge-detection software | 1. Mount wafer on precision vacuum stage and calibrate optical magnification using a certified 10 µm grid micrometer standard. 2. Focus on the primary fiducial vernier sets at center, top, bottom, left, and right chip locations. 3. Acquire 12-bit uncompressed TIFF images under green (540nm) bandpass filtered illumination to eliminate chromatic aberration. 4. Compute center-of-mass and edge transition coordinates for corresponding vernier finger pairs along X and Y axes across all 5 dice. | `Measured absolute overlay misregistration |ΔX| and |ΔY| must be ≤ 5.0 µm across all 5 verification sites. Vernier feature edge profile roughness (3σ) must be ≤ 0.35 µm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Chemical-resistant neoprene/nitrile outer gloves over inner disposable nitrile gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved chemical splash goggles and full-face protective shield, Heavy-duty chemical-resistant butyl or neoprene wet bench apron, Closed-toe cleanroom ESD boots with chemical-resistant overshoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: TMAH is a dangerous neurotoxin readily absorbed through skin. In case of skin contact: Immediately strip contaminated clothing while flooding affected skin under safety shower for minimum 15 minutes. Administer external emergency decontamination; if systemic symptoms (muscular twitching, respiratory arrest) occur, transport to hospital immediately. In case of eye contact: Irrigate eyes continuously for at least 30 minutes at eyewash station holding eyelids open; seek urgent ophthalmological care.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation must be conducted exclusively in a wet chemical exhaustion station with face velocity maintained at 100 ± 10 LFPM (0.5 m/s), monitored via differential magnehelic pressure gauge. Fume exhaust ducting must be polypropylene or PVDF.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent MF-319 alkaline developer must be segregated from acidic piranha/BOE waste streams in a dedicated fluoropolymer carboy. Neutralize off-line with 10% hydrochloric acid or sulfuric acid under controlled pH monitoring to reach pH 6.5-8.5 prior to hazardous waste pickup. Never vent to sanitary sewers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / Cleanroom) | `2.2% - 2.5% (approx. 0.24N in aqueous solution)` |
| **Water (Deionized Quench)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (Resistivity > 18.0 MOhm*cm) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Exposed Shipley 1813 resist (1.3 µm) on SiO2/Si substrate containing latent indene carboxylic acid image; dry, particulate-free (Class 100/ISO 5), stored in amber light.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Developed, thoroughly DI-rinsed, and N2-blow-dried patterned photoresist with sharp vertical sidewalls; substrate clear of micro-scum and developer salt crystallization.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient air causes airborne basic amine uptake and latent acid image neutralization, resulting in severe dissolution inhibition, micro-bridging of fine features, and erratic vernier overlay shifts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful wet chemical development of 1.3 µm Shipley 1813 photoresist in MF-319 developer followed by rapid DI cascade quenching, dry-off, and rigorous post-exposure optical vernier overlay metrology confirming alignment registration within Gen 2 micron-scale tolerance (±5.0 µm) across a 100mm wafer substrate.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `mf319_development_process_run_log.csv`
- [ ] `vernier_overlay_registration_report.pdf`
- [ ] `vernier_comb_micrographs_hires.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum absolute vernier overlay misregistration (|ΔX|, |ΔY|) across all monitored wafer die sites** | `0.0 µm` | ±5.0 µm | Calibrated optical microscope image processing with sub-pixel edge detection at 100x magnification |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual unexposed photoresist film thickness after 50-second MF-319 development cycle** | `1.28 µm` | ±0.03 µm | 5-point spectroscopic reflectometer optical thickness scanning |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Open-frame clear area development scum thickness** | `0.0 nm` | +5.0 nm | Optical profilometry and brightfield/darkfield defect inspection |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 wafer metrology sites demonstrate residual resist scum ≤ 5.0 nm, zero vernier comb bridging, and cumulative overlay registration |ΔX| and |ΔY| strictly within ±5.0 µm, validated by uncompressed 12-bit TIFF imagery and signed calibration run sheets.
