# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-GEN2-004`  
**Title:** COTS Stage Micrometer & Optical Vernier Calibration Target Procurement and Verification  
**Discipline:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip | Metrology & Precision Optical Alignment  
**Target Level:** Generation 2 (µm-scale) | **Action Type:** Make / Procurement & In-situ Qualification  

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     Procurement      │
│    Specification     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Visual Inspection   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Stage Calibration   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Metrology Baseline  │
│       Sign-Off       │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Procurement Specification & Dimensional Sizing**
   - Source a high-grade Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) stage micrometer consisting of vacuum-deposited chromium-on-quartz glass substrate.
   - Target line pattern must include standard 10 µm pitch divisions and high-density vernier subdivisions suitable for optical crosshair calibration matching split-field binocular microscope optics.

2. **Optical & Surface Defect Screening**
   - Inspect the calibration scale under a 10× Plan Achromat microscope objective (NA 0.25).
   - Verify that the chromium patterns are free of voids, micro-scratches, or particulate contamination across the active alignment field.
   - Clean the quartz surface using filtered clean dry air (CDA) or an optical-grade deionized (DI) water flush followed by gentle nitrogen blow-off.

3. **In-Situ Optical Magnification & Sensor Calibration**
   - Mount the target on the mask aligner chuck under the split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras.
   - Align the primary scale divisions along the X/Y axes of the CMOS sensor array.
   - Calculate pixel-to-micron scaling factors across horizontal and vertical axes to map image coordinates for post-develop vernier metrology.

4. **Micrometer Actuator & Gap Sensitivity Calibration**
   - Position the calibration target beneath the aligner gap detection sensors.
   - Actuate the three high-precision differential micrometers (or closed-loop piezo actuators) across their displacement travel to verify micrometer displacement against observed visual pitch.
   - Establish the 10 µm to 20 µm proximity gap zero-plane and verify readout repeatability before introducing production masks.

5. **Calibration Certification & Metrology Offset Log**
   - Record pitch scale linearity, optical magnification constants, and baseline alignment error vectors into the alignment logbook.
   - Store the calibrated stage micrometer in a static-dissipative hard case inside the clean environment.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric Description | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Citation Context Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Actuator Motion Sensitivity** | $\le 0.1$ | µm | *Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose* |
| **Proximity Air Gap Baseline** | $10 \text{ to } 20$ | µm | *Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose* |
| **Gen 2 Optical Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | µm | *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* |
| **Exposure Optical Uniformity** | $> 95$ | % | *Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose* |

```text
       Gen 2 Metrology Dimensional Constraints (um)     
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
  Prox Gap (10-20um)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
Gen2 Align Tol (5um)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
   Prox Res (~2-3um)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
  Contact Res (<1um)┤███                               │
                    │███                               │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                    0.0     3.8      7.5    11.2   15.0 
```

---

### Source Citations

- **[Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose]**:
  - Substrate construction (chromium-on-quartz).
  - Proximity printing gap calibration range ($10 \text{ to } 20\text{ µm}$).
  - Differential micrometer / piezo actuator sensitivity ($0.1\text{ µm}$).
  - Split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras and $>95\%$ beam uniformity requirement.
- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**:
  - Optical objective standard: 10× Plan Achromat, NA 0.25.
  - Alignment tolerance scale progression: Gen 1 ($\pm 100\text{ µm}$) to Gen 2 ($\pm 5\text{ µm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Purchasing commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) stage micrometers and optical vernier targets without NIST/DAkkS traceable calibration certification introduces unquantified systematic scale errors into the optical metrology loop. The optical magnification transfer function of the inspection microscope (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) must be calibrated across the full field of view (FOV) to decouple optical barrel/pincushion distortion from true stage runout and mask-to-wafer overlay error vector calculations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For Gen 2 DRAM overlay metrology targeting ±5 µm alignment, the calibration target must utilize vacuum-deposited low-reflectivity chromium on soda-lime or quartz glass with line pitch sub-divisions down to 10 µm and 1 µm vernier increments. Edge roughness (edge acutance) of the chromium target must not exceed 50 nm 3-sigma, otherwise line edge detection algorithms will suffer centroid jitter exceeding 200 nm, directly degrading the optical overlay budget.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: COTS stage micrometers with certified calibration certificates (e.g., Edmund Optics, Thorlabs, or Ready Optics) face international shipping delays and customs clearance latency into Vietnam. A non-traceable glass slide target will severely bottleneck tool qualification; procurement must dual-source with a pre-certified backup target and specify temperature-stabilized protective packaging.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Procurement lead time is directly on the critical path for Gen 2 overlay lithography baseline signoff. Receipt, physical inspection, dimensional qualification, and baseline database ingestion must complete within a 48-hour turn-around window upon physical arrival to avoid idling the mask aligner commissioning team.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Substrate optical flatness deviation (>λ/4) causing localized focal plane shift and parallax scale distortion during lateral magnification mapping.
1. Chromium pattern pinhole defects or delamination within primary vernier graduations inducing optical centroid thresholding miscalculations.
1. Thermal expansion coefficient mismatch during non-temperature-controlled inspection (>22°C ± 0.5°C) introducing uncorrected pitch drift.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-3-3-1-01` | **NIST-Traceable Pitch Linearity and Optical Scale Calibration** | Calibrated metallurgical optical microscope with 10x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25), 20MP scientific CMOS camera (3.45 µm pixel pitch), sub-micron motorized XY stage, and climate-controlled metrology enclosure (20.0 ± 0.2°C). | 1. Align the 1 mm / 10 µm division stage micrometer along the camera horizontal pixel axis. 2. Capture a 10-frame averaged image at 5 distinct positions across the 1 mm reticle. 3. Apply a sub-pixel edge detection profile (50% threshold) across 100 consecutive 10 µm pitch intervals. 4. Compute pixel-to-micron scaling factor and residual pitch error across full FOV. | `Total accumulated pitch error across 1000 µm span must be ≤ ±0.5 µm; individual 10 µm pitch spacing error must not exceed ±0.1 µm across 99% of line intervals.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-3-3-1-02` | **Optical Vernier Edge Acutance and Line Width Uniformity Verification** | High-magnification optical metrology system (20x/50x objectives, NA ≥ 0.40) coupled to automated line-width measurement (CD) software with calibrated intensity thresholding. | 1. Position vernier sub-divisions (1 µm increments) under field center. 2. Acquire high-contrast brightfield reflection profiles for 10 vernier teeth. 3. Measure line edge roughness (3-sigma) along a 20 µm line segment. 4. Measure chromium optical density (OD) and background glass transmission. | `Line edge roughness (3σ) must be ≤ 0.08 µm; nominal chromium line width (2.0 µm) deviation must be ≤ ±0.15 µm; optical density of chrome features must exceed 3.0 at 365 nm and 550 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Lint-free antistatic cleanroom gown
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of eye contact with solvent, flush eyes immediately with eyewash for 15 minutes. For skin contact, wash thoroughly with soap and DI water. In case of inhalation, move personnel to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating air with HEPA filtration (0.3 µm, 99.97% efficiency); manual solvent wiping conducted within dedicated laminar flow bench with local exhaust.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA solvent wipes and residue must be collected in a sealed, grounded, fire-rated hazardous solvent waste container for licensed chemical disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Factory-sealed cleanroom container, vacuum-packed with antistatic moisture-barrier bag and optical desiccants.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Solvent-cleaned, dry nitrogen blow-dried, particle-free (<1 particle >0.5 µm/cm²), and stored in static-dissipative fluoroware slide box.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Extended atmospheric exposure causes airborne hydrocarbon adsorption and moisture condensation on quartz/chrome surface, shifting optical edge refraction and degrading edge threshold detection.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> COTS optical stage micrometer and vernier calibration target procured, physically inspected, dimensional accuracy verified against manufacturer calibration sheet, and baseline optical transfer scale integrated into DRAM Foundation VN metrology software.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `stage_micrometer_calibration_cert_TC-GEN2-UM-3-3-1.pdf`
- [ ] `optical_scale_factor_lut_10x_achromat.csv`
- [ ] `vernier_edge_roughness_metrology_profile.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Optical magnification scale factor linearity error across 1000 µm field** | `0.0` | ±0.5 µm total accumulated error | Automated sub-pixel line pitch extraction against calibrated 1000 µm scale. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Vernier graduation minimum line width edge acutance (3-sigma)** | `0.05 µm` | ≤ 0.08 µm | Multi-point edge intensity profile thresholding using high-resolution scientific CMOS camera. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Calibration standard successfully resolves 1 µm vernier offsets under 10x Plan Achromat objective with repeatable scale calibration factor (pixel/µm) confirmed across 3 independent mounts with standard deviation σ < 0.02%.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Post-Develop Optical Inspection Setup & Microscopic Vernier Image Acquisition

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-GEN2-004`  
**Classification:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$) Metrology  
**Module:** Optics & Precision Alignment / Metrology  
**Process Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wafer Load on Vacuum  │
│         Stage          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Objective Selection:  │
│  10x Plan Achromat NA  │
│          0.25          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Split-Field / Dual   │
│   CMOS Alignment to    │
│   Vernier Fiducials    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Microscopic Vernier   │
│  Image Acquisition &   │
│        Storage         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Loading**:
   - Verify post-develop wafer status (Shipley 1813 resist, $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ target thickness, developed in Microposit MF-319 for $45\text{--}60\text{ s}$ followed by DI water rinse).
   - Load the patterned wafer onto the macroscopic vacuum inspection stage.
   
2. **Optical System Configuration**:
   - Mount and lock the modified **10x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25)** into the optical inspection path to achieve micron-scale optical feature resolution.
   - Power up the dual CMOS cameras coupled to the split-field binocular microscope assembly.

3. **Fiducial Mark Locating & Focus Adjustment**:
   - Translate the stage along $X/Y$ to bring the patterned crosshair / overlay Vernier alignment marks into the field of view of the dual CMOS cameras.
   - Adjust the $Z$-focus differential micrometer/piezo mechanism to bring both the underlying substrate fiducials and developed resist Vernier bars into sharp focus.

4. **Microscopic Vernier Image Acquisition**:
   - Capture uncompressed, calibrated split-field digital micrographs across the designated die locations (center, left, right) using the dual CMOS camera system.
   - Archive images with timestamp and die coordinates for subsequent overlay vector displacement analysis.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Objective Numerical Aperture (NA)** | $0.25$ (10x Plan Achromat) | Dimensionless | Optical inspection tool configuration log |
| **Preceding Resist Layer Thickness** | $1.3$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Film thickness / spin-coat recipe verification ($4000\text{ RPM}$) |
| **Gen 2 Alignment Overlay Tolerance** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Vernier metrology scale analysis from captured image |
| **Stage/Gap Control Sensitivity** | $0.1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Differential micrometer / closed-loop piezo reading |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - *Optics*: Modified microscope objective (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) enabling micron-scale resolution.
  - *Photoresist Specifications*: Shipley 1813 spin-coated at $4000\text{ RPM}$ yielding $\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thickness; developed in Microposit MF-319 for $45\text{--}60\text{ seconds}$ with DI water rinse.
  - *Alignment Tolerance*: Gen 2 alignment target specified at $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ (improved from Gen 1 at $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**:
  - *Imaging System*: Split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras for dual-mark inspection.
  - *Stage Actuation Sensitivity*: Closed-loop piezo actuators or three high-precision differential micrometers with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity.
  - *Alignment Marks*: Crosshair alignment marks and Vernier fiducial structures.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The optical vernier image acquisition setup must maintain mechanical rigidity and optical co-axiality across the field of view. Using a 10x to 50x Plan Achromat objective with NA 0.25 to 0.55 requires focal plane stability within +/-1.2 um Rayleigh depth of focus. Without active pneumatic vibration isolation (1.2 to 2.5 Hz cutoff), building vibrations will blur optical edges, inflating sub-micron line-edge detection centroid variance beyond the +/-5 um Gen 2 vernier tolerance budget.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-develop optical inspection on Shipley 1813 resist requires strict monochromatic or filtered illumination (546nm green e-line or 589nm yellow) to prevent parasitic photochemical secondary exposure of unexposed or latent resist features. Furthermore, thin-film optical interference over patterned SiO2/poly-Si stacks causes phase contrast inversion across vernier bar edges; image analysis algorithms must use dual-threshold edge gradient fitting rather than simple peak-intensity thresholding.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Dual CMOS split-field binocular sensors and high-extinction polarized Plan Achromat objectives are subject to commercial supply delays and import lead times. Sourcing standardized C-mount high-QE CMOS sensors (Sony IMX series) with open-source micro-positioning micrometer stages (Thorlabs or domestic Vietnamese equivalents) is essential to keep bill-of-materials and mean-time-to-repair within open-source fabrication budgets.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The vernier inspection step directly bottlenecks wafer lot cycle time between DI water spin-drying and post-develop hard bake. Image capture, automated stage indexing across 5 field sites (center, top, bottom, left, right), and optical vernier calibration must execute within an allocated 8-minute total cycle per wafer to satisfy target throughput without violating downstream pre-bake queue time constraints.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Depth-of-field defocusing causing asymmetric edge spread function (ESF) and introducing systematic artificial overlay offsets >2.0 um
1. Actinic light leakage from unfiltered white-light microscope illumination inducing unintended post-exposure footing or resist thinning
1. Wafer tilt and chuck unflatness exceeding 3 um across a 100mm field, causing parallax distortion and optical magnification errors across split vernier combs

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-3-3-2-01` | **Optical Vernier System Spatial Calibration & Optical Distortion Verification** | Certified 100 um / 1 um division stage micrometer (NIST-traceable), 10x Plan Achromat NA 0.25 objective, 20MP monochromatic CMOS C-mount camera, 546nm bandpass filter | 1. Position stage micrometer under 10x objective and achieve peak Sobel-gradient autofocus. 2. Capture 10 successive 16-bit uncompressed TIFF frames across horizontal and vertical axes. 3. Compute pixel-to-micron scale factor along X and Y axes over a 500-pixel line profile. 4. Calculate barrel/pincushion optical distortion across the central 80% field of view. | `Pixel scale factor must yield 0.450 um/pixel +/- 0.005 um/pixel across both orthogonal axes; optical field distortion must be <= 0.25% across the central 80% FOV.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-3-3-2-02` | **Post-Develop Microscopic Vernier Image Acquisition Repeatability & SNR Metric** | Automated XY micrometer stage with 0.5 um resolution, high-resolution split CMOS digital microscopy system, MTF edge-analysis software suite | 1. Load wafer and navigate to central and 4 orthogonal peripheral die vernier test structures. 2. Perform 5 consecutive autofocus and image capture cycles per site with stage disengagement and re-engagement. 3. Measure vernier comb edge-to-background signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and 10%-90% edge transition width. 4. Extract centroid position repeatability of outer and inner vernier fingers across the 5 runs. | `Image edge SNR must exceed >= 24 dB; 10%-90% edge transition width must be <= 1.8 um; 3-sigma centroid extraction repeatability across repeated loads must be <= 0.35 um.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), UV-blocking ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses, Anti-static ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive shoe covers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with trace developer residue during wafer handling, immediately irrigate with copious deionized water or saline solution for at least 15 minutes. For IPA vapor overexposure, move personnel to fresh ambient air and seek medical attention if irritation or dizziness persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within laminar flow clean bench (ISO Class 5) with yellow HEPA filtration at downflow velocity of 0.45 m/s (+/-20%) to maintain particle-free optics and solvent vapor evacuation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Wafers are fully rinsed and dry prior to inspection; alcohol-soaked cleaning wipes must be disposed of in dedicated flame-retardant solvent waste bins with airtight seals.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH from MF-319 trace carryover)** | `75-59-2` | Trace aqueous residue | `<0.1% wt` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA, stage wipe down)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.9% wt` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly developed Shipley 1813 on silicon substrate, spin-rinsed with 18.2 MOhm DI water, spin-dried under dry N2 blow; unbaked soft resist state (post-develop/pre-hardbake)
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Optically inspected wafer with intact, non-crosslinked photoresist vernier structures, zero actinic damage, ready for 120 deg C convection hard bake
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Ambient cleanroom moisture absorption causes photoresist plasticization, swelling, and thermal edge-rounding during subsequent hard bake, degrading vernier pattern resolution and introducing false overlay skew >1.5 um.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Calibrated optical inspection setup and non-destructive microscopic vernier acquisition pipeline delivering sub-micron edge-resolved 16-bit uncompressed images across 5 standard wafer field locations for Gen 2 (+/-5 um) DRAM overlay error vector analysis.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `vernier_optical_calibration_report_gen2.pdf`
- [ ] `die_vernier_raw_micrographs_5site_set.tiff`
- [ ] `spatial_scaling_and_distortion_log.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Optical Vernier Image Resolution (Modulation Transfer Function MTF at 250 lp/mm)** | `0.45` | +/-0.05 | Slanted-edge MTF analysis on NIST stage micrometer chrome target under 546nm green filtered illumination |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Centroid Repeatability of Vernier Edge Detection** | `0.25 um` | <= 0.35 um (3-sigma) | Automated sub-pixel edge detection across 10 repeated autofocus and acquisition cycles per vernier site |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Field Parallax and Magnification Anisotropy Ratio (X/Y scale ratio)** | `1.000` | +/-0.003 | Dual-axis spatial calibration comparison using certified 1 um pitch orthogonal grid |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five-site vernier micrographs (center, N, S, E, W) acquired with verified SNR >= 24 dB, calibration verified with spatial scaling log within +/-0.005 um/pixel, and wafer handed off to post-develop hard bake within the 45-minute cleanroom air Q-time limit.

nodes.sop_content:
# SOP: Overlay Misalignment Vector Computation & Multi-Field Error Decomposition

## 1. Process Overview & Architecture Flow

This standard operating procedure governs post-exposure optical vernier reading, local misalignment vector calculation ($\vec{\Delta} = [\Delta x, \Delta y]^T$), and multi-field grid error decomposition (translation $T_x, T_y$, wafer rotation $\theta$, and expansion/scaling $E$) for Gen 2 lithography on the 180nm open-source DRAM architecture.

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Optical Vernier Metrology (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25)│
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   Misalignment Vector Computation: Δx, Δy (Gen 2 µm)   │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Multi-Field Error Decomposition (Tx, Ty, θ, Expansion) │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Closed-Loop Stage Correction (Piezo / Differential)    │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Optical Vernier Acquisition & Calibration
1. Mount the developed wafer (Shipley 1813 resist, soft-baked at 115 °C for 60 s, developed in MF-319 for 45–60 s and DI-rinsed) onto the macroscopic inspection stage.
2. Position the optical metrology head using a **10x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25)** over designated optical vernier test structures located at the periphery and corners of each die field.
3. Confirm optical focus and set digital crosshair reticle resolution to sub-micron accuracy using calibrated reticle pitch standards.

### Step 2: Overlay Vernier Displacement Extraction
1. Read the vernier scale displacement along both orthogonal axes:
   - Identify the coincident vernier comb fingers between the prior baseline layer (e.g., bitline / active area contact) and the current patterned photoresist layer.
   - Record discrete displacement readings $V_x$ and $V_y$ at each field site $i \in \{1, 2, \dots, N\}$ across the wafer.
2. Compute the local displacement vector:
   $$\vec{\Delta}_i = \begin{bmatrix} \Delta x_i \\ \Delta y_i \end{bmatrix}$$

### Step 3: Multi-Field Overlay Error Model Decomposition
1. Formulate the first-order multi-field overlay model describing wafer-level grid distortions:
   $$\Delta x_i = T_x - \theta \cdot y_i + E_x \cdot x_i + \epsilon_{x,i}$$
   $$\Delta y_i = T_y + \theta \cdot x_i + E_y \cdot y_i + \epsilon_{y,i}$$
   where:
   - $(x_i, y_i)$ are the nominal field coordinates relative to the wafer center.
   - $T_x, T_y$ are translation offsets.
   - $\theta$ is the wafer rotation angle.
   - $E_x, E_y$ are linear intra-field/wafer expansion or scale factors.
   - $\epsilon_{x,i}, \epsilon_{y,i}$ are residual non-correctable errors (NCE).
2. Execute a least-squares linear regression across all sampled field sites to solve for parameter set $\{T_x, T_y, \theta, E_x, E_y\}$.

### Step 4: Closed-Loop Mask Aligner Stage Compensation
1. Decompose the calculated offset vectors into mechanical correction commands:
   - Feed translational shifts $(T_x, T_y)$ and rotational error $\theta$ into the aligner stage micrometer drives or closed-loop piezo actuators with **0.1 µm sensitivity**.
2. Verify that residual alignment vector magnitudes satisfy Gen 2 overlay tolerance:
   $$|\vec{\Delta}_{\text{residual}}| = \sqrt{\epsilon_x^2 + \epsilon_y^2} \le 5\,\mu\text{m}$$

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gen 2 Overlay Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical Vernier reading ($V_x, V_y$) |
| **Actuator Position Sensitivity** | $0.1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Closed-loop piezo / differential micrometer feedback |
| **Photoresist Soft Bake Temperature** | $115 \pm 1$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Thermocouple on flat aluminum hot plate (60 s duration) |
| **Optical Numerical Aperture (NA)** | $0.25$ | Dimensionless | 10x Plan Achromat objective specification |

---

## 4. Cited Literature & Sources

1. **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose**
   - *Actuator resolution:* Gap setting and positioning controlled using closed-loop piezo actuators or differential micrometers with **0.1 µm sensitivity**.
   - *Exposure & Resist baseline:* Shipley 1813 (~1.3 µm thickness) with optimum dose clear at 120–150 mJ/cm² under 365 nm (i-line) optics.
2. **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**
   - *Optical system:* Modified microscope objective (**10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25**) achieving micron-scale resolution.
   - *Bake & Process conditions:* Shipley 1813 spin-coated at 4000 RPM (1.3 µm), soft baked at **115 °C for 60 seconds**; MF-319 developer for 45–60 s.
   - *Overlay tolerance evolution:* Gen 1 alignment tolerance at $\pm 100\,\mu\text{m}$ improving to **$\pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$ in Gen 2**.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - *Context:* Access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$) and stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture requiring tight overlay budget across contact plugs and capacitor nodes.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Decomposing 2D overlay residual error vectors across a 100mm wafer exposed on a Karl Suss MA6 requires explicit separation between macroscopic stage translation (dX, dY), chuck/mask relative rotation (theta), and thermal/scaling expansion (magnification error). Without orthogonal multi-field sampling (minimum 9 field sites including center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zones), non-linear wedge error compensation (WEC) spherical air-bearing tilt will confound the linear overlay vector decomposition model, yielding false operator correction offsets.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Optical Vernier metrology at Gen 2 (resolution limit ~1-2 um with Shipley 1813 resist) relies on dual split-field optical microscopes with calibrated digital reticles. If sub-micron Vernier pitch differentials (e.g., 0.1 um vernier step size) are imaged under brightfield 20x objectives (NA ~0.40), optical diffraction fringes and resist sidewall slope (~80 deg) induce optical proximity distortion, necessitating centroid-based line edge detection rather than visual thresholding to maintain <= 0.25 um measurement uncertainty.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard Karl Suss calibrated quartz optical grid test plates (standard pitch 5.0 mm +/- 0.05 um) and high-NA metallurgical long-working-distance objectives (Mitutoyo Plan Apo 20x/50x) have long replenishment lead times; fallback to localized wafer-level box-in-box lithography artifacts patterned on native 100mm oxidized silicon wafers must be qualified to prevent metrology stoppage.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Overlay error vector extraction is on the critical gating path between post-develop inspection and wet/dry pattern etch. A manual Vernier reading workflow creates a 45-minute operator bottleneck per wafer, risking resist hardening and post-exposure/post-develop Q-time violations; an automated digital image capture and vector computation script must be deployed within 10 minutes per lot.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) induced rotational drift during hard-contact nitrogen pressurization (1.0 bar) introducing systematic parasitic rotation (theta > 1.5 mrad) masked as translation.
1. Vernier resist footing or lateral line collapse during MF-319 development causing asymmetric optical centroid shifting exceeding 0.3 um.
1. Optical split-field camera misalignment or telecentricity error yielding apparent field magnification gradient across wafer edges.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-3-3-3-01` | **Multi-Point Optical Vernier Overlay Vector Extraction & Rigid Body Decomposition** | Karl Suss MA6 Split-Field Optical Microscope with 20x Plan Achromat objective (NA 0.25), dual calibrated 5MP CMOS digital cameras, optical micrometer stage, Python/OpenCV metrology extraction engine. | 1. Mount wafer onto the MA6 chuck and engage WEC air bearing to ensure parallelism < 1.0 um across 100mm surface. 2. Navigate microscope to 9 standardized coordinates: Center (0,0), Cardinal points at r=35mm (N, S, E, W), and Diagonal points at r=40mm (NE, NW, SE, SW). 3. Capture high-contrast 20x tiff images of outer box (Layer 1 oxide) and inner box (Layer 2 resist). 4. Run automated edge-detection to determine centroid offsets delta_x_i and delta_y_i for all 9 fields. 5. Perform least-squares fit against first-order overlay model: delta_x = T_x - theta * y + M_x * x; delta_y = T_y + theta * x + M_y * y. 6. Output residual vector field and decomposed parameters. | `Total calculated translation |T_x|, |T_y| <= 1.00 um; rotational error |theta| <= 0.05 mrad; residual overlay 3-sigma vector magnitude <= 0.50 um across all 9 sample sites.` |
| `TC-GEN2-UM-3-3-3-02` | **Contact Pressure Hysteresis & Vector Shift Stability Test** | Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner equipped with vacuum and pneumatic hard-contact regulators (0.1 - 1.0 bar), optical split-field microscope with calibrated digital reticle. | 1. Measure baseline Vernier centroid alignment at wafer center and periphery under soft contact (0.2 bar). 2. Ramp pneumatic chuck pressure to full hard contact (1.0 bar N2). 3. Re-measure Vernier overlay coordinates delta_x and delta_y at the identical peripheral sites without disengaging the chuck. 4. Release pressure back to proximity mode (calibrated 20 um gap), re-engage hard contact, and repeat measurements 5 times to compute positional vector hysteresis. | `Contact-induced overlay vector shift delta_vector_shift <= 0.35 um; mechanical hysteresis repeatability standard deviation sigma <= 0.15 um.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), UV-absorbing polycarbonate safety glasses (optical safety compliant), Cleanroom antistatic ESD coat and shoe covers, N95 cleanroom mask during open inspection
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush with sterile saline or water for 15 minutes at eyewash station. Skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and wash area thoroughly with copius DI water. Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within laminar flow hood maintaining ISO Class 5 air with dedicated local solvent exhaust duct (face velocity 0.45 m/s +/- 0.05 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous developer rinse effluent routed to dedicated base neutralization holding tank (pH neutralizer target 6.5 - 8.5) prior to disposal. Solvent wipe rags bagged in airtight chemical waste bins.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (MF-319 developer residual)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade | `2.4% aqueous solution` |
| **Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate (PGMEA / Shipley 1813 solvent)** | `108-65-6` | Semiconductor Grade | `< 1% trace outgassing` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-development patterned Shipley 1813 photoresist on dry SiO2/Si substrate, thoroughly rinsed with DI water (resistivity > 18 MOhm-cm) and N2 blow-dried, free of visible developer residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized wafer with verified overlay vector map, unhardened photoresist ready for immediate hard-bake (120C) or downstream anisotropic dry/wet etching.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time causes atmospheric moisture absorption and ambient airborne organic contamination, inducing resist plasticization, critical dimension (CD) swelling, and edge footing that invalidates downstream etch profiles.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery and qualification of a comprehensive 9-point overlay misalignment vector map and automated error decomposition framework for Gen 2 photolithography on 100mm wafers, demonstrating robust decoupling of translation, rotation, and magnification errors under MA6 hard-contact conditions.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `overlay_vector_decomposition_report.pdf`
- [ ] `multi_field_overlay_residuals.csv`
- [ ] `calibrated_vernier_optical_micrographs.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum global translation misalignment vector magnitude (|T|)** | `0.75 um` | +/- 0.25 um | Multi-site least-squares regression decomposition from 9-point Vernier image centroids |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual non-correctable overlay vector error (3-sigma)** | `0.40 um` | <= 0.50 um maximum | Root-mean-square calculation of residual vectors after subtracting rigid body terms (Tx, Ty, Theta) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit sign-off requires mathematical confirmation that computed translation offsets (Tx, Ty) and rotation (theta) successfully converge with residual 3-sigma <= 0.50 um across two consecutive qualified 100mm wafer runs, signed off by Metrology Domain Lead and Systems Engineer.
